note: 原文逐字取自 docs/audit/dos-ecl-text-inventory.json；原版 block 不修改。專有名詞依 docs/reference/manual/glossary.md，說明書沒有的另記在該檔的「遊戲內文字新增譯名」一節。

entries.source: ' DO YOU SEEK HEALING?'
entries.text: 「你們是來求醫的嗎？」
entries.note: 神殿的問句，原版開頭多一個空格。

entries.source: 'A TENTH OF YOUR MONEY THEN.'DO YOU ACCEPT?
entries.text: 「那就你們錢財的十分之一。」你們接受嗎？
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: 'ALL RIGHT THEN. WHAT IS TODAY'S PASSWORD?'
entries.text: 「那好。今天的密語是什麼？」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'ALL RIGHT, GET OUT OF HERE THEN. COME BACK WHEN YOU'VE LEARNED THE RULES.'
entries.text: 「那就滾吧。等你們學會規矩再回來。」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'ALL RIGHT, THEN. PASS!' AND WITH THAT THE GATES SWING OPEN AND YOU PASS THROUGH THE GATE.
entries.text: 「那好，過去吧！」門隨即敞開，你們穿了過去。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'ALL RIGHT, THEN. WHAT IS TODAY'S PASSWORD?'
entries.text: 「那好。今天的通關密語是什麼？」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'ALL RIGHT, THEN. WHAT TODAY'S PASSWORD?'
entries.text: 「那好。今天密語是什麼？」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版此處漏了 IS。

entries.source: 'ARROGANT KNAVE FEEL THE POWER OF TYRANTHRAXUS!'
entries.text: 「狂妄的小人，嘗嘗泰蘭特拉克斯的力量！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'BACK SO SOON? I CAN ONLY REPEAT THE EARLIER OFFERS: '
entries.text: 「這麼快就回來了？我能給的還是先前那幾項：」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: 'BEGONE OR FEEL THE WRATH AND POWER OF TYRANTHRAXUS!' DO YOU LEAVE?
entries.text: 「滾，否則就嘗嘗泰蘭特拉克斯的怒火與力量！」你們要離開嗎？
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'BEHIND THESE DOORS ARE THE SPECIAL TRAINING SCHOOLS  WHERE ADVENTURERS INCREASE THEIR SKILLS. LET US NOW GO TO THE CITY'S MOST IMPORTANT BUILDING.'
entries.text: 「這幾道門後面是各種訓練所，冒險者在裡面精進本事。接下來去看看城裡最重要的建築。」
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第五頁。訓練所沿用說明書 p.9 的用詞。

entries.source: 'BEYOND THIS GATE ARE THE MONSTER-RIDDEN AREAS OF THE OLD CITY WE ARE SLOWLY PREPARING FOR SETTLEMENT.  THE COUNCIL OFFERS A GENEROUS REWARD TO THOSE WHO CLEAR AREAS OF MONSTERS.
entries.text: 「這道門外就是舊城區，那裡滿是怪物，我們正一步步整頓、準備讓人遷入。清掉一區怪物的人，市議會會給一筆優厚的報酬。
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第七頁。原版這一句沒有結尾引號，照原樣不補。

entries.source: 'BLASPHEMERS! GET THEM!'
entries.text: 「褻瀆神明的傢伙！上！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'BOY, THIS CROWN IS HEAVY. OH, WELL IT'S A LIVING. WHAT DOES TYRANTHRAXUS WAN... OOPS! GET THEM!
entries.text: 「唉，這頂王冠真沉。算了，總得討口飯吃。泰蘭特拉克斯要什……糟！上啊！
entries.note: 瓦傑渥城堡內部。接下一段。

entries.source: 'BY ORDER OF THE CITY COUNCIL,' THE HARBOR MASTER SAYS, 'THE ONLY BOAT OUT IS GOING TO SOKAL KEEP.  YOU CAN CATCH IT AT THE END OF THE PIER.'
entries.text: 港務長說：「市議會有令，現在唯一出港的船是開往索卡爾城堡的。到碼頭盡頭就能搭上。」
entries.note: 港口。

entries.source: 'BY THE WAY, YOUR BUNGLING THE BIVANT RESCUE HAS COST US.'
entries.text: 「對了，畢凡特那次救援你們搞砸了，我們付出了代價。」
entries.note: Bivant 為新增譯名。

entries.source: 'CATCH THE BOAT AT THE END OF THE PIER.'
entries.text: 「到碼頭盡頭搭船。」
entries.note: 港務長。

entries.source: 'COME, LET THERE BE GAMES FOR OUR GUESTS.' HE LEADS YOU TO THE CAMP'S CENTRAL CLEARING.
entries.text: 「來，為我們的客人辦幾場競技。」他領著你們走向營地中央的空地。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: 'DIE HAPPY FIENDS, YOUR DEATHS SHALL BE MY FREEDOM.'
entries.text: 「痛快地死吧，惡徒；你們的死就是我的自由。」
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: 'DO YOU SEEK A PARTNER FOR YOUR ADVENTURING?'
entries.text: 「你們是來找冒險同伴的嗎？」
entries.note: 訓練所與競技場。

entries.source: 'DO YOU THINK HE'LL REALLY SHOW UP -- THE BOSS I MEAN?'
entries.text: 「你覺得他真的會現身嗎——我是說老大。」
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: 'DON'T GO THERE! DON'T GO ON THE HILL!'
entries.text: 「別去那裡！別上那座山丘！」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'DON'T TRY TO FOOL ME.' HE GROWLS.
entries.text: 「別想騙我。」他低吼。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'DUE TO YOUR VICIOUS ATTACK ON THOSE WHO PROTECT US, WE REFUSE YOU ALL SERVICE.'
entries.text: 「你們竟然攻擊保護我們的人，這裡不再為你們提供任何服務。」
entries.note: 神殿拒絕服務。

entries.source: 'EXCELLENT.'
entries.text: 「太好了。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: 'FACE ME OR FIND SOME FOOL TO CHAMPION YOU!' THE OLD LIZARD MAN TURNS TO YOU AND SAYS, 'OUR CAUSE IS ONE. WILL YOU CHAMPION ME?'
entries.text: 「跟我單挑，不然就找個傻子替你出戰！」年老的蜥蜴人轉向你們：「我們立場一致。願意替我出戰嗎？」
entries.note: 沼澤的蜥蜴人部族。

entries.source: 'FAR TO THE EAST THERE IS A LARGE KOBOLD COMPLEX.  THERE IS A SILVER BOTTLE OF GREAT POWER THERE THAT WILL HELP YOU ON YOUR QUEST.  RETRIEVE THAT BOTTLE THEN RETURN AND I WILL SEND YOU ON ANOTHER QUEST.'
entries.text: 「遠在東邊有一片龐大的小妖魔巢穴，那裡有一只力量強大的銀瓶，能助你們一臂之力。把瓶子取回來，我再交給你們下一件任務。」
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。

entries.source: 'FOOLS, SUMMON ME ONLY WHEN A VAMPIRE IS NEAR OR FACE MY WRATH.' HE RETURNS TO THE BOTTLE.
entries.text: 「蠢貨，附近有吸血鬼才准召喚我，否則後果自負。」說完他回到了瓶中。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: 'FREE ME AND I'LL HELP YOU.'
entries.text: 「放我自由，我就幫你們。」
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'FROGS AND TOADS NOT SAME THING. THEY NOT SAME, THEY DIF... THEY NOT SAME! ME RIGHT?'
entries.text: 「青蛙跟蟾蜍不一樣。不一樣，牠們不……反正就是不一樣！我沒說錯吧？」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版用不標準的口語。

entries.source: 'FROM HERE YOU CAN ALSO SEE OUR SOLIDLY BUILT OUTSIDE WALL.  THIS WALL HAS SURVIVED MANY ATTACKS, INCLUDING ONE FROM A DRAGON.'
entries.text: 「從這裡各位也看得到我們堅固的外牆。它挺過了多次攻擊，其中還有一次是龍。」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'GARWIN, I'LL GET YOU!' CRIES THE AUCTIONEER. HOWEVER, THE MAN HAS ESCAPED IN THE CONFUSION.
entries.text: 「加文，我不會放過你！」拍賣官大叫。但那人已趁亂逃走了。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。Garwin 為新增譯名。

entries.source: 'GET EM!'
entries.text: 「上啊！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'GET LOST, WIMP! IF YA DON'T BEAT IT WE'LL BEAT YOU! HA! HA!' THE GIANT LEADER POKES THE GIANT NEXT TO HIM, 'BEAT IT, BEAT THEM! GET IT?!'
entries.text: 「滾吧，孬種！你們不快滾，我們就揍你們！哈！哈！」巨人頭子戳了戳旁邊那個：「快滾、揍他們！懂了沒？！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'GET OUTA HERE BEFORE WE MAKE YOU LEAVE' THE MONSTERS YELL.  'AND YOU WONT COME BACK IF YOU KNOW WHATS GOOD FER YA'  THE MONSTERS THEN LEAVE.
entries.text: 「趁我們還沒動手，快滾。」怪物吼道，「識相的話就別再回來。」說完牠們就走了。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。原版此處刻意用不標準的口語。

entries.source: 'GO AHEAD THREATEN US! TEAR OUT OUR HEARTS! CUT OFF OUR HEADS! SLICE OPEN OUR BELLIES... IF YOU CAN.
entries.text: 「儘管威脅我們啊！挖出我們的心！砍下我們的頭！剖開我們的肚子……如果你們辦得到的話。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。接下一段。

entries.source: 'GOING... GOING... GONE!' THE AUCTIONEER CRIES.
entries.text: 「一次……兩次……成交！」拍賣官喊道。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: 'GREAT! MY NAME IS SKULLCRUSHER. THERE'S A SECRET DOOR TO THE SOUTHEAST. THAT'S WHERE I MET THE HOBGOBLIN LEADER.'
entries.text: 「太好了！我叫碎顱者。東南邊有一道暗門，我就是在那裡碰上大哥布林頭子的。」
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'GREETINGS, COURAGEOUS ONES, I AM ROLF, APPOINTED BY THE COUNCIL TO INTRODUCE NEWCOMERS TO THE FAIR CITY OF PHLAN. IF YOU WILL ACCOMPANY ME, I WILL START THE TOUR.'
entries.text: 「勇敢的朋友們，你們好。我是羅夫，市議會派我為新來的人介紹美麗的菲蘭城。願意跟我走一趟的話，導覽這就開始。」
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第一頁。Phlan 依 glossary 定案作菲蘭；Rolf 說明書未收，見 glossary 的「遊戲內文字新增譯名」。

entries.source: 'HAH! HAH! YOU'RE DUMB! THAT'S NOT THE PASSWORD!'
entries.text: 「哈！哈！你們真笨！那不是密語！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'HAIL, NOBLE ADVENTURERS,' HE CALLS. 'I WOULD ASK YOU TO HELP ME END THIS FOUL UNDEAD CURSE.'
entries.text: 「高貴的冒險者，你們好。」他喊道，「我想請你們幫我了結這道汙穢的不死詛咒。」
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'HE IS BOUND TO RECOVER THE TEMPLE WHICH HAS BEEN DESECRATED TO BANE.  GO WITH HIM ACROSS THE RIVER AND HELP HIM TO CLEANSE THE TEMPLE.  IN PAYMENT, YOU MAY KEEP THE HIDDEN TREASURES.'
entries.text: 「他發願要奪回那座被獻給邪惡神的神殿。跟他過河去，幫他把神殿清乾淨。作為報酬，藏在裡面的財寶歸你們。」
entries.note: 巴西歐主教的委託；Bane 依 glossary 作邪惡（神）。

entries.source: 'HE IS NOT HUMAN I TELL YOU! NOT AT ALL!'
entries.text: 「我告訴你們，他不是人！根本不是！」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'HE IS WRAPPED IN FIRE AND SO CRUEL!'
entries.text: 「他渾身裹著火，殘忍極了！」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'HE MELTED INTO A PUDDLE OF LARD WHEN HE TOUCHED THE THING!'
entries.text: 「他一碰那東西就化成一灘油了！」
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: 'HERE YOU MAY REST.'
entries.text: 「各位可以在這裡歇息。」
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: 'HERE YOU SEE ONE OF OUR FINE WATCH TOWERS WHICH WERE BUILT BY THE FINEST STONE MASONS IN THE LAND.'
entries.text: 「各位看到的是我們出色的瞭望塔之一，由全國最好的石匠所建。」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'HEY LOOK! IT MUST BE THEM INTRUDERS.'
entries.text: 「喂看！一定就是那些闖進來的。」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版用口語。

entries.source: 'HEY, WAIT A MINUTE. THEY ARE IMPOSTERS! ALL RIGHT, THROW DOWN YOUR WEAPONS!'
entries.text: 「喂，等等。他們是冒牌的！好啦，把武器丟下！」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'HEY, WHAT DO YOU THINK YOU'RE DOING?'
entries.text: 「喂，你們以為自己在幹嘛？」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'HIS IMMENSITY, TYRANTHRAXUS, HAS SEEN FIT TO ESTABLISH THIS TEMPLE TO OUR LORD BANE. THEREFORE IT IS RIGHT THAT YOU ACCEPT THE LORD BANE'S BLESSING.'
entries.text: 「至大的泰蘭特拉克斯認為該為我主邪惡神立這座神廟。因此，你們理當接受邪惡神的祝福。」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'HOW DARE YOU INTERFERE WITH THE BOSS'S BUSINESS?' THE LEADER ROARS.  'KILL THEM,' HE ORDERS.
entries.text: 「你們竟敢壞老大的事？」領頭的怒吼，「殺了他們。」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'I ACCEPT YOUR PLEDGE.  FOR YOUR FIRST DUTY, I COMMAND YOU TO RECOVER A POWERFUL MAGICAL BOTTLE FROM A KOBOLD SETTLEMENT IN THE HILLS FAR TO THE EAST.  THEN RETURN TO ME AND I SHALL GIVE YOU ANOTHER TASK.'
entries.text: 「我接受你們的效忠。第一件差事：我命你們從遠東方山丘上的小妖魔聚落取回一只強大的魔法瓶，然後回來，我再交給你們下一件任務。」
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。

entries.source: 'I ALMOST KILLED THE LEADER OF THESE SCUMMY HOBGOBLINS, BUT THE REST JUMPED ME!'
entries.text: 「我差點就宰了這群骯髒大哥布林的頭子，結果其他的一擁而上！」
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'I AM PRINCESS FATIMA.' THE PRINCESS CONTINUES.
entries.text: 「我是法蒂瑪公主。」公主接著說。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: 'I AM SORRY,' THE MAN SAYS, 'I CANNOT HELP YOU.'
entries.text: 那人說：「抱歉，我幫不上忙。」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'I AM THE EFREETI SAMIR AHWAHL. YOU ARE NOT MY MASTER. ARE YOU, PERCHANCE, VAMPIRES?'
entries.text: 「我是伊弗利特薩米爾·阿瓦爾。你們不是我的主人。莫非，你們是吸血鬼？」
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。Samir Ahwahl 為新增譯名；Efreeti 依對齊表作伊弗利特。

entries.source: 'I AM TO ESCORT YOU TO OUR TREASURE.'
entries.text: 「我奉命帶各位去看我們的寶藏。」
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: 'I AND MY PEOPLE THANK YOU. AND KNOW THAT WE HAVE HONOR. YOU SHALL BE RICHLY REWARDED FOR YOUR GENEROUS AID.'
entries.text: 「我和我的族人感謝各位。請相信我們知恩圖報，你們的慷慨相助必有厚報。」
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: 'I DON'T LIKE YOUR TONE.'
entries.text: 「我不喜歡你們的口氣。」
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'I HAVE BEEN AUTHORIZED TO GIVE YOU AN ENCHANTED WEAPON IF YOU ACCEPT THE COMMISSION TO END THE GRAVEYARD MENACE.  DO YOU ACCEPT?'
entries.text: 「只要你們接下解除墳場之患的委託，我獲准贈與一件附魔武器。你們接嗎？」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: 'I HAVE NO MORE TIME TO TALK WITH YOU, THE LORD BANE REQUIRES MY CONSTANT DEVOTION. COME, BEFORE YOU LEAVE ACCEPT THE BLESSING OF OUR LORD.
entries.text: 「我沒空再和你們說話了，邪惡神需要我時刻虔敬。來吧，走之前接受我主的祝福。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。接下一段。

entries.source: 'I HAVE NO TIME FOR THE LIKES OF YOU,' THE MAN SAYS AIRILY.  'BEGONE!' (WHAT DO YOU DO?)
entries.text: 「我沒空理你們這種人。」那人輕慢地說，「滾吧！」（你們要怎麼做？）
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'I KNOW THE WAY THROUGH THE HEDGE... LEFT RIGHT RIGHT... FOR CHANTUA'S SAKE! DON'T LEAVE ME!'
entries.text: 「我知道怎麼穿過樹籬……左、右、右……看在香圖亞的份上！別丟下我！」
entries.note: 瓦傑渥城堡內部。Chantua 為新增譯名。

entries.source: 'I MAY HAVE A USE FOR YOU,' THE MAN SAYS. 'SOME TIME AGO, I ORDERED A SPECIAL POTION.  THE POTION IS READY BUT I CAN'T LEAVE TO FETCH IT.  BRING IT HERE, I PAY WELL.' (WHAT DO YOU DO?)
entries.text: 「你們或許派得上用場。」那人說，「前些時候我訂了一瓶特製藥水。藥水好了，我卻走不開去取。替我帶來，重重有賞。」（你們要怎麼做？）
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'I SAID GET LOST!'
entries.text: 「我叫你們滾！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'I SAID GET OUT!' THE GNOLL GRABS A POT FROM THE FIRE AND THROWS ITS CONTENTS AT YOU.
entries.text: 「我叫你們滾！」那隻豺狼人從火上抄起一口鍋，把裡面的東西潑向你們。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'I'M SORRY, I CAN'T TAKE ANYMORE ORDERS JUST NOW. IF IT'S IMPORTANT GET AUTHORIZATION. NOW IF YOU'LL EXCUSE ME I HAVE TO GET BACK TO WORK'
entries.text: 「抱歉，我現在不能再接單了。要是事情要緊，去弄張授權來。恕我失陪，我得回去做事了。」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'I'M SORRY, SIR, THERE'S AN ALERT.
entries.text: 「抱歉，長官，現在有警報。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。接下一段。

entries.source: 'I'M SORRY, SIR, THERE'S AN ALERT. ON WHOSE AUTHORITY ARE YOU HERE?'
entries.text: 「抱歉，長官，現在有警報。你們是奉誰的命令來的？」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'IF YOU CHANGE YOUR MIND, RETURN IN TWO HOURS.' HE ESCORTS YOU OUT.
entries.text: 「改變主意的話，兩小時後再來。」他送你們出去。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: 'IN THE EAST WALL IS THE SECRET DOOR.' SAYS SKULLCRUSHER.'IF WE GO THROUGH WE CAN SURPRISE THEM.'
entries.text: 「暗門在東牆上。」碎顱者說，「從那裡進去可以打牠們個措手不及。」
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'IN THE NAME OF CHANTUA, HELP ME, PLEASE! BY ALL THAT'S MERCIFUL HELP ME.' HE BEGINS TO COUGH.
entries.text: 「以香圖亞之名，求求你們救我！看在一切慈悲的份上救救我。」他咳了起來。
entries.note: 瓦傑渥城堡內部。

entries.source: 'IT IS IMPERATIVE THAT A MESSAGE BE DELIVERED TO THE ZHENTIL OUTPOST TO THE WEST.  I AM SENDING YOU AS DIPLOMATIC ENVOYS.
entries.text: 「有一封信務必送到西邊的漢提爾前哨。我要派你們以使節的身分前往。
entries.note: 接下一段。

entries.source: 'IT IS THE UNANIMOUS REQUEST OF THE COUNCIL THAT YOU LEAD THE ATTACK. YOUR SKILL AND BRAVERY HAVE WON THE ADMIRATION OF ALL PHLAN.  WE LOOK TO YOU TO HELP US WIN OUR FREEDOM.'
entries.text: 「議會一致請求由你們領軍。你們的本事與膽識已贏得全菲蘭城的敬佩。我們指望你們幫我們贏回自由。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: 'IT IS TODAY'S PASSWORD AT THE MAIN GATE INTO THE HEDGE MAZE. ALAS, I CAN NOT HELP YOU WITH THAT FOR I HAVE NOT BEEN INSIDE. BUT I HAVE HEARD THE MAZE IS DEADLY!'
entries.text: 「那是今天進樹籬迷宮大門的密語。可惜迷宮裡我幫不上忙，我沒進去過。不過聽說那迷宮要人命！」
entries.note: 瓦傑渥城堡內部。

entries.source: 'IT WAITS IN A BOOTH IN THE OLD ROPE GUILD BUT A SHORT DISTANCE TO THE SOUTHEAST FROM WHERE YOU NOW STAND.  SPEAK MY NAME, OHLO.'
entries.text: 「東西就在舊繩索公會的一個攤子裡，離你們站的地方往東南不遠。報上我的名字，歐洛。」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'IT WILL COST YOU 1 PLATINUM PIECE TO REST HERE.  DO YOU WANT TO STAY?'
entries.text: 「在這裡休息要一枚白金幣。你們要住下嗎？」
entries.note: 旅店。

entries.source: 'IT'S A STAFF OF COMMAND. I COULD HAVE MY OWN ARMY!'
entries.text: 「那是統御法杖。我可以有自己的軍隊了！」
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: 'IT'S A WAND OF ILLUMINATION. WHO CARES, I SEE IN THE DARK ANYWAY!'
entries.text: 「那是照明魔杖。誰在乎，反正我在暗處也看得見！」
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: 'JUST AROUND THE CORNER IS OUR TREASURE. TAKE WHAT YOU WISH AND LEAVE US. GOOD DAY.'
entries.text: 「轉個彎就是我們的寶藏。各位要什麼儘管拿，然後放過我們。告辭。」
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: 'JUST LET ME GO, OKAY?
entries.text: 「放我走，好不好？
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。接下一段。

entries.source: 'LET ME GIVE YOU A PIECE OF ADVICE,' THEIR LEADER SAYS.  'STAY AWAY FROM THE TEXTILE HOUSE. THE UNDEAD ARE GOING CRAZY UP THERE.'  THE MONSTERS TURN TO LEAVE. (WHAT DO YOU DO?)
entries.text: 「給你們一個忠告，」領頭的說，「離紡織行遠一點。那裡的不死怪物已經瘋了。」怪物轉身要走。（你們要怎麼做？）
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'MEET HERE IN TWO HOURS. YOU MAY MEET HIGH PRIEST MACE.' HE ESCORTS YOU OUT.
entries.text: 「兩小時後在這裡碰面，或許能見到梅斯大祭司。」他送你們出去。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。Mace 為新增譯名。

entries.source: 'MORE OGRES ON THE STREET, SINCE THE GIANTS TOOK OVER THE CASTLE.'
entries.text: 「自從巨人占了城堡，街上的食人鬼就變多了。」
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: 'MOVE IT, TROLL-BAIT!' THEY SNARL AND MOVE OFF.
entries.text: 「讓開，巨魔的餌！」牠們咆哮著走開。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: 'MUTILATING SCUM! WE WILL DIE BEFORE WE LET YOU TWIST US AS YOU HAVE OUR OTHER PEOPLE! BUT YOU WILL DIE FIRST!'
entries.text: 「殘害同類的渣滓！我們寧死也不讓你們像對付其他族人那樣扭曲我們！不過你們得先死！」
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: 'MY SCOUTS HAVE SEEN EVIDENCE OF A LARGE BAND OF KOBOLDS IN THE VICINITY. I WORRY ABOUT MY PEOPLE. IF YOU WOULD STAY UNTIL THEY PASS I WOULD APPRECIATE IT.
entries.text: 「我的斥候在附近發現大批小妖魔的行跡。我擔心族人的安危。各位若肯留到牠們離開，我會很感激。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。接下一段。

entries.source: 'NORTH WALL.  RI  T FRONT GLAS . SE'
entries.text: 「北牆。右　前　玻璃　。看」
entries.note: 牆上被刮花的訊息，原版就是殘缺的，譯文照樣留空。

entries.source: 'NOT ONLY THAT THEY'RE AFRAID OF THEM ETTIN. MAKES 'EM REAL JUMPY. WOULDN'T GIVE 'EM NO BACK TALK IF I WERE YOU.'
entries.text: 「不只這樣，他們還怕那些雙頭巨魔，怕得神經兮兮。我是你們就不會頂嘴。」
entries.note: 史塔傑諾門一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'NOW BEAT IT BEFORE WE GET SERIOUS.'
entries.text: 「趁我們還沒認真，快滾。」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'OH WELL. CAN'T LET HERDREK HAVE ALL FUN.' THEY PICK UP THEIR CLUBS AND ATTACK.
entries.text: 「算了，總不能讓赫德瑞克一個人玩得盡興。」牠們抄起棍棒攻了上來。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。Herdrek 為新增譯名。

entries.source: 'OH WELL.' HE LEAVES.
entries.text: 「算了。」他走了。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'OH, BY THE WAY. BETTER BEWARE OF THE GUARDS. EVER SINCE THE GIANTS MOVED INTO THE CASTLE AREA, BUGBEARS HAVE BEEN STUCK GUARDING THE GATE. AND THEY HATE IT.'
entries.text: 「對了，守衛要當心。自從巨人搬進城堡一帶，守門的差事就落到熊地精頭上，牠們可討厭得很。」
entries.note: 史塔傑諾門一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'OH, WE SORRY! JUST DOING JOB! PLEASE NO TELL? WE LET YOU... WE STAY AT POST. MAKE SURE NO ONE GO BY!'
entries.text: 「喔，抱歉抱歉！我們只是做事！拜託別說出去？我們讓你們……我們守在崗位上，保證沒人過得去！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版用不標準的口語。

entries.source: 'OH, YEAH? WHO SEND YOU?'
entries.text: 「是喔？誰派你們來的？」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版文法本身就不通。

entries.source: 'OH, YOU'RE HERE FOR THE BOSS.'
entries.text: 「喔，你們是來找老大的。」
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: 'OH... OKAY.' AND WITH THAT THEY LEAVE.
entries.text: 「喔……好吧。」說完牠們就走了。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'OKAY, BUT NO HANGING AROUND.'
entries.text: 「好吧，但別在這裡逗留。」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'ON YOUR RIGHT IS ONE OF THE ENTRANCE'S TO SUNE'S TEMPLE. AS WITH ALL PHLAN'S TEMPLES, VARIOUS CLERICAL SERVICES ARE OFFERED INSIDE.  ON YOUR LEFT IS AN ENTRANCE TO THE CITY PARK.'
entries.text: 「右手邊是蘇妮神殿的入口之一。和菲蘭城其他神殿一樣，裡面提供各種神職服務。左手邊則是通往市立公園的入口。」
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第六頁。

entries.source: 'OUR TOUR IS ENDED. AGAIN, LET ME URGE YOU TO APPLY TO THE CITY CLERK FOR A COMMISSION.  GOOD-BYE AND GOOD FORTUNE.' (YOU ARE ON YOUR OWN NOW)
entries.text: 「導覽到此結束。再提醒一次，記得去找書記官接委託。再會，祝你們好運。」（接下來就靠你們自己了）
entries.note: Rolf 導覽最後一頁。括號內是原版給玩家的旁白，不是羅夫的話。

entries.source: 'PLEASE DON'T KILL US,' SHE SAYS. 'IF YOU DON'T WE WILL GIVE YOU THESE CLOTHES TO USE AS A DISGUISE. WE SWEAR WE WON'T SAY ANYTHING!
entries.text: 「求你們別殺我們，」她說，「只要放過我們，這些衣服就給你們拿去偽裝。我們發誓什麼都不說！
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。接下一段。

entries.source: 'PLEASE THINK ABOUT IT OVERNIGHT.' AFTER A WHILE THE FESTIVITIES END AND YOU ARE ESCORTED TO YOUR LODGING.
entries.text: 「請各位考慮一晚。」過了一陣子慶典散了，你們被送回住處。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: 'PLEASURE DOING BUSINESS WITH YOU. HERE'S YOUR WAGON.'
entries.text: 「跟你們做生意真愉快。貨車給你們。」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'PUNY CREATURES,' HE BELLOWS.'I ALLOWED YOU TO TOY WITH MY MINIONS, BUT NOW I'LL CRUSH THE LIFE FROM YOUR LIMBS.'
entries.text: 「渺小的東西。」他咆哮，「我讓你們玩弄我的爪牙，現在該把你們的命從四肢裡捏出來了。」
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'SINCE YOU ARE NOT THE SERVANTS OF YARASH, WE WILL NOT KILL YOU. THE ENEMY OF MY ENEMY IS NOT MY ENEMY!'
entries.text: 「既然你們不是亞拉斯的走狗，我們就不殺你們。敵人的敵人不是我的敵人！」
entries.note: 野外。

entries.source: 'SKULLCRUSHER WAS HERE' IS CARVED INTO THE NORTH WALL.
entries.text: 北牆上刻著「碎顱者到此一遊」。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'SORRY ME NOT KNOW! JUST DOING JOB! YOU GO NOW.'
entries.text: 「抱歉我不知道！只是做事而已！你們快走。」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版用不標準的口語。

entries.source: 'SORRY, SIR. YEAH, WE CAN GET YA TO THE BOSS. THIS PAPER HAS THE PASSWORDS.'
entries.text: 「抱歉，長官。是的，我們能帶你們去見老大。密語都在這張紙上。」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'SORRY, THAT'S MY FINAL OFFER. TAKE IT OR LEAVE IT.
entries.text: 「抱歉，這是我的最後開價。要不要隨你們。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。接下一段。

entries.source: 'SORRY, YOU DON'T GOT THE MONEY, FRIEND. WELL SEE YOU AROUND.
entries.text: 「抱歉，朋友，你們錢不夠。那就再會啦。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。接下一段；原版口語作 DON'T GOT。

entries.source: 'STILL MY PEOPLE STILL ARE HOSTILE TO STRANGERS. I THINK IT IS BEST IF YOU LEAVE.' HE TURNS AND DISAPPEARS INTO THE WILDERNESS.
entries.text: 「不過我的族人對外人仍有敵意。各位還是走為上策。」他轉身沒入荒野。
entries.note: 沼澤的蜥蜴人部族。原版重複了 STILL。

entries.source: 'TELL ME PASSWORD OR I KILL YOU. NOW!'
entries.text: 「說出密語，不然我殺了你們。快！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版文法本身就不通。

entries.source: 'THANK YOU FOR COMING.  I MUST BE BRIEF FOR OUR NEED IS URGENT.  OUR ONE CHANCE TO DEFEAT THE ENEMY IS THROUGH AN ASSAULT ON THE CASTLE. TO DO THIS, WE MUST FIRST SECURE STOJANOW GATE.
entries.text: 「多謝你們前來。事情緊急，我就長話短說。要擊敗敵人只有一條路——強攻城堡。而要做到這一點，得先拿下史塔傑諾門。
entries.note: 接下一段。

entries.source: 'THANK YOU! THANK YOU! I JUST THOUGHT THAT THE POOL WAS HERE! THERE WAS NOWHERE ELSE TO GO! I HAVE NOWHERE TO GO. TAKE ME WITH YOU?'
entries.text: 「謝謝！謝謝你們！我只是以為那池子在這裡！我沒有別的地方可去了！真的沒有。帶我一起走好嗎？」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'THANKS FOR FREEING ME. I'M LORD CADORNA'S SERVANT.
entries.text: 「謝謝你們放我出來。我是卡多納大人的僕人。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。接下一段。

entries.source: 'THAT BOTTLE CONTAINS A POWERFUL EFREET WHO WAS SUMMONED TO KILL VAMPIRES.  HE WILL BE A VALUABLE ALLY IN OLD PHLAN.  IN VALHINGEN GRAVEYARD THERE IS A VAMPIRE.'
entries.text: 「那只瓶子裡封著一頭強大的伊弗利特，當年是為了獵殺吸血鬼而被召喚的。牠在舊菲蘭城會是可貴的盟友。瓦海登墳場裡就有一隻吸血鬼。」
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。Efreet 為新增譯名。

entries.source: 'THAT YOUNG BOY WILL BRING A GOOD PRICE AT ZHENTIL KEEP.  I THINK I SHALL BUY HIM.'
entries.text: 「那個男孩在漢提爾城堡能賣個好價錢。我看我就把他買下來吧。」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'THAT'S THEM! GET THEM!'
entries.text: 「就是他們！上！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'THE AUCTION IS CANCELLED!' YELLS THE AUCTIONEER AS HE FLEES.
entries.text: 「拍賣取消！」拍賣官一邊逃一邊喊。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: 'THE BIG ONE, THE EVIL ONE IN THE CASTLE OF FLOWERS -- HE IS COMING! IT IS COMING!'
entries.text: 「那個大的、住在花之城堡裡的邪物——他要來了！牠要來了！」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'THE BOSS WILL BE THE GUY BIDDING UP THE PRICE.'
entries.text: 「一直把價錢往上喊的那個，就是老大。」
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: 'THE FAITHFUL SERVANT SENT TO FETCH IT NEVER RETURNED.  THE COMPLEX IS JUST SOUTH OF PODOL PLAZA.  BRING THE TREASURE TO ME AND YOU WILL BE WELL REWARDED.'
entries.text: 「派去取回它的忠僕再也沒有回來。那片建築就在波多廣場南邊。把寶物帶回來給我，必有重賞。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: 'THE GAME WORKS LIKE THIS.  WE SPIN THIS TOP. IF THE GREEN SIDE COMES UP, YOU GET DOUBLE YOUR MONEY BACK.  IF A BLUE SIDE COMES UP, YOU GET YOUR MONEY BACK.  IF A RED SIDE COMES UP, YOU LOSE.'
entries.text: 「規則是這樣：我們轉這個陀螺。轉到綠面，你們拿回兩倍的錢；轉到藍面，錢原數奉還；轉到紅面，你們就輸了。」
entries.note: 酒館賭局。

entries.source: 'THE GATE IS TOO STRONG TO BE TAKEN BY STORM. A SMALL BAND MUST SLIP INSIDE AND HOLD UNTIL RELIEVED. YOU ARE THE BEST AND THE BRAVEST. THE COUNCIL HAS INSTRUCTED ME TO ENTRUST THE TASK TO YOU.'
entries.text: 「那道門太堅固，硬攻是攻不下的。得有一小隊人潛進去撐到援軍抵達。你們是最強也最勇敢的一群，議會指示我把這件事託付給你們。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: 'THE PLAZA'S BANE TEMPLE IS RECRUITING FOR MACE AGAIN. GRISHNAK WON'T BE HAPPY.'
entries.text: 「廣場那邊的邪惡神廟又在替梅斯招人了。格里希納克可不會高興。」
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。Grishnak 為新增譯名。

entries.source: 'THE UNDEAD ARE CONTROLLED BY A VAMPIRE WHO LURKS IN THE NORTHEAST CORNER OF THE GRAVEYARD,' THE MAN SAYS.
entries.text: 那人說：「這些不死怪物由一隻吸血鬼操控，牠躲在墳場的東北角。」
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'THEN DIE YOU SCUM,' THE MAN SPITS.
entries.text: 「那就去死吧，渣滓。」那人啐道。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'THEN FOLLOW ME.'
entries.text: 「那就跟我來。」
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: 'THEN I MUST FIGHT HIM MYSELF.' THE COMBAT IS EXTREMELY SHORT IN DURATION. WHEN IT IS FINISHED DRYTHH TURNS TO HIS FOLLOWERS, 'KILL THEM!'
entries.text: 「那我只好親自跟他打。」那場決鬥極短。結束後德萊特轉向手下：「殺了他們！」
entries.note: 沼澤的蜥蜴人部族。

entries.source: 'THEN YOU MUST LEAVE US,' HE RESPONDS WITH AS MUCH DIGNITY AS HE CAN MUSTER. DO YOU LEAVE?
entries.text: 「那你們得離開我們了。」他盡可能保住體面地回話。要走嗎？
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: 'THERE IS A FINE
entries.text: 「費用是
entries.note: 訓練所與競技場。接下一段。

entries.source: 'THERE IS A REWARD FOR CLEARING THE
entries.text: 「清空以下地方有報酬：
entries.note: 片段，接下一段。

entries.source: 'THERE IS NO ONE WHO WILL GO WITH YOU.'
entries.text: 「沒有人願意跟你們走。」
entries.note: 訓練所與競技場。

entries.source: 'THERE YOU SHALL FIND A MAGICAL BOTTLE WHICH WILL HELP YOU IN CLEANSING OLD PHLAN OF ITS EVIL!'
entries.text: 「你們會在那裡找到一只魔法瓶，它能幫你們把舊菲蘭城的邪惡清乾淨！」
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。

entries.source: 'THESE ARE ALL OF THE COMMISSIONS CURRENTLY AVAILABLE.'
entries.text: 「目前能接的委託就這些。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: 'WAIT A MOMENT,' THE MAN SAYS.  HE HURRIES TO THE BACK OF THE BOOTH AND RETURNS WITH A PACKAGE. 'HERE,' HE SAYS.
entries.text: 「等一下。」那人說完急忙走到攤子後面，拿了一個包裹回來：「拿去。」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'WAIT DON'T LEAVE ME HERE. IF YOU DO I'LL RAISE THE ALARM.'
entries.text: 「等等，別把我丟在這裡。你們敢走，我就拉警報。」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'WAIT! I WAS JUST A MAGE SEARCHING FOR KNOWLEDGE WHEN TYRANTHRAXUS CAPTURED ME. I'VE BEEN FORCED TO WORK FOR HIM. SPARE ME AND I WILL LEAVE, NEVER TO RETURN!'
entries.text: 「等等！我只是個尋求知識的法師，被泰蘭特拉克斯抓來的。我是被迫替牠做事。放我一馬，我這就走，再也不回來！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'WAIT! PLEASE! I'LL GIVE YOU ALL MY NOTES! HERE THEY ARE!'
entries.text: 「等等！拜託！我的筆記全給你們！都在這裡！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'WAIT!' HE SHRIEKS. 'I KNOW HOW TO GET THROUGH THE MAIN GATES. I CAN HELP YOU.'
entries.text: 「等等！」他尖叫，「我知道怎麼通過大門。我能幫你們。」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'WE ARE JUST OUTSIDE THE CITY HALL. PROCLAMATIONS ARE POSTED ON THESE WALLS. INSIDE, THE CITY CLERK AWARDS THE COUNCIL'S COMMISSIONS.  COMMISSIONS ARE THE QUICKEST WAY TO FAME AND FORTUNE.'
entries.text: 「我們就在市政廳外面。公告都貼在這幾面牆上。裡頭的書記官負責發放市議會的委託。想快點成名發財，接委託是最快的路。」
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第四頁。commission 沿用專案既有的「委託」。

entries.source: 'WE CAN DUPLICATE THE SEAL ON THAT CHEST -- FOR HALF THE TREASURE -- NO ONE WILL EVER KNOW. INTERESTED?'
entries.text: 「那個箱子的封印我們可以仿造——分我們一半財寶——沒有人會知道。有興趣嗎？」
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'WE DO SO KNOW THE PASSWORDS! YOU ALWAYS THINK YOU'RE SO SMART. LET'S SEE IF YOU CAN READ TODAY'S LIST.'
entries.text: 「我們當然知道密語！你老以為自己多聰明。那就看看你唸不唸得出今天這張單子。」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'WE GOTTA KEEP ALL YOU NONBELIVERS OUTA HERE' THE MONSTERS SAY AS THEY BEGIN TO LEAVE.  'SO HIT THE ROAD YA BUMS.'  THE MONSTERS TURN AND LEAVE.
entries.text: 「我們得把你們這些異教徒擋在外頭。」怪物一邊說一邊要走，「所以上路吧，混帳。」說完轉身離去。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。原版把 NONBELIEVERS 拼成 NONBELIVERS，並刻意用不標準的口語。

entries.source: 'WE HAVE BEEN INFORMED YOU HAVE ELIMINATED SOME UNDEAD FROM THE GRAVEYARD.
entries.text: 「我們接獲通報，你們清掉了墳場裡的一些不死怪物。
entries.note: 接下一段。

entries.source: 'WE HAVE TO KEEP THIS AREA FREE OF INTRUDERS -- BOSS'S ORDERS.  WE'LL LET YOU GO THIS TIME.  BUT IF YOU COME BACK, YOU'LL FACE BIG TROUBLE.' THE MONSTERS LEAVE.
entries.text: 「這一帶不許外人進來——首領的命令。這次放你們一馬，再回來就有大麻煩了。」怪物們隨即離去。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: 'WE TRAIN ONLY
entries.text: 「我們只訓練
entries.note: 訓練所與競技場。接下一段。

entries.source: 'WE'LL LET YOU OFF THIS TIME.' THE MONSTERS SCUTTLE AWAY.
entries.text: 「這次先放過你們。」怪物窸窸窣窣地散開。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: 'WE'RE GONNA HAVE TA TEACH YOU A LESSON!'
entries.text: 「看來得給你們上一課！」
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: 'WELL BOYS, I THINK WE HAVE THE INTRUDERS HERE. GET THEM!'
entries.text: 「弟兄們，闖進來的就在這裡。上！」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'WELL THEN, GOOD LUCK. BEST YOU LEAVE BEFORE YOU ARE FOUND HERE.
entries.text: 「那就祝你們好運。最好趁還沒被發現前離開。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。接下一段。

entries.source: 'WHAT A BUNCH OF CHEAPSKATES,' THE LEADER COMPLAINS. 'LET 'EM HAVE IT BOYS!'
entries.text: 「一群小氣鬼。」領頭的抱怨道，「弟兄們，給他們點顏色看看！」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE?'
entries.text: 「你們在這裡做什麼？」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE?' HE REPEATS.
entries.text: 「你們在這裡做什麼？」他又問了一次。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE?', HE REPEATS.
entries.text: 「你們在這裡做什麼？」他又問了一次。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版這一版逗號位置不同。

entries.source: 'WHAT IS YOUR BUSINESS WITH TYRANTHRAXUS, LORD OF PHLAN?'
entries.text: 「你們找菲蘭城之主泰蘭特拉克斯有什麼事？」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'WHAT PASSWORD?'
entries.text: 「什麼密語？」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'WHAT YA DOIN' HERE?'
entries.text: 「你們在這幹嘛？」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版用口語。

entries.source: 'WHAT? I THINK THESE SCUM ARE IMPOSTERS!'
entries.text: 「什麼？我看這些渣滓是冒牌貨！」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'WHAT? I THINK YOU SCUM ARE IMPOSTERS!'
entries.text: 「什麼？我看你們這些渣滓是冒牌貨！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'WHATS YOUR PROBLEM?'
entries.text: 「你們有什麼毛病？」
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。原版把 WHAT'S 寫成 WHATS。

entries.source: 'WHEN OLD PHLAN WAS OVERRUN, A FAMILY TREASURE WAS HIDDEN IN THE WESTERN BUILDING OF THE TEXTILE COMPLEX.
entries.text: 「舊菲蘭城淪陷時，一件傳家寶被藏在紡織行西側那棟建築裡。
entries.note: 接下一段。

entries.source: 'WHEN YOU GET TO ZHENTIAL KEEP, PRESENT THIS PACKET TO ITS COMMANDANT.  DO NOT BREAK THE SEALS OR YOU WILL BE SEIZED AS SPIES.'
entries.text: 「到了漢提爾城堡，把這包文件交給指揮官。千萬別拆封，否則會被當成間諜逮捕。」
entries.note: 原版此處把 ZHENTIL 拼成 ZHENTIAL。

entries.source: 'WHEN YOU MEET THE VAMPIRE USE THE BOTTLE AND YOU MAY HAVE A CHANCE IN DEFEATING HIM.  I WISH YOU LUCK.'  AFTER SPEAKING DIOGENES FLIES THROUGH A HOLE IN THE CEILING AND DISSAPPEARS.
entries.text: 「遇上那隻吸血鬼時就用那只瓶子，你們或許有機會擊敗牠。祝你們好運。」說完，狄奧根尼斯從天花板的洞飛了出去，消失無蹤。
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。原版把 DISAPPEARS 拼成 DISSAPPEARS。

entries.source: 'WHO HIM? OH WELL HE NO CAN HELP YOU NOW!'
entries.text: 「他？哼，他現在幫不了你們了！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版用不標準的口語。

entries.source: 'WHY SURE I'LL SELL YOU MY WAGON. ALL IT'LL COST YOU IS 250 GOLD PIECES. HOW ABOUT IT?'
entries.text: 「當然，貨車賣你們。兩百五十枚金幣就好。如何？」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'WILL YOU ACCOMPANY DIRTEN?'
entries.text: 「你們願意陪迪爾騰去嗎？」
entries.note: 巴西歐主教的委託；Dirten 為新增譯名。

entries.source: 'WOE, WOOOE, OH WOE,' THE FIGURES CRY PITEOUSLY.
entries.text: 「哀啊，哀啊，好哀啊。」那些身影淒慘地哭喊。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'WORDS DON'T BREAK CHAINS!' HE SNARLS.
entries.text: 「話又砸不斷鎖鏈！」他咆哮。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'WOULD YOU LIKE TO CONSIDER SOMEONE ELSE?'
entries.text: 「要不要考慮換一個人？」
entries.note: 訓練所與競技場。

entries.source: 'WRONG ANSWER, DINNER!'
entries.text: 「答錯了，晚餐！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'WRONG! GUESS AGAIN!
entries.text: 「錯了！再猜！
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。接下一段。

entries.source: 'WRONG! THERE IS NO PASSWORD! HA! HA! HA!' THE GIANTS ATTACK.
entries.text: 「錯！根本沒有密語！哈！哈！哈！」巨人動手了。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'YOU ARE NOT THEY WHO RESCUED MY CHILDREN, BUT ARE MURDEROUS PIRATES! THEN YOU ARE NOT SAFE HERE!' HE DISAPPEARS WITH AMAZING SPEED INTO THE WILDERNESS AROUND YOU.
entries.text: 「你們不是救我族中孩子的那些人，而是殺人的海盜！那你們在這裡就不安全了！」他以驚人的速度沒入四周的荒野。
entries.note: 沼澤的蜥蜴人部族。

entries.source: 'YOU ARE SEEKING THE TEXTILE HOUSE. WE CAN GET YOU IN UNSEEN AND POSSIBLY HELP YOU WITH THE TREASURE. INTERESTED?'
entries.text: 「你們要找的是紡織行。我們可以帶你們神不知鬼不覺地進去，說不定還能幫你們弄到那批財寶。有興趣嗎？」
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'YOU CAN REST HERE AS LONG AS YOU WISH.' SHE THEN LEAVES.
entries.text: 「你們想休息多久都行。」說完她就離開了。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: 'YOU DON'T BELONG HERE!'
entries.text: 「你們不該待在這裡！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: 'YOU FOOLS.  I AM A GOOD SILVER DRAGON NOT THE EVIL LEADER OF PHLAN.  DON'T YOU KNOW THAT WE METALLIC DRAGONS ARE GOOD CREATURES?'  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 「你們這些蠢貨。我是善良的銀龍，不是菲蘭城那個邪惡首領。難道不知道我們金屬龍是善的嗎？」你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。

entries.source: 'YOU HAVE DONE WELL. GIVE ME THE POTION AND YOU WILL BE REWARDED.' (WHAT DO YOU DO?)
entries.text: 「幹得好。把藥水給我，少不了你們的報酬。」（你們要怎麼做？）
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'YOU HAVE RETURNED EMPTY HANDED,' HE OBSERVES. 'I HAVE NO TIME FOR YOU NOW.'  HE WAVES HIS HAND.
entries.text: 「空手回來啊。」他看了一眼，「我現在沒空理你們。」說著揮了揮手。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'YOU LIE,' THE SPIRIT MOANS AS IT FADES AWAY.
entries.text: 「你們說謊。」那幽靈一邊呻吟一邊消散。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'YOU MAY WANDER AS YOU WILL OR YOU MAY STAY HERE AND REST AND STUDY. FORGIVE ME, I MUST SEE TO MY PEOPLE.' HE LEAVES.
entries.text: 「各位可以隨意走動，也可以留在這裡歇息、鑽研。恕我失陪，我得去照看族人。」說完他便離開了。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: 'YOU NO HURT THEM. THEM MY BUDDIES!' THEY ARGUE FOR A LITTLE BIT AND THEN ONE SAYS, 'HEY, WHAT WE FIGHTING FOR? IT'S ALL FAULT OF THEM!' 'YEH!' THEY TURN AND ATTACK YOU.
entries.text: 「你不准傷他們。他們是我朋友！」牠們爭了一會兒，其中一個說：「喂，我們吵什麼？都是他們害的！」「對啊！」牠們轉身攻向你們。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版用不標準的口語。

entries.source: 'YOU NOW FACE AN ENTRANCE TO THE TEMPLE OF TYR.  THERE ARE THREE TEMPLES IN PHLAN: TYR'S, SUNE'S, AND TEMPUS. TYR'S IS THE LARGEST AND HOUSES BISHOP BRACCIO. IF YOU WILL TURN AROUND NOW, '
entries.text: 「你們面前是提爾神殿的入口。菲蘭城裡有三座神殿：提爾、蘇妮與坦帕斯。提爾神殿最大，巴西歐主教就住在裡面。現在請轉過身來，」
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第二頁。原版每一頁各自成一段引文，這一頁的句子在下一頁接完，但引號在本頁就收掉，譯文照同樣的斷法。Tyr 提爾、Braccio 巴西歐 依 glossary 定案；Sune、Tempus 為新增譯名。

entries.source: 'YOU PRESUME TOO MUCH,' THE MAN SAYS QUIETLY.  HE GESTURES.
entries.text: 「你們太放肆了。」那人低聲說，接著打了個手勢。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 'YOU WILL SEE THE ENTRANCE TO THE PASSENGER DOCK AREA WE JUST DEPARTED.  FEW SHIPS DARE THE PERILOUS PASSAGE HERE, BUT THE COUNCIL IS DEVELOPING A PLAN TO OPEN UP THE SEA LANES.  PLEASE FOLLOW ME.'
entries.text: 「就會看到我們剛才離開的客運碼頭入口。敢走這條險路的船不多，不過市議會正在擬定計畫，要把航道打通。請跟我來。」
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第三頁，承接上一頁的句子。The City Council 依 glossary 作市議會。

entries.source: 'YOUR GROUP IS TOO LARGE.'
entries.text: 「你們這隊人太多了。」
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: 'YOUR PARTY IS TOO LARGE TO JOIN AT THIS TIME.  RETURN WHEN IT IS SMALLER.'
entries.text: 「你們人太多了，現在不能加入。等人少一點再來。」
entries.note: NPC 入隊限制。

entries.source: (WHAT DO YOU DO?)
entries.text: （你們要怎麼做？）
entries.note: 同上，原版這一版帶括號。

entries.source: , BACKSTABS A PARTY MEMBER THEN DISAPPEARS THROUGH THE WALL.
entries.text: ，從背後偷襲了一名隊員，然後穿牆而去。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。片段，承接上一段。

entries.source: --TYRANTHRAXUS'
entries.text: ——泰蘭特拉克斯
entries.note: 署名片段，原版以兩個連字號起頭。
單獨的句點，原版用來把拆開的句子接起來。

entries.source: .  HE TRIES TO ATTACK THE PARTY BUT YOU STOP HIM.  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 。他想攻擊隊伍，但被你們制住了。要怎麼處置？
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。片段。

entries.source: . IS THIS ACCEPTABLE?'
entries.text: 。這樣可以嗎？」
entries.note: 片段，承接上一段。

entries.source: . THE LEADER SEES YOU. 'THAT'S THEM!'
entries.text: 。領頭的看見你們：「就是他們！」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。片段。

entries.source: . THE LEADER YELLS 'SACRILEGIOUS SCUM!'
entries.text: 。領頭的大吼：「褻瀆神明的渣滓！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。片段。

entries.source: . WILL YOU JOIN US?'
entries.text: 。要不要加入我們？」
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: ... THE GANG IS OPERATING FROM THE CATACOMBS BY THE WELL...
entries.text: ……那幫人以井邊的地下墓穴為據點……
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: ... THE TEMPLE OVER THE RIVER IS RUN BY SOME HOT-SHOT ORC...
entries.text: ……河對岸那座神殿由一隻很跩的半獸人掌管……
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: ... THERE IS A SECRET TREASURE ROOM IN THE NW CORNER ...
entries.text: ……西北角有一間祕密寶庫……
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: ...THE LAST PART IS EATEN AWAY.
entries.text: ……最後一段被啃蝕掉了。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: 1 SHARE
entries.text: 一份
entries.note: 分配戰利品的份數。
古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。編號片段。
古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。編號片段。

entries.source: 2 LIZARD MEN AND A GIANT LIZARD CHARGE AT YOU.
entries.text: 兩名蜥蜴人和一隻巨蜥朝你們衝來。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: 2 SHARES
entries.text: 兩份
entries.note: 同上。
古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。編號片段。
古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。編號片段。

entries.source: 3 GIANT LIZARDS CHARGE TOWARD YOU.
entries.text: 三隻巨蜥朝你們衝來。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: 3 SHARES
entries.text: 三份
entries.note: 同上。

entries.source: 4 SHARES
entries.text: 四份
entries.note: 同上。
古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。編號片段。
介面提示。

entries.source: A
entries.text: 甲
entries.note: 選項編號，原版以 A～D 標示四個小箱。

entries.source: A BAND OF KOBOLDS CLIMBS FROM THE WELL AND ATTACKS.
entries.text: 一群小妖魔從井裡爬上來攻擊。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: A BAND OF KOBOLDS CLIMBS FROM THE WELL BEHIND YOU AND ATTACKS.
entries.text: 一群小妖魔從你們身後的井裡爬上來攻擊。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: A BOULDER BLOCKS OFF THE PASSAGE. USING A LEVER, THE KOBOLD DISLODGES IT AND PROCEEDS. DO YOU?
entries.text: 一塊巨石堵住通道。那隻小妖魔用槓桿把它撬開後繼續前進。你們要跟嗎？
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: A BROKEN HEARTH AND BELLOWS DOMINATES THE COLLAPSED REMAINS OF A BLACKSMITH'S SHOP.  THE FLOOR IS SPONGEY AND DAMP.  THE CROAKING OF FROGS GREETS YOUR ENTRY.
entries.text: 鐵匠鋪的殘骸裡，一座破爐與風箱最為顯眼。地面濕軟，你們一進來就聽見青蛙的呱呱聲。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A BUGBEAR LEADING
entries.text: 一隻熊地精領著
entries.note: 怪物名片段。

entries.source: A BUGBEAR LEADING A PARTY OF
entries.text: 一隻熊地精領著一隊
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。片段。

entries.source: A BUGBEAR WALKS UP TO YOU. 'OKAY, LETS HAVE THE 15 GOLD.' DO YOU PAY HIM?
entries.text: 一隻熊地精走上前來：「好啦，十五枚金幣拿來。」你們要付嗎？
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A CROWD OF SCRUFFY LOOKING NOMADS GATHERS AS HIDDEN SENTRIES GIVE WORD OF YOUR APPROACH. THERE ARE ABOUT AN EQUAL NUMBER OF MEN AND WOMEN.
entries.text: 暗處的哨兵通報了你們的到來，一群衣衫襤褸的遊牧民圍了過來，男女人數相當。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: A DECAYED BUILDING LEFT TO THE RATS.
entries.text: 一棟朽壞的建築，如今只剩老鼠。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: A DRUNKEN BRAWL BREAKS OUT. YOU ARE CAUGHT IN THE MIDDLE.
entries.text: 一場酒醉鬥毆爆發，你們正好被夾在中間。
entries.note: 酒館事件。

entries.source: A DRUNKEN KOBOLD LIES HERE.
entries.text: 一隻喝醉的小妖魔倒在這裡。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: A FIGHTER EMERGES FROM THE BUILDING NEARBY AND CONFRONTS YOU.
entries.text: 一名戰士從附近的建築走出來攔住你們。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: A GIGANTIC SNAKE LIES IN FRONT OF YOU.  IT REARS AND ATTACKS.
entries.text: 一條巨蛇橫在你們面前，昂起身子攻了上來。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: A GROUP OF ARMED GUARDS RIDE BY.
entries.text: 一隊武裝守衛騎馬經過。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: A GROUP OF BUGBEARS APPROACH. 'THROW DOWN YOUR WEAPONS!'
entries.text: 一群熊地精走了過來：「把武器丟下！」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A GROUP OF FOUR GIANTS CHARGE OUT OF A NEARBY BUILDING.
entries.text: 四名巨人從附近一棟建築裡衝了出來。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: A GROUP OF HUMANS WERE DESCRIBED TO ME BY THREE OF OUR PEOPLE WHOM THEY RESCUED. IF YOU ARE THEY YOU WILL HAVE BEEN SHOWN OUR TRIBAL FRIEND-WORD.
entries.text: 我們有三名族人被一群人類救過，他們向我描述了那些人。各位若就是他們，應該看過我們部族的友好暗語。
entries.note: 沼澤的蜥蜴人部族。

entries.source: A GROUP OF LIZARD MEN SLITHER OUT OF THE WATER AND THROW JAVELINS AT YOU.
entries.text: 一群蜥蜴人滑出水面，朝你們投擲標槍。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: A GROUP OF MEN ON HORSEBACK RIDE OUT TO MEET YOU.  THEIR LEADER SAYS, 'ARE YOU THE DIPLOMATIC ENVOYS FROM NEW PHLAN?'  WHAT WILL YOU SAY?
entries.text: 一隊騎馬的人出來迎你們，領頭的問：「你們是新菲蘭城來的使節嗎？」你們要怎麼回答？
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: A GROUP OF MONSTERS IS WAITING ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE WALL
entries.text: 牆的另一邊有一群怪物等著
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。片段。

entries.source: A GROUP OF NOMADS SPOT YOU. THEY SHOUT AND CHARGE. AS THEY COME CLOSER THEIR NUMBERS SWELL WITH ARRIVALS.
entries.text: 一群遊牧民發現了你們，喊著衝上來。愈靠近，趕來的人愈多。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: A GUARD COMES BY AND SAYS 'IF YOU WISH TO CAMP, GO TO THE MERCHANTS AREA!'
entries.text: 一名守衛走過來說：「要紮營就去商人區！」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: A HEALTHY-LOOKING GOBLIN IS INSTRUCTING A GROUP OF YOUNG WARRIORS.  HE SMILES AND SAYS, 'I SEE OUR OPPONENTS HAVE ARRIVED.'
entries.text: 一隻壯碩的哥布林正在指導一群年輕戰士。牠笑著說：「看來對手到了。」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A HORDE OF KOBOLDS IS ATTACKING THE CAMP.
entries.text: 一大群小妖魔正在攻擊營地。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: A HORDE OF KOBOLDS IS ATTACKING THE CAMP. A LONE SENTRY CHARGES BUT IS QUICKLY CUT DOWN. A FAMILY EMERGES FROM A HUT AND CHARGES THE KOBOLDS.
entries.text: 一大群小妖魔正在攻擊營地。一名哨兵獨自衝上去，很快就被砍倒。一家人從帳篷裡出來，迎頭撲向小妖魔。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: A KOBOLD APPROACHES WAVING A WHITE FLAG.
entries.text: 一隻小妖魔舉著白旗走了過來。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: A LARGE GROUP OF MEN LED BY A DWARF RUNS FOWARD TO ATTACK
entries.text: 一大群人由一名矮人帶頭衝上來攻擊
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。原版把 FORWARD 拼成 FOWARD。

entries.source: A LARGE GROUP OF MEN LED BY THE COMMANDANT RUSH FOWARD AND ATTACK.
entries.text: 一大群人由指揮官帶頭衝上前來攻擊。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。原版把 FORWARD 拼成 FOWARD。

entries.source: A LARGE GROUP OF THIEVES OPERATES OUT OF THE OLD KOVEL MANSION. THE COUNCIL WILL PAY TO HAVE THEM CLEANED OUT.'
entries.text: 一大群盜賊以舊柯威大樓為據點。議會願意出錢把他們清掉。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: A LARGE ORC RAISES HIS HEAD AND SNARLS, 'HOW DARE YOU BREAK INTO OUR HOME?'
entries.text: 一隻高大的半獸人抬起頭來咆哮：「你們竟敢闖進我們的地方？」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A LARGE TRIBE OF KOBOLDS IS BEING RECRUITED BY THE ENEMY.  MAKE SURE THEY DON'T JOIN THE ENEMY FORCES.'
entries.text: 敵方正在招攬一支龐大的小妖魔部族，別讓他們加入敵軍。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: A LETTER FROM THE BOSS, TELLING YARASH TO JOIN OR DIE. (ENTRY 33)
entries.text: 一封來自首領的信，要亞拉斯歸順，否則就死。（線索報導 33）
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: A LIZARDMAN LEADS A PACK OF GIANT LIZARDS ON PATROL BEFORE A DOOR THAT HAS BEEN NAILED CLOSED.  SEEING YOU, THE MONSTERS ATTACK!
entries.text: 一名蜥蜴人帶著一群巨蜥，在一道被釘死的門前巡邏。看到你們，怪物們就攻了上來！
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: A LOUD COMMOTION RISES FROM THE COURTYARD.  BASHING OPEN THE DOOR, A LARGE FORCE OF ORCS AND HOBGOBLINS RUSHES YOU.
entries.text: 中庭傳來一陣喧鬧。門被撞開，一大群半獸人與大哥布林朝你們衝來。
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A MAN AND OGRE EXCHANGE THE WAND AND A LARGE BAG, THEN DISAPPEAR INTO THE CROWD.
entries.text: 一個人和一隻食人鬼交換了魔杖與一個大袋子，隨即消失在人群裡。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: A MAN DRIVING A WAGON FULL OF FOOD AND EQUIPMENT STARTS TO DRIVE PAST YOU, GOING NORTH.
entries.text: 一個人趕著滿載食物與裝備的貨車，正要往北從你們身邊經過。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A MAN HURRIES FORWARD. 'I AM SORRY, NOBLE ONES, BUT I HAVE NOTHING TO SELL.'
entries.text: 一個人急忙迎上來：「抱歉，各位大人，我沒有東西可賣。」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A MEDUSA COMES RUNNING TOWARD YOU.
entries.text: 一隻梅杜莎朝你們奔來。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: A MESSAGE TO THE BUCCANEERS OFFERING A BOUNTY FOR A REAL SAHUAGIN. (ENTRY 27)
entries.text: 一則給海盜的訊息，懸賞一隻真正的 Sahuagin。（線索報導 27）
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。Sahuagin 依說明書線索 27 保留原文。

entries.source: A MIST RISES AND THICKENS INTO NUMEROUS SHADOWING FIGURES.  FROM THESE FIGURES RISES A LOW MOANING.
entries.text: 霧氣升起，凝成無數暗影般的身形，其間傳出低沉的呻吟。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A MUSCULAR MAN LOCKED IN CHAINS LIES HERE. NEAR HIM IS A PAGE THAT YOU PLACE IN YOUR JOURNAL UNDER ENTRY 47.
entries.text: 一個被鎖鏈綁著的壯漢躺在這裡。他旁邊有一頁紙，你們把它放進手冊，成為線索報導 47。
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A NET ENTANGLES YOU.
entries.text: 一張網把你們纏住了。
entries.note: 遭遇敘述。

entries.source: A NOTE TO A TRAPPER ABOUT KOBOLDS AND HOBGOBLINS. (ENTRY 40)
entries.text: 一張給獵人的字條，講的是小妖魔與大哥布林。（線索報導 40）
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: A PACK OF HUNGRY GHOULS LOPES TOWARD YOU.
entries.text: 一群飢餓的食屍鬼朝你們奔來。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A PACK OF TROLLS CHARGE FROM WHERE THEY WERE HIDING.
entries.text: 一群巨魔從藏身處衝了出來。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: A PACK OF UNDEAD SUDDENLY APPEARS.
entries.text: 一群不死怪物突然出現。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A PALE FORM RISES BEFORE YOU.
entries.text: 一個蒼白的身影在你們面前升起。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A PARTY OF
entries.text: 一隊
entries.note: 遭遇敘述的片段。

entries.source: A PATROL OF GIANTS LED BY A HUMAN FIGHTER
entries.text: 一隊巨人，由一名人類戰士帶領
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。片段。

entries.source: A PATROL ROUNDS THE CORNER..
entries.text: 一支巡邏隊繞過轉角……
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: A POWERFUL ONE BECOMES AWARE OF YOUR DEEDS AND SEEKS TO DESTROY YOU.  A WEAK ONE SEES YOU AS A PATH TO POWER.
entries.text: 一位強者察覺了你們的作為，想除掉你們；一位弱者則把你們看成通往力量的路。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。算命內容。

entries.source: A PRIEST AND TWO ACOLYTES TURN FROM THE ALTER, 'WELCOME MY CHILDREN. COME FORWARD AND ACCEPT THE BLESSING OF LORD BANE.'
entries.text: 一名祭司與兩名見習僧侶從祭壇前轉過身來：「歡迎，我的孩子們。上前來，接受邪惡神的祝福。」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版把 ALTAR 拼成 ALTER。

entries.source: A RAIN OF ARROWS POURS OVER YOU.
entries.text: 一陣箭雨潑向你們。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: A ROBED ORC IS SITTING HERE. WHAT DO YOU DO?
entries.text: 一隻穿長袍的半獸人坐在這裡。你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: A ROPE IS TOSSED UP AND THE REST OF THE PARTY COMES DOWN. THE OLD THIEF SAYS 'OUR RULES REQUIRE YOU TO BE BLINDFOLDED IN OUR GUILD HOUSE, OKAY?'
entries.text: 一條繩子被拋了上來，隊伍其餘的人也下來了。那名年長的盜賊說：「按規矩，在我們公會裡各位得蒙上眼，可以吧？」
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A RUINED BALLISTA LIES HERE.
entries.text: 這裡躺著一架毀壞的弩砲。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: A SCREAMING HORDE OF KOBOLDS ATTACKS THE PARTY.
entries.text: 一大群小妖魔尖叫著撲向隊伍。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: A SCRIBE WALKS INTO THE ROOM. HE SEES YOU AND LETS OUT A GASP. HE DROPS HIS BOOKS AND RUNS OUT THE DOOR.
entries.text: 一名文書走進房裡，看到你們倒抽一口氣，丟下書就奪門而出。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: A SCYTHING BLADE DROPS ACROSS THE DOORWAY, DAMAGING ONE OF THE CHARACTERS.
entries.text: 一片鐮刀狀的刃器橫掃過門口，傷到了一名隊員。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: A SECRET DOOR IS FOUND
entries.text: 你們找到一道暗門
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: A SHARP CRACK SPLITS THE AIR AND YOU ARE STUNG.
entries.text: 空中傳來一聲脆響，你們被蟄了一下。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A SIGN ON THE NORTH DOOR READS 'FIGHTERS'.
entries.text: 北邊那道門上寫著「戰士」。
entries.note: 訓練所與競技場。

entries.source: A SIGN ON THE NORTH DOOR READS 'ROGUES'.
entries.text: 北邊那道門上寫著「盜賊」。
entries.note: 訓練所與競技場。

entries.source: A SIGN ON THE WALL DIRECTS MAGIC USERS TO GO THROUGH THE EAST DOOR AND CLERICS TO GO THROUGH THE WEST DOOR.
entries.text: 牆上的指示牌要魔法師走東門、牧師走西門。
entries.note: 訓練所與競技場。

entries.source: A SIMPLE KITCHEN, A FEW CLAY BOWLS ADORN THE FLOOR.
entries.text: 一間簡陋的廚房，地上擺著幾個陶碗。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A SKELETAL FORCE SPOTS YOU AND ATTACKS.
entries.text: 一支骷髏隊伍發現你們，攻了上來。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A SMALL ARMY OF SKELETONS RUSHES FROM THE TOWER.
entries.text: 一小支骷髏軍從塔裡衝了出來。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A SMALL CARAVAN OF SLAVERS RIDE BY YOU TOWARD THE BUCCANEER BASE.
entries.text: 一小隊奴隸販子的商隊從你們身邊經過，朝海盜的據點去。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: A SPECTRE SUDDENLY APPEARS BEFORE YOU. 'THIEF! I DEFENDED THESE BOOKS IN LIFE AND I WILL DEFEND THEM IN DEATH!' IT ATTACKS YOU.
entries.text: 一隻幽魂突然出現在你們面前：「小偷！我生前守著這些書，死後照樣守！」牠攻了過來。
entries.note: 舊繩索公會的圖書室。

entries.source: A SWARM OF STIRGES SWOOPS DOWN AND ATTACKS THE PARTY!
entries.text: 一群吸血鳥俯衝下來攻擊隊伍！
entries.note: 野外。

entries.source: A TERRIBLE WYVERN CHARGES TO ATTACK THE PARTY!
entries.text: 一頭凶惡的雙足飛龍衝上來攻擊隊伍！
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: A THICK CARPET OF FUNGUS COVERS THE FLOOR OF THIS ROOM.
entries.text: 這房間的地板上鋪著一層厚厚的真菌。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A TOWER STANDS CLEARLY ABOVE ALL CRYPTS IN THE AREA.  HUGE PILES OF HUMAN BONES ARE STREWN ABOUT.
entries.text: 一座塔明顯高過周圍所有墓室，四下散著成堆的人骨。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A TRIBE OF LIZARDMEN IS PREPARING TO JOIN THE ENEMY.  PREVENT THIS.'
entries.text: 有一支蜥蜴人部族正準備投靠敵方，阻止他們。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: A VOICE FROM THE TOWER YELLS 'STAY AWAY FROM THE WALL!'
entries.text: 塔上有人大喊：「離牆遠一點！」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A VOICE SPEAKS, 'COME, MY BRAVE ADVENTURERS.  YOU MUST TAKE MY GIFTS TO BETTER FIGHT THE EVIL THAT HAS COME TO THE CITY.'
entries.text: 一個聲音說：「來吧，勇敢的冒險者。收下我的贈禮，才好對抗降臨這座城的邪惡。」
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: A VOICE YELLS DOWN, 'WE SAID STAY AWAY FROM THE WALL. THAT INCLUDES THE TOWER!'
entries.text: 上面有人吼下來：「說了離牆遠一點，塔也一樣！」
entries.note: 史塔傑諾門一帶的事件。

entries.source: A VOLLEY OF BOULDERS ARE THROWN AT YOU...
entries.text: 一陣巨石朝你們砸來……
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: A WARNING TO AN AGENT ABOUT THE DANGERS IN THE MOUNTAINS TO THE NORTHWEST. (ENTRY 56)
entries.text: 一封給某名密探的警告，講的是西北山區的危險。（線索報導 56）
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: A WEAPON OF GREAT POWER IS TO BE AUCTIONED TO OUR ENEMIES. THIS AUCTION IS TO BE HELD IN PODAL PLAZA.  FIND OUT WHAT THE WEAPON IS AND RETURN.'
entries.text: 有一件威力強大的武器要拍賣給我們的敵人，拍賣會就辦在波多廣場。查清楚那是什麼武器，然後回報。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: A WIDE-EYED WOMAN IS SEATED ON A RUG.  AT YOUR ENTRY, SHE STANDS. 'GREETINGS BOLD ONES, I HAVE LONG AWAITED YOUR COMING.  MY TIME HERE IS SHORT FOR THE WORLD ENTERS A NEW AGE.
entries.text: 一名睜著大眼的女子坐在地毯上。你們一進門，她便站起身：「勇者們，你們好，我等候多時了。我在此的時間不多，因為世界正邁入新的紀元。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。接下一段。

entries.source: A WOMAN APPEARS BEFORE YOU.'I AM THE PRINCESS FATIMA, AID ME IN THIS BATTLE.'
entries.text: 一名女子出現在你們面前：「我是法蒂瑪公主，這一戰請助我一臂之力。」
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: A YOUNG WOMAN COMES FORWARD 'WE PROVIDE HELP FOR THOSE WHO CAN REACH US. ARE YOU IN NEED OF HEALING?
entries.text: 一名年輕女子走上前來：「凡是能來到這裡的人，我們都提供幫助。你們需要治療嗎？
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。接下一段。

entries.source: A ZOMBIE WITH GRAY, LEATHERY-HARD SKIN GAZES AT YOU WITH HATE-FILLED EYES.
entries.text: 一具皮膚灰硬如革的殭屍以充滿恨意的眼神盯著你們。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: ACCEPT BLESSING
entries.text: 接受祝福
entries.note: 遭遇選單。

entries.source: ACCEPT THE COMMISSION
entries.text: 接下委託
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: ACOLYTE
entries.text: 見習僧侶
entries.note: NPC 稱謂。

entries.source: ADD HIM TO YOUR PARTY?
entries.text: 要讓他加入隊伍嗎？
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: ADMIST THE BODIES YOU FIND SOME JEWELRY.  WILL YOU TAKE IT?
entries.text: 在屍堆裡你們找到一些首飾。要拿走嗎？
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。原版把 AMIDST 拼成 ADMIST。

entries.source: ADVANCE CAUTIOUSLY
entries.text: 小心前進
entries.note: 遭遇選單。

entries.source: ADVANCING ON YOU IS A LARGE BAND OF KOBOLDS WITH BLOOD LUST IN THEIR EYES.
entries.text: 一大群小妖魔朝你們逼近，眼裡滿是嗜血。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: AFTER DEFEATING THE FIRST WAVE OF BUCCANEERS,  YOU SEE ANOTHER WAVE FORMING IN THE DISTANCE.  WITH A LOUD ROAR THEY ATTACK YOU IN FULL FORCE.
entries.text: 打退第一波海盜後，你們看到遠處又集結了一波。他們一聲怒吼，全力攻了上來。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: AFTER DEFEATING THE LAST OF THE BUCCANNEERS THE REST SURRENDER OR FLEE.  YOU RESCUE THE SLAVES AND CAPTURE THE FORT.
entries.text: 打倒最後一批海盜後，其餘的不是投降就是逃走。你們救出奴隸，占下了這座堡壘。
entries.note: 海盜據點。原版把 BUCCANEERS 拼成 BUCCANNEERS。

entries.source: AFTER DEFEATING THE LAST, WAVE YOU SEE ANOTHER WAVE ATTACK FROM THE SOUTH OF THE COMPOUND.
entries.text: 打退前一波之後，你們看到又一波從營區南邊攻了上來。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。原版逗號位置有誤。

entries.source: AFTER HEARING YOUR APOLOGY THE DRAGON SAYS, 'THOUGH YOU ARE FOOLISH I BELIEVE YOUR ACTS ARE NOBLE.  I WILL HELP YOU WITH YOUR QUEST TO CLEANSE THE CITY OF PHLAN FROM EVIL.'
entries.text: 聽了你們的道歉，那條龍說：「你們雖然愚蠢，我相信你們的作為是高尚的。我會協助你們把菲蘭城的邪惡清乾淨。」
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。

entries.source: AFTER IT IS DONE, IT LEAVES.
entries.text: 說完牠便離開了。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: AFTER KILLING THE COMMANDANT THE REST OF THE OUTPOST EITHER SURRENDERS OR RUNS AWAY.
entries.text: 指揮官一死，前哨其餘的人不是投降就是逃走。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: AFTER RECOVERING FROM THE FIREBALL YOU SEARCH THE REST OF THE LAIR AND FIND NOTHING OF INTREST.
entries.text: 從火球的衝擊中緩過來後，你們搜遍巢穴其餘的地方，沒發現什麼值得一提的。
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。原版把 INTEREST 拼成 INTREST。

entries.source: AFTER SAYING NO, THE RIDERS RETURN TO THE OUTPOST.  BEFORE LEAVING, THEIR LEADER SAYS, 'YOU ARE TRESSPASSING ON PRIVATE LAND.  I ADVISE YOU TO LEAVE.'
entries.text: 你們否認後，那些騎兵便返回前哨。臨走前領頭的說：「你們擅闖私人領地，我勸你們離開。」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。原版把 TRESPASSING 拼成 TRESSPASSING。

entries.source: AFTER SKIMMING THROUGH THE PAPERS THE COMMANDANT SAYS, 'I WELCOME YOU AND HOPE YOU WILL JOIN ME FOR DINNER TONIGHT.'  HE TELLS A GUARD TO GIVE YOU A TOUR OF THE OUTPOST.
entries.text: 指揮官草草翻過文件後說：「歡迎各位，也希望今晚能一起用餐。」他吩咐一名守衛帶你們參觀前哨。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: AFTER SPEAKING, THE DRAGON FLYS THROUGH AN OPENNING IN THE CEILING OF THE CAVE.  YOU EXIT THE CAVE TO CONTINUE YOUR QUEST.
entries.text: 說完，那條龍從洞頂的開口飛了出去。你們走出洞穴，繼續踏上旅程。
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。原版把 FLIES 拼成 FLYS、OPENING 拼成 OPENNING。

entries.source: AFTER THE PARTY ENTERS THE ROOM A NET LACED WITH SHARP BLADES FALLS ON THE PARTY.
entries.text: 隊伍進房之後，一張綴滿利刃的網從上頭罩了下來。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: AFTER YOU DEFEAT THE GUARDS YOU SEE A CROWD HAS FORMED.  FROM WITHIN THE CROWD A LARGE MAN IN GLEAMING CHAIN MAIL STEPS OUT.  HE SAYS 'THAT WAS AMUSING BUT DO NOT CAUSE ANYMORE TROUBLE!'
entries.text: 你們打倒守衛後，四周已聚了一群人。人群中走出一名身穿亮甲的高大男子：「這場面挺有趣，但別再惹事了！」
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: AFTER YOU RELEASE HIM THE THIEF SLOWLY WALKS TOWARD THE FAR DOOR THANKING YOU ALL THE WAY.  PARTWAY THROUGH THE DOOR HE SAYS, 'SUCKERS', THEN SPRINTS AWAY.
entries.text: 你們放他走後，那名盜賊一路道謝，慢慢走向遠處那道門。走到一半他丟下一句「蠢蛋」，拔腿就跑。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: AGREE
entries.text: 答應
entries.note: 遭遇選單。

entries.source: AHEAD OF YOU IS A MOAT FILLED WITH SLUDGE AND THORNS. YOU CANNOT PROCEED BECAUSE THE MUD WOULD SURELY DRAG YOU DOWN TO YOUR DEATH.
entries.text: 前方是一條滿是爛泥與荊棘的護城河。過不去——那些泥必定會把你們拖下去淹死。
entries.note: 沼澤中的廢棄城堡，挪里斯的盜匪團。

entries.source: ALL AROUND THE TOWER, PILES OF HAIR AND FUR COVER THE AREA.
entries.text: 塔的四周堆滿了毛髮與獸皮。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: ALL THE NOMADS HOLD THEIR SWORDS AT THE READY, WATCHING YOU WARILY. MORE NOMADS APPEAR FROM OUT OF TENTS IN THE CAMP.
entries.text: 所有遊牧民都按著刀戒備地盯著你們，營地的帳篷裡還不斷有人出來。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: AMBUSH AND KILL HIM
entries.text: 伏擊殺了他
entries.note: 遭遇選單。

entries.source: AMBUSH AND TIE HIM UP
entries.text: 伏擊並把他綁起來
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: AMID THE LITTER OF THE ROOM YOU SEE A DULL BROWN REPTILIAN MONSTER.
entries.text: 在滿地雜物之間，你們看到一隻暗褐色的爬蟲怪物。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: AMID THE TRASH YOU FIND A BOX WHICH CONTAINS GOLD FOIL.
entries.text: 你們在垃圾堆裡找到一個裝著金箔的盒子。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: AMID THEIR PROTESTS YOU TIE THEM UP. THESE PROTESTS DIMINSH IN VOLUME AS YOU GAG THE WOMEN AND HIDE THEM IN A CORNER.
entries.text: 你們在她們的抗議聲中把人綁了起來。塞住嘴、藏進角落之後，抗議聲也小了下去。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版把 DIMINISH 拼成 DIMINSH。

entries.source: AMONG THE PAPERS ON THE DESK YOU FIND THE FOLLOWING AND SLIP THEM INTO YOUR JOURNAL:
entries.text: 你們在桌上的文件裡找到下面這些，把它們夾進手冊：
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: AMONGST A NEST OF LOGS YOU FIND SOME TREASURE.
entries.text: 在一堆交錯的原木間，你們找到一些財寶。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: AN ABANDONED SHOP. BROKEN SHELVES ARE ALL THAT REMAIN.
entries.text: 一間廢棄的店鋪，只剩下斷裂的貨架。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: AN AGED PRIEST APPROACHES, POINTING AT THE MAD MAN, HE SPEAKS, 'THAT MAN URGENTLY NEEDS OUR CARE.  DROP HIM FROM YOUR PARTY OR HE WILL BRING YOU TO GRIEF.  WE WILL CARE FOR HIM.'
entries.text: 一位年長的僧侶走過來，指著那個瘋子說：「那個人急需我們照料。把他從隊伍裡放掉吧，不然他會給你們惹禍。我們會照顧他。」
entries.note: 瘋子事件。

entries.source: AN ALARM GOES OFF IN THE DISTANCE.
entries.text: 遠處警報響起。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: AN ALARM GOES OFF IN THE DISTANCE.  YOUR ONLY HOPE IS TO RUN FOR THE FRONT GATE.
entries.text: 遠處警報響起。你們唯一的指望就是衝向前門。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: AN ALARM IS SOUNDING.
entries.text: 警報響了。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: AN ALARM STARTS RINGING!
entries.text: 警報大作！
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: AN ANCIENT MAGE LOOKS UP FROM HIS STUDIES, 'AH, GOOD, I NEED MORE SPECIMENS AS CONTROLS.' HE TURNS TO HIS MUTATED GUARDS, 'SUBDUE THEM!'
entries.text: 一名年邁的法師從研究中抬起頭：「啊，正好，我還缺幾個對照組的樣本。」他轉向那些變異的守衛：「拿下他們！」
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: AN AWFUL STENCH IS COMING FROM THE WEST.
entries.text: 西邊飄來一陣惡臭。
entries.note: 野外。

entries.source: AN EVIL SPIRIT FROM AN UNHOLY POOL GUIDES YOUR ENEMIES. IT HIDES BEHIND A FAIR COUNTENANCE. BE NOT DECEIVED.' WITH THAT, THE WOMAN IS GONE.
entries.text: 一個來自不潔之池的邪靈在指引你們的敵人。它藏在一副美好的面容之後。莫要受騙。」話音一落，那女子便消失了。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: AN OFFICER LOOKS AT YOU, 'WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE?'
entries.text: 一名軍官看向你們：「你們在這裡做什麼？」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: AN OLD LIZARDMAN APPEARS BEFORE YOU, HAND RAISED IN A GESTURE OF PEACE.
entries.text: 一名年老的蜥蜴人出現在你們面前，舉起手做出示好的姿勢。
entries.note: 沼澤的蜥蜴人部族。

entries.source: AN OLD THIEF STANDS HERE.'WELCOME TO MY GUILD. I AM RESTAL.' HE BOWS LOW.
entries.text: 一名年長的盜賊站在這裡：「歡迎來到我的公會。我是雷斯托。」他深深一鞠躬。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。Restal 為新增譯名。

entries.source: AN UNDEAD PATROL CONFRONTS YOU.  DO YOU GIVE THE PASSWORD?
entries.text: 一支不死怪物的巡邏隊攔住你們。要說出通關密語嗎？
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: AN UNSENT REPLY TO THIS LETTER. (ENTRY 49)
entries.text: 這封信一封沒寄出的回信。（線索報導 49）
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: AND DEMAND, 'WHO ARE YOU?'
entries.text: 並喝問：「你們是誰？」
entries.note: 片段。

entries.source: AND ITS RETAINERS.
entries.text: 和牠的隨從。
entries.note: 遭遇敘述的片段。

entries.source: AND WALK ON.
entries.text: 然後繼續走。
entries.note: 遭遇敘述的片段。

entries.source: AND YELL 'SETTLERS! KILL THEM!'
entries.text: 然後大喊：「移民！殺了他們！」
entries.note: 片段。

entries.source: AND YOU FIND A SWORD!
entries.text: 你們找到一把劍！
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: ANHKHEG
entries.text: 掘地蟲
entries.note: 怪物名，原版拼作 ANHKHEG（一般作 Ankheg）。

entries.source: ANIMALS ARE RUNNING ALL OVER THE COMPOUND.
entries.text: 牲口在營區裡四處亂竄。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: ANOTHER PIPE, RUNNING FROM THE WALL ACROSS AND TO YOUR RIGHT, PUMPS IN STREAMS OF THE FOUL LIQUID. ALL ABOUT THE ROOM ARE VALVES, GAUGES, PETCOCKS, AND PIPES.
entries.text: 另一條管線從牆邊橫過來、通向你們右手邊，不斷灌入那種惡臭的液體。屋裡到處是閥門、量表、旋塞與管路。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: ANOTHER WAVE OF MEN ATTACK YOU.
entries.text: 又一波人攻了上來。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: APOLOGIZE
entries.text: 道歉
entries.note: 遭遇選單。

entries.source: APPROACH
entries.text: 靠近
entries.note: 遭遇選單。

entries.source: ARE YOU GOING TO TALK ABOUT NEW OR OLD PHLAN?
entries.text: 你們要談新菲蘭城還是舊菲蘭城？
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS HE COMES THROUGH THE DOOR YOU KNOCK HIM OUT AND DRAG HIS FORM INTO A CORNER.
entries.text: 他一走進門就被你們打昏，屍身被拖進角落。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS HE COMES THROUGH THE DOOR YOU SLIT HIS THROAT. THE BODY IS DRAGGED INTO A CORNER.
entries.text: 他一走進門，喉嚨就被你們割開。屍體被拖進角落。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS NIGHT FALLS, THE NOMADS BUILD A HUGE CAMPFIRE IN THE CENTER OF THE CAMP. THE WHOLE TRIBE GATHERS FOR THE FEAST. AFTER THE FEAST THERE IS DANCING AND WILD CELEBRATIONS.
entries.text: 入夜後，遊牧民在營地中央升起一堆大火，全族聚來赴宴。宴罷是舞蹈與盡情的慶祝。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: AS SOON AS YOU OPEN THE GATE THE ANIMALS INSIDE CHARGE OUT.  THEY STAMPEDE ACROSS THE COMPOUND.
entries.text: 門一打開，裡面的牲口就衝了出來，在營區裡狂奔亂竄。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: AS THE GIANT TURNS IN TRIUMPH TO HIS COMPANIONS, THE OTHERS PICK UP THEIR CLUBS. 'WHAT THEY KNOW? WE KNOCK DUMB LITTLE MEN'S BRAINS OUT!'
entries.text: 那名巨人得意地轉向同伴，其餘的抄起了棍棒：「他們懂什麼？把這些笨小人的腦漿打出來！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版用不標準的口語。

entries.source: AS THE OTHER GIANTS BURST INTO HOWLS OF LAUGHTER THE ONE WHO TALKED TO YOU TURNS RED AND SAYS, 'YOU LIE! YOU LIE TO MAKE ME FOOL! I SMASH YOU!'
entries.text: 其他巨人爆出一陣狂笑，剛才跟你們說話的那個臉都紅了：「你們騙人！騙我出醜！我砸扁你們！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS YOU APPROACH HER HAIR BRISTLES AND SHE ATTACKS!
entries.text: 你們一走近，她便毛髮倒豎，撲了上來！
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS YOU APPROACH THE CAPTAIN'S QUARTERS THE ELITE GUARDS SOUND AN ALARM AND GUARDS RUSH FORTH AND ATTACK.
entries.text: 你們一靠近隊長的住處，精銳守衛就拉響警報，守衛蜂擁而上。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: AS YOU APPROACH THE KEEP, A GROUP OF ARMED MEN ON HORESBACK RIDE OUT TO MEET YOU.  THEIR LEADER SAYS 'YOU ARE TRESSPASSING ON PRIVATE LAND; LEAVE NOW OR FACE THE CONSQUENCES!'
entries.text: 你們接近城堡時，一隊武裝騎兵出來迎面攔住：「你們擅闖私人領地，現在就走，否則後果自負！」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。原版把 HORSEBACK 拼成 HORESBACK、CONSEQUENCES 拼成 CONSQUENCES。

entries.source: AS YOU APPROACH THEY MOVE, ALLOWING YOU ENTRANCE INTO THE TEMPLE.
entries.text: 你們一走近，牠們就讓開，放你們進神廟。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: AS YOU ARE ENTERING THE CAVE, A MAGIC MOUTH APPEARS ON ONE OF THE WALLS.  IN A BOOMING VOICE IT SAYS, 'WHO ENTERS THE HOME OF DIOGENES?  SPEAK NOW AND DECLARE YOUR INTENT!'
entries.text: 你們正要進洞，牆上浮現一張魔法之口，以洪亮的嗓音說：「是誰踏進狄奧根尼斯的居所？現在就報上來意！」
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。

entries.source: AS YOU ARE POKING AROUND IN THE VATS, A PAIN CRAZED LIZARD MAN SURFACES AND ATTACKS YOU! TWO OTHERS QUICKLY JOIN HIM FROM OTHER VATS.
entries.text: 你們在缸裡翻找時，一名痛得發狂的蜥蜴人破水而出撲向你們！另外兩缸也隨即冒出兩名。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: AS YOU ATTEMPT TO DEACTIVATE THE TRAP YOU SET IT OFF.  A POSIONED NEEDLE SHOOTS OUT AND PLUNGES INTO A PARTY MEMBER.
entries.text: 你們試著解除陷阱卻反而觸發了它，一根毒針射出，扎進一名隊員身上。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。原版此處把 POISONED 拼成 POSIONED。

entries.source: AS YOU ATTEMPT TO DISARM THE TRAP, IT GOES OFF IN YOUR FACE!  A CLOUD OF POISONOUS YELLOW GAS FILLS THE ROOM.
entries.text: 你們試圖解除陷阱，它卻當面炸開！一團黃色毒氣充滿整個房間。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: AS YOU BACK AWAY AGAIN THE OLD BLIND ORC IS CONVINCED YOU ARE NOT WORSHIPPERS.  HE GRUNTS AN ORDER TO ATTACK.
entries.text: 你們再度後退，那隻盲眼老半獸人確信你們不是信徒，低吼一聲下令攻擊。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: AS YOU BACK AWAY THE BLIND ORC SAYS, 'I MUST CHECK IF YOU ARE WORTHY TO ENTER THE TEMPLE OF BANE, DO NEED NOT BE AFRAID.'
entries.text: 你們一後退，那隻盲眼半獸人說：「我得檢查你們配不配進邪惡神廟，不必怕。」
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。原版此處語句本身就不通（DO NEED NOT BE AFRAID）。

entries.source: AS YOU BREAK THROUGH THE DOOR INTO A WELL FITTED APARTMENT, TWO GIANTS COME LUMBERING UP TO YOU. YOU TURN TO FACE THEM.
entries.text: 你們破門進入一間陳設講究的居室，兩名巨人笨重地走了過來。你們轉身迎戰。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS YOU CAREFULLY SEARCH THE ROOM YOU FEEL A STRANGE TINGLE AS YOU GET CLOSE TO A BARE AREA.
entries.text: 你們仔細搜索房間，靠近一塊空無一物的地方時，感到一陣奇異的刺麻。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: AS YOU DEFEAT THE GUARDS SOME MORE MEN RUN IN AND ATTACK.
entries.text: 你們打倒守衛後，又有人衝進來攻擊。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS YOU DESTROY THE ALTAR, THE TEMPLE DOORS FLY OPEN AND A SCREAMING HORDE OF ORCS LED BY A HALF-ORC CLERIC ATTACK.  YOU TURN TO FACE THEM.
entries.text: 你們一搗毀祭壇，神廟大門猛地打開，一群尖叫的半獸人由一名半獸人牧師率領撲了進來。你們轉身迎戰。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: AS YOU DON'T ANSWER THE LAST QUESTION THE COMMANDANT SMILES SLIGHTLY AND SAYS, 'I SEE THAT YOU ARE NOT FOOLISH AND LOOSE TONGUED.'
entries.text: 你們沒回答上一個問題，指揮官微微一笑：「看來各位不是嘴上沒把門的傻子。」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS YOU ENTER THE BUILDING YOU SEE A LARGE GROUP OF FOUL ORCS.  THEY SNARL AT YOU AND ATTACK!
entries.text: 你們一走進建築就看到一大群骯髒的半獸人。牠們朝你們咆哮，撲了上來！
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: AS YOU ENTER THE BUILDING YOU SEE A LARGE GROUP OF ORCS WHO ARE SURPRISED THAT YOU'RE HERE.  WITH CONFUSED LOOKS ON THEIR FACES THEY STARE AT YOU
entries.text: 你們一走進建築，就看到一大群半獸人。牠們沒料到你們會來，一臉困惑地盯著你們
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。片段。

entries.source: AS YOU ENTER THE CAVE YOU ARE GREETED BY DIOGENES, THE SILVER DRAGON.  HE SAYS 'I SEE YOU HAVE RECOVERED THE SILVER BOTTLE FROM THE KOBOLD CAVES.  I CONGRADULATE YOU.'
entries.text: 你們一進洞，銀龍狄奧根尼斯便迎了上來：「看來你們把銀瓶從小妖魔的洞裡取回來了。恭喜。」
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。Diogenes 為新增譯名；原版把 CONGRATULATE 拼成 CONGRADULATE。

entries.source: AS YOU ENTER THE ROOM A THIEF WITH A SWORD COMES OUT OF NOWHERE
entries.text: 你們一走進房間，一名持劍的盜賊憑空冒出來
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。接下一段。

entries.source: AS YOU ENTER THE ROOM TWO THIEVES COME OUT OF NOWHERE AND ATTACK THE PARTY.  THEY FAIL MISERABLY AND RUN OUT THE EAST DOOR.  WILL YOU CHASE THEM?
entries.text: 你們一進房，兩名盜賊憑空冒出來偷襲，卻慘敗而逃，往東門跑了。要追嗎？
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: AS YOU ENTER THE ROOM YOU ARE AMBUSHED BY SOME THIEVES.
entries.text: 你們一走進房間就被幾名盜賊伏擊。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: AS YOU ENTER THE ROOM YOU SEE FOUR KOBOLDS CHAINED TO THE WALL.  ONE OF THEM SAYS 'RELEASE US, OR THE LIZARD MEN WILL EAT US!'  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們一進屋，看見四隻小妖魔被鎖鏈拴在牆上。其中一隻說：「放了我們，不然蜥蜴人會把我們吃掉！」你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: AS YOU ENTER THE ROOM YOU SEE SIX ORCS LED BY A LARGE OGRE.  THEY LUNGE FOWARD AND ATTACK.
entries.text: 你們一進房就看到六隻半獸人，由一隻高大的食人鬼帶領。牠們撲上前來攻擊。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。原版把 FORWARD 拼成 FOWARD。

entries.source: AS YOU ENTER THE ROOM YOU SEE SOME SLEEPING GIANTS.
entries.text: 你們一進房就看到幾名熟睡的巨人。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS YOU ENTER THIS ROOM THE TWO THIEVES SPLIT; ONE GOING THROUGH THE EAST DOOR, THE OTHER GOING THROUGH THE SOUTH.  WHICH PATH WILL YOU TAKE?
entries.text: 你們一進房，兩名盜賊便分頭逃走，一個走東門，一個走南門。要追哪一邊？
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: AS YOU EXAMINE THE CASKET A TRAP GOES OFF.  A DART SHOOTS OUT AND HITS ONE OF THE PARTY MEMBERS.
entries.text: 你們查看小箱時觸動了陷阱，一支飛鏢射出來，打中一名隊員。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: AS YOU EXIT THE TEMPLE YOU ARE ATTACKED BY A VERY LARGE GROUP OF ORCS.  LEADING THEM IS A HALF-ORC WHO IS SCREAMING 'KILL!  KILL, THE UNBELIEVING TOADS.  KILL THEM OR SUFFER MY WRATH!'
entries.text: 你們走出神廟時遭到一大群半獸人攻擊，領頭的半獸人尖叫著：「殺！殺了這些不信神的癩蛤蟆。殺了他們，不然就等著承受我的怒火！」
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: AS YOU FREE THEM THEY TELL YOU ALL ABOUT WHAT YARASH IS DOING AND HOW YOU CAN GET HELP FROM THEIR TRIBE IN THE SWAMP. YOU COPY ALL THEY SAY AS ENTRY 35 OF YOUR JOURNAL.
entries.text: 你們鬆開牠們的鎖鏈，牠們便把亞拉斯的所作所為，以及如何向沼澤裡的族人求援，一五一十說了出來。你們把這些全抄進手冊，成為線索報導 35。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: AS YOU HIKE THROUGH THE MOUNTAINS YOU SEE A LARGE CAVE.
entries.text: 你們在山間跋涉時看到一個大洞穴。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS YOU HIKE THROUGH THE MOUNTAINS, A LARGE DRAGON FLYS ABOVE YOU.  IT CIRCLES THEN SWOOPS DOWN AND LANDS IN FRONT OF A CAVE.  IT DISAPPEARS INTO A CAVE.
entries.text: 你們在山間跋涉時，一條大龍從頭頂掠過。牠盤旋一圈後俯衝而下，落在一個洞穴前，隨即沒入洞中。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。原版把 FLIES 拼成 FLYS。

entries.source: AS YOU LEAVE THE SORCERER'S PYRAMID BEHIND YOU CAN SEE THAT THE LAND IS ALREADY BEGINNING TO RECOVER FROM THE ALCHEMICAL POLLUTION CAUSED BY THE PYRAMID.
entries.text: 把巫師的金字塔拋在身後時，你們看得出這片土地已經開始從它造成的煉金污染中復原。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: AS YOU MENTION POLITICS THE COMMANDANT SAYS 'I'VE HEARD THAT PHLAN'S TOWN COUNCIL IS CORRUPT, SPECIFICALLY ULRICH EBERHARD.  IS THIS TRUE?
entries.text: 你們一提到政治，指揮官便說：「我聽說菲蘭城的市議會貪腐，尤其是亞爾瑞屈·艾伯哈德。是真的嗎？
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。接下一段。

entries.source: AS YOU MENTION THE POOL OF RADIANCE THE COMMANDANT TELLS YOU A STORY ABOUT THAT VERY POOL.  YOU ENJOY THE STORY AND COPY IT INTO YOUR JOURNAL UNDER ENTRY 46.
entries.text: 你們一提到光芒之池，指揮官便說了一個關於那池子的故事。你們聽得津津有味，把它抄進手冊，成為線索報導 46。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS YOU MOVE AWAY THE MONSTERS GLANCE YOUR WAY,
entries.text: 你們走開時，怪物瞥了你們一眼，
entries.note: 片段。

entries.source: AS YOU MOVE THROUGH THE GARDEN
entries.text: 你們穿過花園時
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。片段。

entries.source: AS YOU MOVE THROUGH THE ROOM THERE IS A FLASH AND YOU SUDDENLY FIND YOURSELF ELSEWHERE.
entries.text: 你們走過房間時眼前一閃，人忽然到了別的地方。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: AS YOU MOVE THROUGH THE ROOM THERE IS A FLASH, AND YOU SUDDENLY FIND YOURSELVES ELSEWHERE.
entries.text: 你們走過房間時眼前一閃，一行人忽然到了別的地方。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: AS YOU MOVE YOU OVERHEAR SOME
entries.text: 你們走著走著，聽見一些
entries.note: 片段。

entries.source: AS YOU NEAR THE PILE OF WEAPONS AN AWFUL SMELLING CLOUD OF GAS FORMS.  THIS FOUL SMELLING GAS STUNS THE PARTY ALLOWING A GROUP OF THIEVES TO JUMP OUT OF THE SHADOWS AND ATTACK AT WILL!
entries.text: 你們一靠近那堆武器，一團惡臭的氣體便升起。臭氣把隊伍薰得動彈不得，一群盜賊趁機從暗處撲出來，任意攻擊！
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: AS YOU NEAR THE PILE OF WEAPONS AN EXTREMELY BAD SMELLING GAS FILLS THE ROOM.  THE SMELL IS DISGUSTING BUT HARMLESS ENOUGH.
entries.text: 你們一靠近那堆武器，房裡就充滿一股極難聞的氣體。臭歸臭，倒是無害。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: AS YOU OPEN THE DOOR A BUCKET OF SAND THAT WAS PROPPED ABOVE THE DOOR FALLS.
entries.text: 你們一開門，架在門上的一桶沙就翻了下來。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS YOU PULL, THE STOPPER COMES LOOSE AND SMOKE BILLOWS OUT, FORMING INTO A GIANT, REDDISH HUMANOID.
entries.text: 你們一拉，瓶塞鬆脫，煙霧滾滾湧出，凝成一個巨大的赤紅人形。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: AS YOU PUSH THE DOOR OPEN THE CEILING CAVES IN.
entries.text: 你們一推開門，天花板就塌了下來。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS YOU QUICKLY LEAVE THE ROOM, YOU HEAR ONE OF THE GIANTS SAY, 'AH, US RIGHT. THEM JUST AFRAID TO SAY 'CAUSE KNOW YOU SMASH 'EM.' THE ARGUMENT RESUMES.
entries.text: 你們匆匆離開時，聽見一名巨人說：「啊，我們是對的。他們只是不敢講，怕被你砸扁。」爭論又繼續下去。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版用不標準的口語。

entries.source: AS YOU READY YOUR WEAPONS TO ATTACK.  THE DRAGON TAKES FLIGHT AND ROARS, 'EVIL CREATURES, BEGONE FROM MY LAIR.'  HE THEN FLIES UP THROUGH A HOLE IN THE CEILING.
entries.text: 你們正舉起武器要動手，那條龍便振翅而起，怒吼：「邪惡的生物，滾出我的巢穴。」隨即從天花板的洞飛了出去。
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。

entries.source: AS YOU SEARCH THE BEDS A GROUP OF ORCS COMES INTO THE ROOM.  THEY ATTACK IMMEDIATELY.
entries.text: 你們正在搜床鋪，一群半獸人走進房裡，立刻發動攻擊。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: AS YOU SEARCH THE CASKET YOU TRIGGER A TRAP.  FROM A SECRET COMPARTMENT IN THE WALL, A SHOWER OF DARTS RAINS DOWN UPON THE PARTY.
entries.text: 你們搜小箱時觸發了陷阱，牆上的暗格射出一陣飛鏢，如雨般落在隊伍身上。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: AS YOU SEARCH THE CASKET, YOU ACCIDENTLY SET OFF A TRAP.  A NOXIOUS POWDER SPRAYS INTO THE AIR DAMAGING THE PARTY.
entries.text: 你們搜小箱時不慎觸動陷阱，一股毒粉噴散開來，傷到了隊伍。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: AS YOU SEARCH THE ROOM YOU SCAN RANDOM BOOKS.
entries.text: 你們搜房間時隨手翻了幾本書。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: AS YOU SEARCH THROUGH THE WRECKED SMITHY, YOU FIND THAT TIME HAS CRUMBLED EVERYTHING WITH THE EXCEPTION OF ONE OLD HAMMER.
entries.text: 你們在毀壞的鐵匠鋪裡翻找，發現時間已把一切化為碎屑，只剩一柄舊鐵鎚。
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: AS YOU SLICE THROUGH SOMEONE IS PRICKED BY A THORN.
entries.text: 你們一路砍過去，有人被荊棘扎到。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS YOU SNEAK TOWARD THEM A LOOSE BOARD CREAKS. THE GIANTS GET TO THEIR FEET SHAKING THE SLEEP FROM THEIR EYES.
entries.text: 你們潛行過去時踩到一塊鬆動的木板，發出吱嘎聲。巨人紛紛起身，把睡意甩開。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS YOU START TO ATTACK HIM, FOUR GIANTS BURST OUT OF A NEARBY BUILDING.
entries.text: 你們正要動手，四名巨人就從附近的建築衝了出來。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS YOU TALK ABOUT NEW PHLAN THE COMMANDANT LISTENS CAREFULLY.  THE COMMANDANT SAYS 'IS IT TRUE THAT THE REAL POWER IN NEW PHLAN IS BISHOP BRACCIO?'
entries.text: 你們談起新菲蘭城，指揮官聽得仔細，然後問：「新菲蘭城真正掌權的是巴西歐主教，這是真的嗎？」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS YOU TALK ABOUT OLD PHLAN'S INHABITANTS THE COMMANDANT SAYS 'I KNOW A LEGEND ABOUT A FIRE BEING CALLED TIRANTIKUS.  I BELIEVE, THAT TIRANTIKUS AND TYRANTHRAXUS ARE ONE AND THE SAME'.
entries.text: 你們談起舊菲蘭城的住民，指揮官說：「我知道一則關於火之存在提蘭提庫斯的傳說。我相信提蘭提庫斯和泰蘭特拉克斯是同一個。」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。Tirantikus 為新增譯名。

entries.source: AS YOU TRY TO DEACTIVATE THE TRAP YOU MANAGE TO SET IT OFF.  A LARGE NEEDLE SHOOTS OUT OF A HIDDEN COMPARTMENT HITTING A PARTY MEMBER.
entries.text: 你們想解除陷阱，結果反而讓它啟動了。一根大針從暗格射出，扎中一名隊員。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: AS YOU WALK INTO THIS ROOM A GIANT SNAKE FALLS ON TOP OF THE PARTY.
entries.text: 你們一走進這房間，一條巨蛇就落到隊伍身上。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: AS YOU WALK THROUGH THE TRESS YOU ARE AMBUSHED BY TWO DISPLACER BEASTS.
entries.text: 你們穿過林間時，兩頭移位獸從旁伏擊。
entries.note: 野外。原版把 TREES 拼成 TRESS。

entries.source: AS YOU WALK THROUGH THIS AREA TWO ANHKHEGS ERUPT FROM THE GROUND BENEATH YOU.
entries.text: 你們走過這一帶時，兩隻掘地蟲從腳下的地裡竄了出來。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: ASIDE FROM A LAYER OF MUD, YOU DON'T FIND ANYTHING.
entries.text: 除了一層爛泥，什麼也沒找到。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: ASK DRAGON FOR ADVICE
entries.text: 向那條龍請教
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: ASK FOR MORE MONEY
entries.text: 要求加價
entries.note: 遭遇選單。

entries.source: AT DUSK A GUARD COMES BY TO ESCORT YOU TO DINNER.
entries.text: 黃昏時一名守衛過來領你們去用晚餐。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: AT THE BOTTOM THE KOBOLD DIVES BENEATH SOME RUBBLE.
entries.text: 到了底下，那隻小妖魔鑽進一堆瓦礫底下。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: AT THE END OF THE PASSAGEWAY ARE THREE LARGE WILD BOARS.  THEY CHARGE AT YOU AND ATTACK!
entries.text: 通道盡頭有三頭大野豬，牠們朝你們衝了過來！
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: AT THE SAME TIME GIANT LIZARDS CHARGE OUT OF HIDDEN TUNNELS.
entries.text: 同時，巨蜥從隱密的隧道裡衝了出來。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: AT YOUR ENTRY, THE COUNCIL CLERK BEGINS LOOKING THROUGH A STACK OF PAPERS.  'BEFORE I CAN OFFER ANY COMMISSIONS, I MUST SEE IF YOU ARE DUE A CURRENT REWARD.
entries.text: 你們一進門，議會書記官便開始翻一疊文件：「在談委託之前，我得先看看你們有沒有該領的報酬。
entries.note: 接下一段。

entries.source: ATOP A SMALL BONE ALTAR, STANDS AN ANCIENT, HOBGOBLIN. SHE SCREAMS 'I AM THE MIGHTY GRISHNAK! YOU HAVE INTERRUPTED MY UNHOLY RITES! FEEL MY INFERNAL WRATH!'
entries.text: 一座小小的骨製祭壇上站著一隻蒼老的大哥布林。她尖叫：「我是偉大的格里希納克！你們打斷了我的邪穢儀式！嘗嘗我地獄般的怒火！」
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: ATTACK
entries.text: 攻擊
entries.note: 遭遇選單，出現 32 次。

entries.source: ATTACK AS THEY SLEEP
entries.text: 趁睡著時偷襲
entries.note: 遭遇選單。

entries.source: ATTACK GUARDS
entries.text: 攻擊守衛
entries.note: 遭遇選單。

entries.source: ATTACK GUARDS.
entries.text: 攻擊守衛。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: ATTACK HER
entries.text: 攻擊她
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: ATTACK HIM
entries.text: 攻擊他
entries.note: 遭遇選單。

entries.source: ATTACK IT
entries.text: 攻擊牠
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: ATTACK YOU IMMEDIATELY!
entries.text: 立刻攻擊你們！
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。片段。

entries.source: AVERAGE
entries.text: 中等
entries.note: 同上。

entries.source: AVOID TRAP
entries.text: 避開陷阱
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: B
entries.text: 乙
entries.note: 同上。

entries.source: BACK OFF
entries.text: 退開
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: BACK OFF AGAIN
entries.text: 再退開
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: BANDITS
entries.text: 盜匪
entries.note: 野外。

entries.source: BAY
entries.text: 海灣
entries.note: 港務長航線選項。

entries.source: BEAUTIFUL STOJANOW RIVER.
entries.text: 美麗的史塔傑諾河。
entries.note: 地點敘述；河名依 glossary。

entries.source: BEFORE HE CAN ATTACK THE OTHERS GRAB HIM AND SAY, 'YOU BETTER GO LITTLE MEN.
entries.text: 他還來不及動手就被其他人拉住：「小傢伙們，你們最好快走。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。接下一段。

entries.source: BEFORE I LEAVE LET ME HELP YOU AS BEST I CAN.' HE TAKES A SLIP OF PAPER FROM THE POUCH OF THE DEAD GNOLL. 'HERE, YOU WILL NEED THIS.'
entries.text: 走之前讓我盡力幫你們一把。」他從那隻死去豺狼人的袋子裡抽出一張紙條：「拿去，你們會用得上。」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。承接上一段。

entries.source: BEFORE THE CLERIC'S SPELLS INADVERTENTLY BOUND THEM TO THIS PLACE. ONE SPIRIT'S VOICE RISES ABOVE THE REST, 'AN ACCOUNT OF OUR TRIALS IS WITHIN THE DIARY.' HE POINTS TO A FLOORBOARD.
entries.text: 後來那位僧侶的法術無意間把他們縛在了這裡。一個亡魂的聲音蓋過其他：「我們的遭遇都寫在那本日記裡。」他指了指一塊地板。
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。承接上一段。

entries.source: BEFORE THE GATE YOU CAN MAKE OUT A MAN WITH A WAGON OF GOODS WHO IS TALKING TO TWO OF THE BUGBEARS. THE MAN HANDS SOMETHING TO THE BUGBEARS AND THE GATES OPEN.
entries.text: 門前有個趕著貨車的人正和兩隻熊地精說話。那人遞了什麼東西過去，門就開了。
entries.note: 史塔傑諾門一帶的事件。

entries.source: BEFORE THEY CAN RETURN TO THE WATER YOU ENGAGE THEM. THEY TURN AND FIGHT FANATICALLY.
entries.text: 牠們還來不及回到水裡就被你們纏上，只得回身死戰。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: BEFORE YOU ARE THREE THRI-KREEN WARRIORS.  THEY ATTACK YOU IMMEDIATELY.
entries.text: 你們面前是三名昆蟲人戰士，牠們立刻發動攻擊。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: BEFORE YOU CAN REACT THEY TURN AND DIVE BACK INTO THE WATER.
entries.text: 你們還來不及反應，牠們就轉身潛回水裡。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: BEFORE YOU IS A GREAT HALL.  THE FLOOR IS LITTERED WITH ORC TRASH AND THE WALLS HAVE CRUDE BLACK HANDS PAINTED ON THEM.
entries.text: 你們面前是一座大廳，地上滿是半獸人的垃圾，牆上畫著粗糙的黑手。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: BEFORE YOU IS A HORDE OF KOBOLDS. BEHIND THEM ARE TWO MEN AND AN ANCIENT KOBOLD ON A WOODEN THRONE.

entries.text: 費瑞說：「這座城很久以前就淪陷了，敵人是一群不受祝福、被一池魔法之力灌注的生物。為首的是泰蘭特拉克斯、艾德蘭卡與托拉斯。

entries.source: FIERCE GUSTS OF WIND HOWL PAST AND THE GROUND SHAKES AS PEALS OF THUNDER ROCK THE LAND.  THE SWIRLING MURK HIDES WHAT LIES AHEAD.
entries.text: 狂風呼嘯而過，雷聲震得大地搖晃。翻捲的昏暗遮住了前方的一切。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: FIGHT
entries.text: 開打
entries.note: 遭遇選單。

entries.source: FIGHT THEM?
entries.text: 要跟牠們打嗎？
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: FIGHT?
entries.text: 要打嗎？
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.text: 戰士

entries.source: FINALLY YOU ENTER THE CIVILIZED AREA OF PHLAN.
entries.text: 你們終於回到菲蘭城已開化的地帶。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: FIND THE NOMADS AND STOP THEM FROM JOINING FORCES WITH OUR ENEMIES.'
entries.text: 找到那群遊牧民，別讓他們和敵人聯手。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: FIND THE SOURCE OF THE RIVER'S POLLUTION AND END IT.'
entries.text: 找出河水污染的源頭，把它斷掉。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.text: 四隻巨蜥奔上來攻擊隊伍！
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.text: 放他自由

entries.source: FROM AN ARCHWAY AT THE BOTTOM COME ARROWS.
entries.text: 箭矢從底下的拱門射了出來。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: FROM ARROW SLITS IN THE TOWER ARE SHOT A COUPLE ARROWS.
entries.text: 塔上的箭孔射出幾支箭。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: FROM HERE YOU SEE A LARGE INNER WALL AROUND THE CENTRAL KEEP.  THIS AREA IS BUSY WITH MEN ENTERING AND LEAVING BARRACKS.
entries.text: 從這裡看得到主堡外的一道厚實內牆。這一帶人來人往，進出營房的人不少。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: FROM NEARBY A GROUP OF LIZARD MEN APPEAR. ONE LARGER THAN THE REST MOVES TO THE FRONT, 'YOUR TIME IS THROUGH OLD ONE. YOUR CLAWS ARE BLUNT.'
entries.text: 附近出現一群蜥蜴人，一名比其他都高大的走到前面：「你的時代結束了，老東西。你的爪子已經鈍了。」
entries.note: 沼澤的蜥蜴人部族。

entries.source: FROM THE MAGICALLY-LIT TOMB OF A BRAVE KNIGHT, A BODY RISES FROM ITS RESTING PLACE TO LAY WEAPONS BEFORE THE PARTY.
entries.text: 在一位勇敢騎士的魔法照明墓穴裡，一具遺體從安息之處起身，把武器放到隊伍面前。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: FROM THE SOUTH, A LARGE ANHKHEG LUNGES OUT AND ATTACKS THE PARTY.
entries.text: 一隻大掘地蟲從南邊竄出，撲向隊伍。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: FROM THE TOP OF THE GATE COMES A VOLLEY OF ROCKS.
entries.text: 門樓上砸下一陣落石。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: GENHEERIS
entries.text: 根赫里斯
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。通關密語，音近。

entries.text: 抓住他
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: GHOSTLY SHAPES SCREECH OUT A DREADFUL KEENING HOWL
entries.text: 幽靈般的身影發出可怖的哀嚎
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。片段。

entries.source: GIANT LIZARDS
entries.text: 巨蜥
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.text: 巨螳螂
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.text: 哥布林

entries.source: GOBLINS.
entries.text: 哥布林。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.text: 金
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。轉盤的四色之一。

entries.source: GOLD.
entries.text: 金。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。
