entries.text: 去睡覺
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。原版把 GO TO 連寫成 GOTO。

entries.source: GRAB
entries.text: 抓住
entries.note: 扒手事件的選項。

entries.source: GRAFFITI COVERS THE WALLS IN MEANINGLESS ABANDON.
entries.text: 牆上滿是毫無意義的塗鴉。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: GRAVEYARD
entries.text: 墳場
entries.note: 城郊出入口。

entries.source: GREET
entries.text: 打招呼
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: GREET YOU AND YOU EXCHANGE PLEASANTRIES.  THE
entries.text: 向你們打招呼，雙方寒暄了幾句。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。片段。

entries.source: GREET YOU AND YOU EXCHANGE PLESANTRIES.  THE
entries.text: 向你們問好，彼此寒暄了幾句。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。原版把 PLEASANTRIES 拼成 PLESANTRIES；此為句子片段。

entries.source: GRUMBLE, AND TURN AWAY.
entries.text: 咕噥幾句，轉身走開。
entries.note: 片段。

entries.source: GUARDING THIS CHAMBER ARE TWO GIANT LIZARDS.  AS YOU APPROACH, THEY ATTACK.
entries.text: 兩隻巨蜥守著這間石室。你們一靠近，牠們就攻了上來。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: GUARDS RUN TO INTERCEPT YOU.
entries.text: 守衛跑過來攔截你們。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: HARASH
entries.text: 哈拉許
entries.note: NPC 名，音近。

entries.source: HE GLARES AT YOU,'ONE OF YOU SHALL PAY FOR THIS INSULT. WHO WILL IT BE?'WHAT DO YOU DO?
entries.text: 他瞪著你們：「你們得有一個人為這句羞辱付出代價。誰？」你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: HE LEAVES.
entries.text: 他離開了。
entries.note: 敘述。

entries.source: HE LOOKS AT YOU PATIENTLY.
entries.text: 他耐著性子看著你們。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: HE LOOKS CONFUSED,'OH, THE ENVOYS. DO YOU WISH AN ESCORT TO THE KING?'
entries.text: 他一臉茫然：「喔，是使節。要人帶你們去見王嗎？」
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: HE LOOKS RELUCTANT AND SAYS, 'BUT HIS MINIONS ARE THERE. HE WILL COME TOO!' DO YOU INSIST HE COME?
entries.text: 他一臉不情願：「可是他的爪牙都在那裡。他也會來的！」你們要堅持帶他去嗎？
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: HE LUNGES FOR THE DOOR AND HITS A BUTTON. THEN HE TURNS AND FACES THE PARTY WITH SWORD DRAWN. 'IN A MOMENT A PATROL WILL BE HERE. IF YOU STAY TO FIGHT ME YOU WILL DIE.'
entries.text: 他撲向門邊按下一個按鈕，然後拔劍轉身面對隊伍：「再過一會兒巡邏隊就到了。你們留下來跟我打，就是死路一條。」
entries.note: 瓦傑渥城堡內部。

entries.source: HE POINTS HIS RING AT YOU AND YOU RISE UP AND OUT THE WELL.
entries.text: 他把戒指對準你們，你們便升起來，飄出了井口。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: HE QUICKLY LEAVES. YOU ARE LEFT WITH THE NOTES OF AL-HYAM DHAZID, WHICH TELL QUITE A LOT ABOUT THE POOL OF RADIANCE. YOU COPY THEM INTO YOUR JOURNAL AS ENTRY 30.
entries.text: 他匆匆離去，留下阿爾-海姆·達齊德的筆記，裡面提到不少關於光芒之池的事。你們把它抄進手冊，成為線索報導 30。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。Al-Hyam Dhazid 為新增譯名。

entries.source: HE QUICKLY RETREATS THROUGH THE DOOR AND SLAMS IT, YELLING, 'INTRUDERS!'
entries.text: 他迅速退進門裡，砰地關上，一邊大喊：「有人闖進來了！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: HE RUNS OUT OF THE HALL. THERE IS TREASURE ALL ABOUT.
entries.text: 他跑出了大廳。四周散著財寶。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: HE SCRAMBLES OUT THE DOOR.
entries.text: 他連滾帶爬地衝出門去。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: HE SEEMS TO COLLAPSE. 'ALL RIGHT. I'M NOT TYRANTHRAXUS. HE JUST HIRED ME TO IMPERSONATE HIM. IT'S NOT A BAD LIFE, BUT, HEY! I CAN TELL WHICH WAY THE WIND'S BLOWING.'
entries.text: 他整個垮了下來：「好吧，我不是泰蘭特拉克斯。他只是雇我來冒充他。這差事不算差，不過嘿，風往哪邊吹我還是看得出來的。」
entries.note: 瓦傑渥城堡內部。

entries.source: HE STANDS UP, MUTTERING TO HIMSELF, AND JOINS YOU.
entries.text: 他站起身，喃喃自語，加入了你們。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: HERE CRUDE TABLES, LITTERED WITH BONES, ARE SCATTERED AROUND.
entries.text: 這裡零亂擺著幾張粗製的桌子，上頭滿是骨頭。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: HERE IS A LAUGHING THIEF.
entries.text: 這裡有個在笑的盜賊。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: HERE IS YOUR REWARD.'
entries.text: 這是你們的報酬。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: HERE. DO YOU WANT TO TRAIN?'
entries.text: 。你們要受訓嗎？」
entries.note: 訓練所與競技場。片段。

entries.source: HERO
entries.text: 英雄
entries.note: AD&D 等級稱號（戰士第四級）。

entries.source: HIDDEN IN A NARROW CREVICE IS AN OLD CRIPPLED KOBOLD. IT CROAKS WEAKLY FOR WATER.
entries.text: 一隻又老又跛的小妖魔藏在窄縫裡，有氣無力地嘶聲討水。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: HIPPOGRIFFS
entries.text: 鷹馬
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: HISTORY.
entries.text: 《歷史》。
entries.note: 書名，出現在搜書的敘述裡。

entries.source: HIT <RETURN> OR BUTTON TO CONTINUE
entries.text: 按 <RETURN> 或按鈕繼續
entries.note: 介面提示；原版此處與別處拼法不同，逐一對應。

entries.source: HOBGOBLINS
entries.text: 大哥布林
entries.note: 怪物名；與哥布林成對，取「大」以示體型。

entries.source: HOBGOBLINS CHARGE SCREAMING.
entries.text: 大哥布林尖叫著衝了過來。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: HOW MANY PLATINUM PIECES WILL YOU WAGER? (HOUSE LIMIT IS 1000)
entries.text: 要下注幾枚白金幣？（莊家上限一千）
entries.note: 酒館賭局。

entries.source: HOW WILL YOU FREE HIM?
entries.text: 你們要怎麼放他自由？
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: HOWEVER, HIDDEN AMIDST ALL THIS JUNK YOU FIND SOME TREASURE.
entries.text: 不過在這堆雜物之中，你們翻出了一些財寶。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: HOWEVER, YOU FIND A BOOK UNDER THE BODY. IT IS THE JOURNAL OF TYRMOR.  IT IS FACINATING AND YOU INCLUDE MUCH OF ITS INFORMATION IN YOUR JOURNAL AS ENTRY 26.
entries.text: 不過你們在屍體下找到一本書，是提爾莫的日記。內容引人入勝，你們把其中不少寫進手冊，成為線索報導 26。
entries.note: 野外。Tyrmor 為新增譯名；原版把 FASCINATING 拼成 FACINATING。

entries.source: I AM SORRY, BUT I HAVE NOTHING TO SELL NOW.  COME BACK SOME OTHER TIME.
entries.text: 抱歉，我現在沒有東西可賣。改天再來吧。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: I CAN'T ACCEPT THAT WAGER.
entries.text: 這個賭注我不能收。
entries.note: 酒館賭局。

entries.source: I CANNOT ARRANGE SUCH A DUEL.
entries.text: 這樣的對決我安排不來。
entries.note: 訓練所與競技場。

entries.source: IGNORE
entries.text: 不理會
entries.note: 遭遇選單。

entries.source: IGNORE CAVE
entries.text: 不理會洞穴
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: IN A CHAMBER FILLED WITH RUINED PARCHMENTS, YOU SURPRISE A SHAPE THAT IS CREATING ZOMBIES.
entries.text: 在一間滿是毀壞羊皮紙的屋子裡，你們撞見一個身影正在製造殭屍。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: IN A DEEP THREATENING VOICE ONE OF THE ORCS SAYS 'YOU MOLES BETTER WATCH YOUR STEP OR YOU SHALL FEEL THE WRATH OF BANE!'  AFTER SAYING THIS HE SPITS AND LEAVES.
entries.text: 其中一隻半獸人壓低嗓子威脅道：「你們這些鼴鼠最好給我小心點，不然就等著嘗嘗邪惡神的怒火！」說完啐了一口就走。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: IN A POUCH ON THE REMAINS IS A CRUMBLING PARCHMENT SCROLL WITH THE WORDS ...
entries.text: 遺骸身上的小袋裡有一卷風化的羊皮卷軸，上面寫著……
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: IN FRONT OF YOU ARE THREE CABINETS.  WHICH ONE WILL YOU EXAMINE?
entries.text: 你們面前有三個櫃子。要查看哪一個？
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: IN FRONT OF YOU IS A WOODEN CABINET.  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們面前是一個木櫃。要怎麼做？
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: IN FRONT OF YOU IS AN ALTAR THAT IS SMEARED WITH BLOOD AND COVERED WITH CRUDE BLACK HAND PRINTS.  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們面前是一座沾滿血跡、印著粗糙黑手印的祭壇。要怎麼做？
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: IN FRONT OF YOU.
entries.text: 就在你們前面。
entries.note: 遭遇敘述的方位片段，原版把句子拆成幾段拼起來。

entries.source: IN IT IS A KOBOLD'S CRUDE DRAWING.
entries.text: 裡面是一幅小妖魔畫的粗糙圖畫。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: IN THE CENTER OF THE ROOM IS A GLOWING POOL. AN ANCIENT BRONZE DRAGON, SURROUNDED BY A FIERY AURA, RISES FROM WHERE IT WAS COILED NEARBY.
entries.text: 房間正中是一池發光的水。一條蒼老的青銅龍裹著火焰般的靈光，從一旁盤踞之處立起。
entries.note: 瓦傑渥城堡內部。

entries.source: IN THE CHAMBER IS A SINGLE CRYPT.  FLOATING ABOVE THE CRYPT IS A WRAITH. 'I AM THE PROTECTOR OF THE PALADIN. I GUARD HIS REMAINS FOR ALL ETERNITY.  LEAVE OR SUFFER.'  WHAT DO YOU DO?
entries.text: 室內只有一座墓，墓上飄著一隻幽靈：「我是那位聖武士的守護者，永世看守他的遺骸。走開，否則後果自負。」你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS, THE ENTIRE CITY COUNCIL IS WAITING FOR YOU. THE LORD HIGH MAYOR, ULRICH EBERHARD, SPEAKS: 'OUR FORCES ARE MARSHALLED FOR THE ASSAULT ON VALJEVO CASTLE.
entries.text: 議事廳裡，全體市議會都在等你們。大市長亞爾瑞屈·艾伯哈德開口：「我軍已集結完畢，準備進攻瓦傑渥城堡。
entries.note: 接下一段。

entries.source: IN THE CRYPT LIES THE FULLY-EQUIPPED BODY OF A MIGHTY WARRIOR.  DO YOU STRIP THE BODY?
entries.text: 墓室裡躺著一具裝備齊全的強大戰士遺體。要剝下他的裝備嗎？
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: IN THE ENTRY IS SET A HUGE PAIR OF BRASS DOORS.
entries.text: 入口處嵌著一對巨大的黃銅門。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: IN THE MIDDLE OF A DOOR IS A PANEL OF A POWERFUL KNIGHT FIGHTING SEVERAL UNDEAD.
entries.text: 門的中央鑲著一塊浮雕，刻的是一名強大的騎士對抗數隻不死怪物。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: IN THE ROOM ARE FOUR GIANTS.
entries.text: 房裡有四名巨人。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: IN THE RUBBLE YOU SPOT A BEAUTIFUL TAPESTRY.  WILL YOU TAKE IT?
entries.text: 你們在瓦礫裡看到一幅漂亮的掛毯。要拿走嗎？
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: IN THIS ROOM ARE SOME GNOLLS AND TROLLS.  THEY ATTACK YOU IMMEDIATELY.
entries.text: 這間屋裡有幾隻豺狼人和巨魔，牠們立刻攻了上來。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: IN THIS ROOM ARE SOME GOBLIN SLAVES THAT ARE COWERING IN THE CORNER.  THEY ALL SCREAM 'PLEASE DON'T KILL US.'  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 房裡有幾隻哥布林奴隸縮在角落，全都尖叫著：「求求你們別殺我們。」你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: IN THIS ROOM ARE THE HORRID REMAINS OF SOME ELVES.
entries.text: 這間屋裡是幾具精靈的殘骸，慘不忍睹。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: IN THIS ROOM IS A YOUNG WOMAN IN BARBARIAN FINERY. SHE DROPS A KOBOLD SHE WAS STRANGLING WHEN SHE SEES YOU.
entries.text: 這間屋裡有個穿著蠻族華服的年輕女子。看到你們，她鬆手扔下正被她掐著的小妖魔。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: IN THIS ROOM THERE ARE FOUR LARGE LIZARD MEN.  AS YOU ENTER ONE OF THEM YELLS 'KILL' AND THEY ATTACK.
entries.text: 這間屋裡有四名高大的蜥蜴人。你們一進去，其中一個大喊「殺」，牠們便攻了上來。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: INSIDE THE CABINET YOU FIND EIGHTEEN SACKS FILLED WITH GOLD PIECES.
entries.text: 櫃子裡有十八袋金幣。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: INSIDE THE CABINET YOU FIND FIFTEEN SACKS FILLED WITH SILVER PIECES.
entries.text: 櫃子裡有十五袋銀幣。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: INSIDE THE CABINET YOU FIND SOME FILES.  YOU STUFF THE PAPERS INTO YOUR JOURNAL UNDER ENTRIES 23 AND 14.
entries.text: 櫃子裡有幾份卷宗。你們把文件塞進手冊，成為線索報導 23 與 14。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: INSIDE THE CASKET ARE SOME BEAUTIFUL GEMS.
entries.text: 小箱裡是幾顆漂亮的寶石。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: INSIDE THE CASKET IS A VARIETY OF GOLD CHAINS, PENDANTS AND JEWELRY.
entries.text: 小箱裡是各式金鍊、墜飾與首飾。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: INSIDE THE RUINS OF A BLACK MARBLE CRYPT IS A COFFIN FILLED WITH DUST.  AMONG THE PILES OF DUST ARE SEVERAL BROKEN CROSSES, VIALS OF SPILLED HOLY WATER, AND A SCROLL.
entries.text: 黑色大理石墓室的廢墟裡有一具滿是塵土的棺材。塵堆之間散著幾支斷裂的十字架、幾瓶灑翻的聖水，還有一卷卷軸。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: INSIDE THIS HUT ARE FOUR LIZARD MEN.  THEY ATTACK YOU IMMEDIATELY.
entries.text: 這間棚屋裡有四名蜥蜴人，牠們立刻撲了上來。
entries.note: 野外。

entries.source: INSIDE THIS ROOM YOU FIND A LARGE PILE OF WEAPONS AND SHIELDS.  THEY APPEAR TO BE IN GOOD CONDITION AND OF FINE QUALITY.  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 房裡堆著大量武器與盾牌，看起來狀況良好、品質不錯。你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: INSULT BACK

entries.source: INVESTIGATE
entries.text: 查看

entries.text: 牠朝你們嘶叫。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.text: 上了鎖。你們要怎麼開？
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: IT IS NIGHT AND YOU ARE IN YOUR QUARTERS.
entries.text: 入夜了，你們待在住處。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: IT SEEMS THAT THEIR SCREAMS WERE HEARD...
entries.text: 看來牠們的尖叫被聽見了……
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: IT'S BLUE.  YOU WIN.
entries.text: 是藍色，你們贏了。
entries.note: 酒館賭局結果。

entries.source: IT'S GREEN.  YOU GET DOUBLE YOUR MONEY BACK.
entries.text: 是綠色，你們拿回兩倍的錢。
entries.note: 酒館賭局結果。

entries.source: JOIN IN HEAVY DRINKING
entries.text: 跟著大喝
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: JUNIOR COUNCILMAN CADORNA HAS A SPECIAL COMMISSION FOR YOU.  HIS CHAMBERS ARE THROUGH THE EAST DOOR.'
entries.text: 資淺議員卡多納有一件特別的委託要交給你們。他的房間走東邊那道門。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: JUST ABOVE THE WATERLINE, A SECRET DOOR HAS BEEN LEFT AJAR IN THE SOUTH WALL OF THE WELL.  DO YOU WANT TO CLIMB UP THE RUNGS?
entries.text: 水面上方一點，井的南壁有一道暗門半開著。要爬踏階上去嗎？
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: KILL THEM

entries.note: 遭遇選單。

entries.source: KNOWING THAT TYRANTHRAXUS HAS FINALLY BEEN DEFEATED, YOU LEAVE THE CASTLE. MOVING THROUGH THE STREETS YOU CATCH OCCASIONAL GLIMPSES OF MONSTERS IN HIDING. NONE ATTACK.
entries.text: 確知泰蘭特拉克斯終於被擊敗，你們離開了城堡。走在街上，偶爾瞥見躲藏的怪物，卻沒有一隻出手。

entries.text: 小妖魔冒了出來，朝你們扔石頭。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: KOBOLDS BLOCK ALL THE EXITS.
entries.text: 小妖魔堵住了所有出口。

entries.source: KOBOLDS SEEM TO BOIL UP FROM NOWHERE.
entries.text: 小妖魔像是憑空冒出來似的湧上。

entries.text: 圖書館。」

entries.text: LIX。

entries.text: 蜥蜴人

entries.text: 蜥蜴人。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: LOOK FOR THE MAN IN PLAIN CLOTHES
entries.text: 找那個穿便服的人
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: LOOKING DISAPPOINTED THE HEADMAN SAYS, 'GOOD LUCK IN YOUR TRAVELS.'
entries.text: 首領面露失望：「祝各位一路順風。」
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: LOOKING UP FROM A TABLE ARE FIVE KOBOLDS.
entries.text: 五隻小妖魔從桌邊抬起頭來。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: LORD CADORNA HAS A DELICATE DIPLOMATIC MISSION THAT REQUIRES YOUR PARTICULAR SKILLS.  YOU ARE SUMMONED TO HIS CHAMBERS. GO THROUGH THE SOUTH DOOR.'
entries.text: 卡多納大人有一樁棘手的外交任務，正需要你們這樣的本事。他召你們到他房裡，走南門進去。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: LORD URSLINGEN WISHES URGENTLY TO SPEAK WITH YOU.  GO THROUGH THE SOUTH DOOR OF THE TRAITOR CADORNA'S OLD QUARTERS.'
entries.text: 烏斯林根大人急著要見你們。走叛徒卡多納舊居的南門進去。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: LUMBERING FIGURES REACH FOR YOU.
entries.text: 笨重的身影朝你們伸出手來。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: LUX
entries.text: 勒克斯
entries.note: NPC 名，音近。

entries.source: LYING HERE ARE THE PARTIALLY EATEN REMAINS OF A HALFING.
entries.text: 這裡躺著一具半身人的殘骸，被啃食了一部分。
entries.note: 荒野。原版把 HALFLING 拼成 HALFING，說明書 p.11 也照此拼法。

entries.source: LYING ON THE FLOOR IS A LARGE, SHEDDED SNAKE SKIN.
entries.text: 地上躺著一張碩大的蛇蛻。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: LYING ON THE GROUND HERE ARE THE DISSOLVING REMAINS OF A DWARF.  HE IS COVERED IN ACID.
entries.text: 地上躺著一具正在溶解的矮人遺體，渾身沾滿酸液。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: MANY CREATURES HAVE GATHERED. THE ROBED ORC STANDS AND CALLS OUT,'FIRST, TO SHOW YOUR LOYALTIES, KILL THE UNBELIEVERS.' HE POINTS AT YOUR GROUP.
entries.text: 許多生物聚了過來。那隻穿長袍的半獸人站起身喊道：「首先，為了表明你們的忠誠，殺了異教徒。」牠指向你們這一隊。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.text: 怪物從遠處的塔那邊朝你們衝來。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.text: 怪物從遠處的塔朝你們衝來，同時旁邊那座塔裡也竄出怪物撲向你們。
entries.note: 史塔傑諾門一帶的事件。

entries.text: 四周建築裡的怪物撲向你們。

entries.source: MONSTERS INSULT YOUR ABILITIES AND PARENTAGE.
entries.text: 怪物把你們的本事和祖宗一起羞辱了一遍。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: MONSTERS THUNDER DOWN THE STEPS OF THE TOWER NEXT TO YOU.
entries.text: 怪物從你們旁邊那座塔的階梯上轟隆隆衝下來。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: MORE GUARDS COMMING RUNNING TOWARD YOU.  THEIR LEADER YELLS 'SURRENDER OR DIE!'  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 更多守衛朝你們奔來，領頭的大喊：「投降不然就死！」你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 海盜據點。原版把 COMING 拼成 COMMING。

entries.text: 旁邊有一頭大母野豬正在餵幼崽。你們一靠近，牠就低吼著要你們走開。你們要怎麼做？

entries.source: NOW THEY ARE MUCH MORE SINISTER. THE WEB OF CORRUPTION HE HAS SPREAD IS INCREDIBLE IN ITS SCOPE. HIS ULTIMATE GOAL IS TO CONQUER ALL LANDS SOUTH OF THE MOONSEA.
entries.text: 如今他們陰險多了。他所鋪開的腐化之網規模驚人，最終目標是征服月之海以南的所有土地。

entries.text: 她笑了笑：「那我就自己殺出去。祝你們順利。」說完便走了。

entries.text: 幾隻食屍鬼決定把你們加進菜單。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: SOME GUARDS RUSH FOWARD AND ATTACK.
entries.text: 幾名守衛衝上前來攻擊。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。原版把 FORWARD 拼成 FOWARD。

entries.source: SOME GUARDS SPOT YOU AND ATTACK.
entries.text: 幾名守衛發現你們，攻了上來。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: SOME HOBGOBLINS ARE ARGUING OVER A PILE OF GOLD.  'THIEVES!' THEY SCREAM WHEN THEY SEE YOU.
entries.text: 幾隻大哥布林正為一堆金幣爭吵。看到你們，牠們大叫：「小偷！」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: SOME ITEMS WERE LOST RECOVERING
entries.text: 取回時弄丟了一些物品
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。句子片段。

entries.source: SOME MONSTERS ARE TOSSING A SACK OF GRAIN. WHEN THE SACK BREAKS THEY WAIL, 'OH, NO! WHAT CAN WE THROW NOW?' ONE LOOKS YOUR WAY. 'I KNOW,' HE SAYS.
entries.text: 幾隻怪物正把一袋穀子拋來拋去。袋子破了，牠們哀號：「糟了！那現在要丟什麼？」其中一隻朝你們看過來：「我知道了。」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: SOME MOVEMENT OCCURS IN THE ROOM'S FAR CORNER AND THEN A VOLLEY OF ARROWS TEARS INTO THE GROUP.
entries.text: 屋子那頭的角落動了一下，接著一排箭矢射進隊伍。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: SOME OF THE GUARDS SPOT YOU WITH THE BOY.
entries.text: 幾名守衛看見你們帶著那個男孩。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: SOUTH
entries.text: 南

entries.source: SOUTH WALL.

entries.source: SPEAK
entries.text: 說話
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: SPIKES SPRING OUT AND IMPALE YOU.
entries.text: 尖刺彈出，把你們刺穿。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: STANDING IN FRONT OF THE DOOR ARE TWO LARGE GUARDS.  ONE OF THEM SAYS 'DO YOU HAVE A PASS TO SEE THE CAPTAIN?'  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 門前站著兩名壯碩的守衛，其中一個問：「你們有見隊長的通行證嗎？」你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: STANDING READY THEIR LEADER SAYS 'YOU MUST BE THE SERVANTS OF YARASH!'
entries.text: 領頭的擺開架式：「你們一定是亞拉斯的走狗！」
entries.note: 野外。

entries.source: STATE NAME AND INTENT
entries.text: 報上姓名與來意
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.note: 遭遇選單。

entries.source: STAY IN

entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: STREWN ACROSS THE FLOOR IS THE ACCUMULATED WEALTH OF THE KOBOLD COMMUNITY.
entries.text: 地上散落著這個小妖魔聚落積攢下來的全部財富。

entries.source: STRONG
entries.text: 強
entries.note: 同上。

entries.source: SUDDENLY 3 GIANT LIZARDS APPEAR FROM BEHIND A MOUND OF RUBBLE. YOU FREEZE A MOMENT AS THEY CHARGE YOU!
entries.text: 三隻巨蜥突然從一堆瓦礫後面竄出。牠們衝來時，你們愣了一瞬！
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: SUDDENLY A HIDDEN DOOR BURSTS OPEN AND A HORRIBLE MONSTER BURSTS FORTH SHOUTING 'KIAIAIAIAIAIAIAI!' IT WADES INTO YOU TEARING YOU APART WITH 3-INCH LONG CLAWS.
entries.text: 一道暗門突然撞開，一頭猙獰的怪物衝了出來，大吼「唭啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！」牠殺進隊伍，用三吋長的利爪把你們撕開。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: SUDDENLY LIZARD MEN JUMP UP FROM WHERE THEY WERE HIDING AND THROW JAVELINS AT YOU.
entries.text: 蜥蜴人突然從藏身處跳起，朝你們投擲標槍。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: SUDDENLY YOU ARE ATTACKED BY TWO LIZARD MEN AND A GIANT LIZARD!
entries.text: 兩名蜥蜴人和一隻巨蜥突然襲來！
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: SUDDENLY YOU ARE FACE TO FACE WITH A GROUP OF
entries.text: 你們突然和一群
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。片段，後接怪物名。

entries.source: SUDDENLY, YOU SPOT A DULL BROWN REPTILIAN MONSTER WHICH IS JUST COMING AWAKE.
entries.text: 你們忽然發現一隻暗褐色的爬蟲怪物剛剛醒來。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.text: 說實話？
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THAT COMBAT IS NOT NECESSARY AND YOU GO ON YOUR WAY.
entries.text: 這一仗沒有必要，你們就繼續上路了。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.text: 那個人的狀況爬不動。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.text: 這個不行，換一個。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THAT PERSON WON'T PAY.
entries.text: 那個人不肯付。
entries.note: 敘述。

entries.source: THE
entries.text: 那個
entries.note: 片段，原版把句子拆開拼接時用到。

entries.source: THE AGED ORC COMES GRASPING TOWARD YOU.  WILL YOU LET HIM TOUCH YOU?
entries.text: 那隻年邁的半獸人伸著手朝你們摸過來。要讓他摸嗎？
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: THE AIR AROUND THE TOWER IS CHARGED WITH STATIC ELECTRICITY AND BALL LIGHTNING.
entries.text: 塔的四周瀰漫著靜電，還有滾動的球狀閃電。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE ANIMALS HAVE BEEN CAPTURED.
entries.text: 那些動物已經被抓住了。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE ARENA MASTER ASKS IF YOU WISH TO DUEL.  'THE DUELS  ARE EVENLY MATCHED AND NORMALLY NOT TO THE DEATH. DO YOU DUEL?'
entries.text: 競技場主事問你們要不要上場對決：「對手實力相當，通常不會打到死。要打嗎？」
entries.note: 訓練所與競技場。

entries.source: THE AUCTION ENDS. YOU DON'T SEE WHO BOUGHT THE ITEM.
entries.text: 拍賣結束，你們沒看清是誰買走了那件東西。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THE AUCTION OVER, THE MONSTERS GRUMBLE AND TURN AWAY.'
entries.text: 拍賣結束，怪物咕噥著轉身散去。」
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THE AUCTIONEER CRIES 'CREATURES OF ALL AGES, WELCOME TO THIS AUCTION FOR AN ITEM BOTH MAGICAL AND POWERFUL!'
entries.text: 拍賣官高喊：「各族的朋友們，歡迎來到這場拍賣，今天的物件既有魔力又強大！」
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THE AUCTIONEER HAS EITHER A WAND OR STAFF.
entries.text: 拍賣官手上不是魔杖就是法杖。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THE BALLISTA ARE RELOADED. THE KING CALLS OUT,'DEATH OR IMPRISONMENT.'
entries.text: 弩砲重新上弦。那位王喊道：「要死還是要坐牢。」
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE BAR LOOKS LIKE IT WAS DESTROYED BY EXPERTS.
entries.text: 這間酒吧看起來像是被行家砸過。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THE BATTLE IS OVER, THE PATRONS RETURN TO DRINKING.
entries.text: 打鬥結束，客人們又回去喝酒了。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THE BIDDING ESCALATES TO 5,000 GOLD PIECES -- HIGH BID FROM A MAN IN PLAIN CLOTHES, NEXT TO AN OGRE.
entries.text: 價錢一路喊到五千枚金幣——最高價出自一個站在食人鬼旁邊、穿著便服的人。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THE BIGGEST NOMAD, APPARENTLY THE CHIEF OR HEADMAN, ACKNOWLEDGES YOU WITH A NOD, 'WE WILL GIVE A FEAST IN YOUR HONOR
entries.text: 那名最魁梧的遊牧民，看來是酋長或首領，朝你們點頭示意：「我們要為各位設宴
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。接下一段。

entries.source: THE BIGGEST, MEANEST, DIRTIEST NOMAD PUSHES HIS WAY TO THE FRONT OF THE CROWD. FIVE OTHER NOMADS STAND AROUND HIM AS IF TO PROTECT HIM.
entries.text: 一名最魁梧、最兇惡、最骯髒的遊牧民擠到人群前頭，另外五個圍在他身邊，像是在護著他。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: THE BOAT DISEMBARKS YOU AT SOKAL KEEP.
entries.text: 船把你們送上索卡爾城堡。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE BRASS KEY YOU FOUND OPENS ALL OF THE PADLOCKS.
entries.text: 你們找到的黃銅鑰匙打開了所有掛鎖。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE BUCCANEER SMILES.'THAT IS SUFFICIENT PAYMENT.' HE LEAVES.
entries.text: 那名海盜笑了笑：「這樣就夠了。」隨即離去。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THE BUGBEAR TAKES THE MONEY AND THE GATE OPENS. YOU PROCEED THROUGH.
entries.text: 熊地精收下錢，門開了。你們走了進去。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE BUGBEARS STRIP YOU OF ANYTHING REMOTELY VALUABLE AND SEND YOU ON YOUR WAY.
entries.text: 熊地精把你們身上稍微值錢的東西全搜走，然後放你們走。
entries.note: 史塔傑諾門一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE CAPTAIN LOOKS YOU OVER AND SAYS 'WHAT DO YOU WANT?'
entries.text: 隊長把你們打量一番：「你們想幹什麼？」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE CAPTAIN SAYS 'YOU HAVE CHOSEN WISELY.'  SOME OF THE BUCCANEERS COME FORWARD AND STRIP YOU OF SOME OF YOUR ITEMS AND MONEY.  THEY ESCORT YOU OUT OF THE COMPOUND.
entries.text: 隊長說：「你們選得明智。」幾名海盜上前搜走你們一部分財物與錢財，然後把你們押出營區。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: THE CAPTAIN SAYS 'YOU HAVE FOUGHT WELL.  YOU MAY RANSOM YOURSELVES OR DIE!'  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 隊長說：「你們打得不錯。要嘛拿錢贖命，要嘛死。」你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: THE CAPTAIN SAYS 'YOU HAVE MADE A GOOD DEAL.'  AFTER TALKING THE CAPTAIN MAKES A MOTION AND THE BOY IS BROUGHT TO YOU.
entries.text: 隊長說：「這筆買賣划算。」談妥後他打了個手勢，男孩被帶了過來。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: THE CAPTAIN THEN LEAVES THE ROOM AND YOU ARE ESCORTED BACK OUTSIDE.
entries.text: 隊長隨即離開房間，你們被護送回外面。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE CASKET IS FILLED WITH TINY PEARLS!
entries.text: 小箱裡滿滿都是細小的珍珠！
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: THE CHAMBER IS FILLED WITH USELESS CLOTHING AND RUSTING ARMOR.
entries.text: 室內堆滿了沒用的衣物與生鏽的護甲。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE CHAMBER LIGHTS UP TO REVEAL A TALL, PALE MAN WITH VERY WHITE TEETH.
entries.text: 室內亮起，照出一個高瘦蒼白、牙齒極白的男人。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE CHARACTERS HEAR A LOUD FLAPPING NOISE AND THEN A WARM RUSH OF AIR HITS THEIR FACES.  STANDING BEFORE YOU NOW IS A GREAT SILVER DRAGON.  HE SAYS, 'YOU ARE WISE TO SEEK MY COUNCIL AND I CAN HELP YOU...'
entries.text: 隊員聽見一陣響亮的振翅聲，接著一股暖風撲面而來。眼前站著一條巨大的銀龍：「你們來求我指點是明智的，我可以幫你們……」
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。

entries.source: THE CHARACTERS HEAR A LOUD FLAPPING NOISE AND THEN FEEL A WARM JET OF AIR HIT THEIR FACES.  A HUGE SILVER DRAGON FLIES DOWN TO MEET THEM.
entries.text: 隊員聽見一陣響亮的振翅聲，接著一股暖風撲面而來。一條巨大的銀龍飛落下來。
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。

entries.source: THE CITY WATCH CHARGES IN. DO YOU RUN AWAY OR STAY TO CONFRONT THEM?
entries.text: 城衛隊衝了進來。你們要跑，還是留下來面對他們？
entries.note: 城衛隊事件。

entries.source: THE CITY WATCH RESPONDS TO THE NOISE.  DO YOU STAY TO FIGHT THEM OR RUN AWAY?
entries.text: 城衛隊聞聲趕來。你們要留下來打，還是逃走？
entries.note: 城衛隊事件。

entries.source: THE CITY WATCH STOPS YOU AND REMOVES CADORNA'S TREASURE FROM YOUR KEEPING.  THEY TELL YOU YOUR REWARD WAITS WITH THE CITY CLERK.
entries.text: 城衛隊攔下你們，把卡多納的財寶收走，並告訴你們報酬在書記官那裡等著領。
entries.note: 劇情事件；Cadorna 依 glossary 作卡多納。

entries.source: THE CLERK SHUFFLES THROUGH HER PAPERS. 'ON THE MATTER OF COMMISSION,' SHE SAYS, 'I CAN OFFER THE FOLLOWING: '
entries.text: 書記官翻了翻手邊的文件：「關於委託，」她說，「我能提供以下幾項：」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE CLERK SPEAKS. '
entries.text: 書記官開口說：「
entries.note: 片段，後面接委託內容。

entries.source: THE COFFIN MAKES A MESS ON THE FLOOR.
entries.text: 棺材砸得滿地狼藉。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE COMMANDANT IS SURPRISED THAT YOUR CITY IS HAVING NO TROUBLE WITH TYRANTHRAXUS.  HE THEN SAYS, 'YOUR TOWN DEFENSES MUST BE STRONG IN ORDER TO HANDLE HIM.  HOW STRONG ARE THEY?'
entries.text: 指揮官很意外貴城竟然沒有被泰蘭特拉克斯困擾，接著問：「能應付牠，貴城的防務想必很強。到底有多強？」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE COMMANDANT SAYS 'I EXPECT THERE WOULD BE TROUBLE; I'VE HEARD TYRANTHRAXUS IS A POWERFUL FIRE DEMON.  YOUR CITY'S DEFENCES MUST BE QUITE STRONG, HOW STRONG ARE THEY?'
entries.text: 指揮官說：「我想總會有麻煩的；聽說泰蘭特拉克斯是一頭強大的火魔。貴城的防務想必相當堅實，究竟有多強？」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE COMMANDANT TURNS TO ONE OF THE CHARACTERS AND SAYS, 'SO, HOWS EVERYTHING IN PHLAN?'  WHAT WILL YOU TALK ABOUT?
entries.text: 指揮官轉向其中一名隊員：「那麼，菲蘭城那邊一切都好嗎？」你們要談什麼？
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。原版把 HOW'S 寫成 HOWS。

entries.source: THE COMMOTION ALLOWS YOU TO GET TO THE FRONT GATE!
entries.text: 這場騷動讓你們得以趕到前門！
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE CONVERSATION BEGINS TO DIE DOWN.  THE COMMANDANT  STARTS A CONVERSATION BY SAYING 'WELL, ARE YOU HAVING MUCH TROUBLE WITH THE CREATURES FROM OLD PHLAN?'
entries.text: 談話漸漸冷了下來。指揮官起了個頭：「那麼，舊菲蘭城那些東西給你們添了不少麻煩吧？」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE CONVERSATION COMPLETELY DIES AND EVERYONE IS STARING AT EACH OTHER.  THE COMMANDANT EXCUSES HIMSELF AND LEAVES.  A GUARD TAKES YOU BACK TO YOUR QUARTERS.
entries.text: 談話徹底冷場，眾人面面相覷。指揮官告退離席，一名守衛帶你們回住處。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE CONVERSATION GOES STALE AND THE COMMANDANT EXCUSES HIMSELF FROM THE TABLE.  YOU ARE ESCORTED BACK TO YOUR QUARTERS.
entries.text: 談話冷了場，指揮官告退離席。你們被護送回住處。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE COUNCIL HAS AWARDED A BONUS FOR YOUR ELIMINATING NORRIS THE GRAY.
entries.text: 你們除掉了挪里斯，議會另發一筆獎金。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE COUNCIL HAS NOTED THE PASSING OF THE TRAITOR CADORNA.'
entries.text: 議會已知悉叛徒卡多納的死訊。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE COUNCIL HAS VOTED A SPECIAL PRIZE FOR ENDING THE GRAVEYARD MENACE.
entries.text: 你們解除了墳場之患，議會表決通過一筆特別獎賞。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE COUNCIL IS OFFERING A REWARD FOR BOOKS, MAPS, TOMES, ETC. WHICH PROVIDE USEFUL INFORMATION ABOUT PHLAN BEFORE THE FALL.  THE REWARD IS TIED TO THE VALUE OF THE INFORMATION.'
entries.text: 議會懸賞書籍、地圖、典籍等一切能提供菲蘭城陷落前資訊的東西，賞金視資訊價值而定。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE COUNCIL WAS PLEASED BY THE ELIMINATION OF THE THIEVES IN KOVEL MANSION.
entries.text: 你們肅清了柯威大樓裡的盜賊，議會相當滿意。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE COUNCIL WILL BE AMUSED BY THE DESCRIPTIONS.
entries.text: 議會看了這些記述會很有意思。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE CREATURES IGNORE YOU FOR THE MOMENT.
entries.text: 那些東西暫時沒有理會你們。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THE CROAKING RISES IN VOLUME.
entries.text: 呱呱聲愈來愈響。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE DOOR HAS BEEN NAILED SHUT.  WILL YOU FORCE IT OPEN?
entries.text: 這道門被釘死了。要硬撬開嗎？
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE DOOR IS FREED.
entries.text: 門被弄開了。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE DOOR IS LOCKED.  DO YOU WANT TO BREAK IN?
entries.text: 門鎖著。要破門進去嗎？
entries.note: 互動提問。

entries.source: THE DOOR OF THE BUILDING YOU ARE PASSING SLAMS.
entries.text: 你們經過的那棟建築，門砰地關上。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE DRAGON LANDS, LOOKS THE PARTY OVER THEN SAYS 'YOU HAVE NOTHING THAT INTRESTS ME.  IF YOU WISH TO APEASE ME THEN GO EAST AND DESTROY THE KOBOLD COMMUNITY THERE.'
entries.text: 那條龍落地，把隊伍打量一番後說：「你們身上沒有我感興趣的東西。想讓我消氣，就往東去，把那裡的小妖魔聚落滅了。」
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。原版把 INTERESTS 拼成 INTRESTS、APPEASE 拼成 APEASE。

entries.source: THE ELF IS LONG DEAD.
entries.text: 那名精靈早就死了。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE ENCLAVE IS GUARDED BY A SKELETON ARMY!
entries.text: 這片地界由一支骷髏大軍守著！
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE FLOOR IS SLIPPERY FROM DUNG AND REEKS OF URINE.
entries.text: 地板被糞便弄得濕滑，尿騷味刺鼻。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE FOLLOWING CATCHES YOUR EYE, 'DO NOT BE FOOLED BY OUTWARD FORMS FOR YOU SHALL KNOW ME BY MY FLAMING AURA.
entries.text: 這一段吸引了你們的注意：「莫被外形所惑，你們將以我那燃燒的靈光認出我。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。接下一段。

entries.source: THE GATE PASSWORD IS
entries.text: 城門的密語是
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。片段。

entries.source: THE GIANT HESITATES, 'WHO SENT YOU?'
entries.text: 那名巨人遲疑了一下：「誰派你們來的？」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE GIANT READIES HIS WEAPON AND ADVANCES. THE OTHERS FOLLOW SUIT.
entries.text: 那名巨人舉起武器逼近，其餘的也跟著上。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE GIANTS ARE WALKING TOWARD YOU.
entries.text: 巨人正朝你們走來。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE GIANTS LOOK UP AT YOU.
entries.text: 巨人抬頭看向你們。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE GIANTS STAND IN FRONT OF YOU LOOKING SUSPICIOUS.
entries.text: 巨人站在你們面前，一臉懷疑。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE GIANTS WHO PLACED THE BUCKET THERE CHARGE!
entries.text: 擺下那只桶子的巨人衝了上來！
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE GNOLL TURNS TO FLEE. AS HE RUNS BY, ONE OF THE SLAVES TRIPS HIM. YOU ADVANCE AND CUT THE OVERSEER'S THROAT.
entries.text: 那隻豺狼人轉身要逃，跑過時被一名奴隸絆倒。你們上前割開了工頭的喉嚨。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE GROUND HERE IS SOFT AND FRESHLY CHURNED.
entries.text: 這裡的地面鬆軟，像是剛被翻動過。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE GROUP OF BUGBEARS COME OVER, 'WE WARNED YOU! WHAT'S THE MATTER? CAN'T YOU UNDERSTAND COMMON? I GUESS I'LL HAVE TO TEACH YOU.' THE LEADER SWINGS AT YOU.
entries.text: 那群熊地精走了過來：「警告過你們了！怎麼，聽不懂通用語嗎？看來得教教你們。」領頭的一刀砍向你們。
entries.note: 史塔傑諾門一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE GUARD CAPTAIN STEPS FORWARD. 'PLEASE LET US SHOW YOU THE WAY.'
entries.text: 衛隊長走上前來：「請讓我們帶路。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE GUARD GIVING THE TOUR SAYS 'HERE YOU SEE ONE OF OUR FINE BARRACKS.  THERE ARE SIX OF THESE HERE AND EACH CAN HOLD OVER A 100 MEN.'
entries.text: 帶隊導覽的守衛說：「各位看到的是我們出色的營房之一。這裡有六座，每座可容納一百多人。」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE GUARD SAYS 'HERE ARE YOUR QUARTERS.  DO NOT LEAVE THIS AREA.'  HE THEN LEAVES.
entries.text: 守衛說：「這是你們的住處。不要離開這一帶。」說完就走了。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE GUARD SAYS 'THAT CONCLUDES THE TOUR.  I WILL SHOW YOU TO YOUR QUARTERS.'
entries.text: 守衛說：「導覽到此結束。我帶你們去住處。」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE GUARDS IN THE BARRACKS ATTACK.
entries.text: 營房裡的守衛動手了。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE GUARDS LOOK AT YOUR PASS AND LET YOU PASS.
entries.text: 守衛看了看你們的通行證，放行了。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE HALL IS EMPTY, SAVE FOR SIGNS OF A RECENT BATTLE.
entries.text: 大廳空無一物，只留下不久前一場戰鬥的痕跡。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE HARBOR MASTER TELLS YOU BOATS LEAVE FOR THE WEST, THE EAST, SOKAL KEEP, AND THE NORTH SIDE OF THE BAY.  'ROUND TRIP PASSAGE IS 1 PLATINUM PIECE. WHAT PASSAGE CAN I SELL YOU?'
entries.text: 港務長告訴你們，有船開往西邊、東邊、索卡爾城堡與海灣北岸。「來回船票一枚白金幣。要買哪一趟？」
entries.note: 港口。

entries.source: THE HARMONY OF THE ROCK.
entries.text: 《岩石的和諧》。
entries.note: 書名，出現在搜書的敘述裡。

entries.source: THE HAUNTS BURST INTO A CHORUS OF HOWLS, MOANS, COMPLAINTS, WAILS, AND OTHER LAMENTATIONS OVER THEIR FATE AND THE FATE OF THEIR FAMILIES. THEY WERE THE ORIGINAL DEFENDERS OF THE KEEP,
entries.text: 那些幽魂爆出一陣嚎叫、呻吟、抱怨與哀號，為自己和家人的命運悲嘆。他們原是這座城堡的守軍，
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。接下一段。

entries.source: THE HEADMAN COMES TO YOU AND SAYS, 'ABOUT MY REQUEST OF LAST NIGHT, WHAT IS YOUR DECISION?'
entries.text: 首領走過來問：「昨晚拜託各位的事，決定得如何？」
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: THE HEADMAN SEEMS VERY UNEASY AS HE CONTINUES TO SPEAK. HE PRACTICALLY BEGS YOU TO STAY FOR A FEW MORE DAYS, RATHER THAN LEAVE IN THE MORNING AS YOU PLANNED.
entries.text: 首領說著說著顯得很不安，幾乎是懇求你們多留幾天，別照原定計畫早上就走。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: THE HEADMAN WALKS UP TO YOU WITH HIS GUARDS. 'GOOD MORNING. THERE ARE CELEBRATIONS PLANNED TODAY.'
entries.text: 首領帶著護衛走來：「早安。今天安排了慶典。」
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: THE HEIR TO THE HOUSE OF BIVANT MUST BE RESCUED.  WE WILL PAY GENEROUSLY FOR HIS SAFE RETURN.'
entries.text: 畢凡特家的繼承人必須救回來。平安帶回，重金酬謝。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE HEROIC DEATHS OF THOSE YOU HAVE JUST BATTLED HAS BOUGHT TIME FOR THE HEADMAN TO RALLY HIS PEOPLE. WITH A TREMENDOUS CRY HE LEADS HIS TRIBE INTO BATTLE.
entries.text: 方才那場血戰中壯烈犧牲的人，為首領爭取到集結族人的時間。他一聲怒吼，領著全族投入戰鬥。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: THE HOBGOBLINS GIVE CHASE, BUT YOU ESCAPE.
entries.text: 大哥布林追了上來，但你們逃掉了。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE HOBGOBLINS RESPOND WITH A PIERCING BATTLE CRY!
entries.text: 大哥布林以刺耳的戰吼回應！
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE INTERIOR IS OVERRUN WITH INSECTS.  AT YOUR FOOTSTEP, THEY FALL FROM THE WALLS AND CEILING.
entries.text: 室內爬滿了蟲子。你們一踏進去，牠們就從牆上與天花板落下。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE KING CALLS OUT,'YOU SEEM VALUABLE. SURRENDER OR DIE.'
entries.text: 那位王喊道：「你們看來挺值錢。投降，不然就死。」
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KING HAS ESCAPED DURING THE FIGHT.
entries.text: 打鬥之中，那位王逃走了。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KING, FROTHING AT THE MOUTH, CRIES, 'USE THE SECRET WEAPONS.' BALLISTA APPEAR AND FIRE.
entries.text: 那位王口吐白沫地喊：「用秘密兵器！」弩砲推了出來，開火。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KING, PANICKED, HAS FALLEN INTO HIS OWN SPIKED PIT AND DIED.
entries.text: 那位王驚慌之下掉進自己的尖刺坑，死了。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KOBOLD BOWS AND SAYS,'YOU ARE QUITE DANGEROUS, WE WILL PAY FOR A TRUCE.'
entries.text: 那隻小妖魔躬身道：「各位相當難惹，我們願意出錢求和。」
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KOBOLD CALLS OUT,'THE ENVOYS ARE HERE, GREAT KING.' AN AGED VOICE REPLIES 'SEND THEM FORWARD.' YOUR GUIDE, HOWEVER, HAS FALLEN INTO A STUPOR.
entries.text: 那隻小妖魔高聲道：「使節到了，偉大的王。」一個蒼老的聲音回道：「帶他們上前。」不過你們的嚮導已經醉倒了。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KOBOLD CRIES OUT, 'I'LL NOT GO ALONE!'
entries.text: 那隻小妖魔大喊：「我不會一個人上路！」
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KOBOLD DIES.
entries.text: 那隻小妖魔死了。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KOBOLD DISAPPEARS BEYOND THE BOULDER.
entries.text: 那隻小妖魔閃到巨石後面不見了。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KOBOLD PAUSES, IDLY TAPS THE WALL, THEN PROCEEDS.
entries.text: 那隻小妖魔停下腳步，隨手敲了敲牆，接著繼續走。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KOBOLD PROMPTLY RETURNS TO SLEEP.
entries.text: 那隻小妖魔轉眼又睡了過去。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KOBOLD RETREATS AROUND A BEND.
entries.text: 那隻小妖魔退到轉角後面。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KOBOLD RETREATS, THEN STRIKES THE WALL.
entries.text: 那隻小妖魔退了幾步，接著敲了敲牆。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KOBOLDS ARE TRYING TO SNEAK OFF.
entries.text: 那些小妖魔想偷偷溜走。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KOBOLDS CHASE FOR A WHILE, BUT YOU ESCAPE.
entries.text: 小妖魔追了一段，你們還是脫身了。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KOBOLDS COLLAPSE INTO A PATHETIC, MEWING HEAP. 'PLEASE, OH PLEASE DON'T HURT US,' THEY WAIL.  'WE KNOW NOTHING.  WE ARE POOR LOST SOULS LOOKING FOR OUR HOMES.' (WHAT DO YOU DO?)
entries.text: 那群小妖魔癱成可憐兮兮、嗚咽成一團的一堆。「求求你們，別傷害我們，」牠們哀號，「我們什麼都不知道，只是找不到家的可憐蟲。」（你們要怎麼做？）
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KOBOLDS FAWN ON YOU PATHETICALLY.  'PLEASE, OH PLEASE NOBLE ONES, DON'T HURT US,' THEY BEG.  'WE WERE SENT ON A SCOUTING MISSION BY OUR KING.  RUMORS OF A WONDROUS POOL CAME TO HIM IN HIS LAIR.
entries.text: 那群小妖魔可憐兮兮地向你們獻媚。「求求高貴的各位，別傷害我們，」牠們哀求，「我們是奉王命出來探路的。有一池奇妙之水的傳聞傳到了他的巢穴。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。接下一段。

entries.source: THE KOBOLDS HERD YOU TOWARD YOUR PRISON. SOME NAB BITS OF YOUR EQUIPMENT AND LEAVE.
entries.text: 小妖魔把你們趕往牢房，途中有幾隻順走了一些裝備就走開了。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE KOBOLDS SCAMPER QUICKLY AWAY.  JUST BEFORE PASSING OUT OF SIGHT, ONE TURNS AND RAISES HIS HAND IN A GESTURE, AS IF TO WAVE FAREWELL.
entries.text: 小妖魔一溜煙跑遠。就在消失前，其中一隻回過頭抬起手，像是在道別。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE LAST OF THE BUCCANNEERS FORM INTO A FINAL WAVE AND ATTACK.
entries.text: 剩下的海盜集結成最後一波攻了上來。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。原版把 BUCCANEERS 拼成 BUCCANNEERS。

entries.source: THE LEADER ADVANCES.
entries.text: 領頭的走上前來。
entries.note: 遭遇敘述。

entries.source: THE LEADER SPEAKS, 'THE BOSS DON'T ALLOW YOUR KIND IN HIS TERRITORY.  LEAVE NOW OR WE'LL HAVE TO RUN YOU IN.' (WHAT DO YOU DO?)
entries.text: 領頭的開口：「老大不准你們這種人進他的地盤。現在就走，不然我們就要動手抓人了。」（你們要怎麼做？）
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE LIZARD MEN'S FEAR CHANGES TO RAGE AND THEY THROW THEIR BARRELS OF CONTAMINANT ON THE PARTY.
entries.text: 蜥蜴人的恐懼化成暴怒，把成桶的污染物潑向隊伍。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: THE LOWER CHAMBER IS FILLED WITH GLASS AND FUR OBJECTS OF ALL TYPES.
entries.text: 下層室內堆滿各式玻璃與毛皮製品。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE MAD MAN SUDDENLY BEGINS TO SCREAM AND ATTACK EVERYONE WITHIN ARM'S REACH.
entries.text: 那個瘋子突然尖叫起來，見人就打。
entries.note: 瘋子事件。

entries.source: THE MAIN WALL RISES 30 FEET WHILE THE TWO WATCHTOWER RISE TO 50 FEET. LOUNGING AROUND THE ENTRANCE ARE A GROUP OF BUGBEARS.
entries.text: 主牆高三十呎，兩座瞭望塔高五十呎。入口附近懶散地聚著一群熊地精。
entries.note: 史塔傑諾門一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE MAN DIES A CRUEL DEATH.
entries.text: 那人死得很慘。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE MAN RUNS SCREAMING INTO THE BACK OF THE BOOTH.
entries.text: 那人尖叫著跑進攤子後面。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE MAN SCREAMS WHILE FROTHING AT THE MOUTH,
entries.text: 那人口吐白沫，一邊尖叫著
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。片段。

entries.source: THE MAN TAKES THE POTION AND GULPS IT GREEDILY.  AS YOU WATCH, HE SEEMS TO GROW YOUNGER AND STRONGER. 'EXCELLENT,' HE SMACKS, 'YOUR REWARD.'
entries.text: 那人接過藥水，貪婪地一飲而盡。你們看著他彷彿變得更年輕、更強壯。「太好了。」他咂了咂嘴，「你們的報酬。」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE MAN THEN LEAVES AND BEFORE YOU IS THE SLEAZY MERCHANT.  HE BEGS FORGIVENESS THEN WIMPERS AWAY.
entries.text: 那人離開後，眼前只剩那名下流的商人。他連聲討饒，然後嗚咽著走開。
entries.note: 海盜據點。原版把 WHIMPERS 拼成 WIMPERS。

entries.source: THE MAN THEN SPEAKS A WORD AND THE AUCTIONEER'S BLOCK IS ENVELOPED IN DARKNESS.
entries.text: 那人念了一個字，拍賣台隨即被黑暗吞沒。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THE MAN WAITS IMPATIENTLY.
entries.text: 那人不耐煩地等著。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE MEN SNEER AT THE KING AND ONE SAYS,'LET US SHOW YOU HOW WARRIORS FIGHT.'
entries.text: 那兩個人朝王冷笑，其中一個說：「讓你見識見識戰士怎麼打。」
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE MINUTE YOU FIND THE TREASURE A LARGE GROUP OF ORCS CHARGE THROUGH THE TEMPLE DOORS.  LEADING THEM IS A HALF-ORC WHO IS SCREAMING 'KILL!  KILL, THESE SCUM WHO WOULD STEAL FROM OUR TEMPLE.'
entries.text: 你們一找到寶藏，一大群半獸人就從神廟大門衝了進來，領頭的半獸人尖叫著：「殺！殺了這些膽敢偷我們神廟東西的渣滓。」
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: THE MOANING CONTINUES.
entries.text: 呻吟聲持續著。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE MONSTERS LOOK AROUND FOR A SCAPEGOAT. THEIR EYES FALL UPON YOUR PARTY, THEN THEY
entries.text: 怪物四下張望想找個替罪羊，目光落在你們身上，接著牠們
entries.note: 片段。

entries.source: THE MONSTERS PREPARE
entries.text: 怪物準備
entries.note: 片段。

entries.source: THE MONSTERS RESPOND, 'DA BOSS DON'T LIKE YOUSE GUYS. GIVE US SUMPTIN AN MAYBE WE'LL FERGET WE SEEN YAS.' (WHAT DO YOU DO?)
entries.text: 怪物回話：「老大不喜歡你們這票人。給點好處，說不定我們就當沒看見。」（你們要怎麼做？）
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。原版此處刻意用不標準的口語。

entries.source: THE MONSTERS ROB AND BLINDFOLD YOU. YOU ARE KICKED SOUNDLY AND SENT ON YOUR WAY.
entries.text: 怪物搶了你們的東西，蒙住你們的眼，狠狠踹了幾腳才放人。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE MONSTERS SCREAM 'OH YEAH, WELL I GUESS WERE JUST GONNA HAVE TO TEACH YOUSE GUYS A LESSON OR TWO'  THEY RUSH FOWARD TO ATTACK.
entries.text: 怪物大叫：「是喔，那看來我們得給你們這票人上一兩課了。」牠們衝上前來攻擊。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。原版此處刻意用不標準的口語，並把 FORWARD 拼成 FOWARD。

entries.source: THE MONSTERS SHOOT YOU ANGRY LOOKS,
entries.text: 怪物朝你們投來惡狠狠的目光，
entries.note: 片段。

entries.source: THE MONSTERS STAND READY
entries.text: 怪物嚴陣以待
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THE MYSTIC MAN SPEAKS, 'THE VAMPIRE IS BEHIND THE NORTHERN WALL.'
entries.text: 那名神祕人說：「吸血鬼就在北牆後面。」
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE NOISE HAS DISTURBED SOMETHING. WITH A BEATING OF WINGS, A HUGE BEAST LANDS UPON YOU.
entries.text: 聲響驚動了什麼。一陣振翅之後，一頭巨獸落到你們頭上。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: THE NOMADS WAIT FOR YOU TO MAKE THE FIRST MOVE.
entries.text: 遊牧民等著你們先動。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: THE OGRE IS TACKLED AND SEARCHED. HE DOESN'T HAVE THE ITEM ON HIM.
entries.text: 食人鬼被撲倒搜身，東西不在牠身上。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THE OLD BLIND ORC PAWS THE CHARACTERS LOOKING FOR SOMETHING.  FINDING THE LEATHER HOLY SYMBOL, HE SMILES THEN GRUNTS 'WELCOME TO THE TEMPLE OF BANE, SUPREME GOD OF THE REALMS.'
entries.text: 那隻盲眼老半獸人在隊員身上摸索著找東西。摸到那枚皮製聖徽後，他笑了，低聲說：「歡迎來到邪惡神廟，祂是這片國度的至高神。」
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: THE OLD BLIND ORC PAWS THE PARTY AS IF LOOKING FOR SOMETHING.  AFTER A CAREFULL PAWING, HE BACKS AWAY AND YELLS 'GUARDS, IN THE NAME OF BANE, KILL THESE UNBELIEVERS!'
entries.text: 那隻盲眼老半獸人在隊伍身上摸索，像在找什麼。仔細摸過一遍後，他退開大喊：「守衛，以邪惡神之名，殺了這些異教徒！」
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。原版把 CAREFUL 拼成 CAREFULL。

entries.source: THE OLD LIZARD MAN RECOGNIZES THE WORD AND HIS LIPS PART IN A TOOTHY GRIN. YOU ALL GATHER CLOSE AS HE BEGINS HIS STORY.
entries.text: 那名年老的蜥蜴人認得這個字，咧開嘴露出滿口利齒。你們湊近圍好，聽他說起故事。
entries.note: 沼澤的蜥蜴人部族。

entries.source: THE OLD THIEF LAUGHS, 'PERHAPS WE SHALL MEET AGAIN.'
entries.text: 那名年長的盜賊笑道：「或許我們還會再見。」
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE ORC SMILES CROOKEDLY.'GREETINGS FROM BANE.
entries.text: 那隻半獸人歪嘴一笑：「邪惡神向你們問好。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。接下一段。

entries.source: THE ORCS READY THEIR SPEARS
entries.text: 半獸人舉起長矛
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THE ORCS YELL OUT, 'WE HAVE ORDERS TO CHECK OUT SUSPICIOUS INDIVIDUALS, BUT YOUSE GUYS LOOK HARMLESS ENOUGH.'  AFTER TALKING THE FOUR ORCS WANDER AWAY.
entries.text: 半獸人喊道：「上頭要我們盤查可疑的人，不過你們這票看起來人畜無害。」說完那四隻半獸人就晃走了。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THE OUTLINE OF A SAD-FACED MAN WAVERS AND FADES AWAY.
entries.text: 一個愁容男子的輪廓晃了晃，消散了。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE OVERSEER TURNS TOWARD YOU BLUDGEON IN HAND. 'GO ON! GET OUT OF MY KITCHEN OR I'LL THROW BOILING OIL ON YOU!'
entries.text: 工頭手持大棒轉向你們：「走開！滾出我的廚房，不然我就把滾油潑到你們身上！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE PARTY HEARS THE CRACKING OF GLASS.  A POISONOUS GAS FILLS THE AIR!
entries.text: 隊伍聽到玻璃碎裂的聲音，毒氣瞬間瀰漫開來！
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: THE PARTY RUNS AND ESCAPES.
entries.text: 隊伍拔腿逃了出去。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THE PRIEST SHOUTS, 'WHAT'S THIS? YOU AREN'T WORSHIPPERS OF LORD BANE! DIE IMPOSTERS!' HE GRABS THE LAST RHINESTONE FROM A NECKLACE AND THROWS IT AT YOU. A FIREBALL EXPLODES!
entries.text: 那名祭司大喝：「這是怎麼回事？你們根本不是邪惡神的信徒！冒牌貨去死！」他從項鍊上摘下最後一顆水鑽擲向你們，一團火球轟然炸開！
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE PRIESTS OF TEMPUS BID YOU WELCOME.
entries.text: 坦帕斯神殿的僧侶歡迎你們。
entries.note: 地點敘述。

entries.source: THE PRIESTS OF TYR WELCOME YOU TO THE TEMPLE.
entries.text: 提爾神殿的僧侶歡迎你們入內。
entries.note: 地點敘述。

entries.source: THE PRINCESS SAYS,'I SHALL GO MY OWN WAY NOW, BUT YOU WILL ALWAYS BE REMEMBERED. GOOD HUNTING.'
entries.text: 公主說：「我要走自己的路了，但各位我永誌不忘。祝你們順利。」
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE RECORDS PROVIDE INSIGHTS INTO MUCH THAT WAS PUZZLING.
entries.text: 這些記錄解開了不少一直想不通的事。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE REMAINING GUARDS DECIDE TO LEAVE YOU ALONE.
entries.text: 剩下的守衛決定不再找你們麻煩。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE REMAINS OF A SMOKING FIRE.
entries.text: 一堆還冒著煙的火堆殘跡。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE REMAINS OF AN EVIL ALTAR ARE NEARBY.
entries.text: 附近有一座邪惡祭壇的殘跡。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: THE REMAINS OF SEVERAL OF THE ANHKHEG'S VICTIM.  ADMIST THE DEBRIS IS SOME TREASURE.
entries.text: 幾名掘地蟲獵物的殘骸。碎屑之間有一些財寶。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。原版把 AMIDST 拼成 ADMIST。

entries.source: THE RIDERS ESCORT YOU INTO THE OUTPOST.
entries.text: 那些騎兵護送你們進入前哨。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE ROOF COLLAPSES.
entries.text: 屋頂塌了下來。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE ROOM IS DIRTY AND HAS A STRONG AND UNPLEASANT ODOR.
entries.text: 房間很髒，還有一股濃烈的臭味。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE ROOM IS FILLED WITH DUELING PAIRS.
entries.text: 房裡到處都是兩兩對決的人。
entries.note: 訓練所與競技場。

entries.source: THE SCROLL IS PLACED IN YOUR JOURNAL AS ENTRY 43.
entries.text: 那卷卷軸被放進手冊，成為線索報導 43。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE SHAPE SPEAKS, 'I AM THE LIFE FORM OF FERRAN MARTINEZ, BOUND WITH THE UNDEAD SPIRITS OF ALL WHO DIE WITHIN THESE WALLS TO GUARD THE KEEP. TELL ME, HAS THE CITY BEEN FREED?'
entries.text: 那身影開口：「我是費瑞·馬提茲的生命形體，與所有死在這道城牆內的亡魂縛在一起，守著這座城堡。告訴我，那座城自由了嗎？」
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE SHOP SELLS SILVER ITEMS. 'WOULD YOU LIKE TO SEE OUR SELECTION?'
entries.text: 這家店賣銀器。「要看看我們的貨嗎？」
entries.note: 商店。

entries.source: THE SHOP SPECIALIZES IN ARMS AND ARMOR. 'CAN I SHOW YOU OUR WARES?'
entries.text: 這家店專賣武器與護甲。「要我拿貨給你們看嗎？」
entries.note: 商店。

entries.source: THE SHOPKEEPER GREETS YOU AND OFFERS YOU ITEMS FOR SALE. 'CAN I SHOW YOU SOMETHING?'
entries.text: 店主招呼你們，開始兜售商品。「要我拿些東西給你們看嗎？」
entries.note: 商店。

entries.source: THE SHOPKEEPER OFFERS JEWELRY FOR SALE. 'CAN I SHOW YOU SOMETHING?'
entries.text: 店主賣的是珠寶。「要我拿些東西給你們看嗎？」
entries.note: 商店。

entries.source: THE SIX SCRIBES DIVE FOR COVER AS THE TWO OFFICERS ATTACK.
entries.text: 六名文書撲向掩蔽，兩名軍官同時攻了上來。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE SKELETON OF A LONG-DEAD ELF LIES HIDDEN BY ROCKS AND REEDS.  ITS WEAPONS AND EQUIPMENT ARE BADLY RUSTED AND CORRODED BY SALT, ITS LEATHERS ARE WORM EATEN AND CRUSTED IN DIRT.
entries.text: 一具死去多時的精靈骸骨被岩石與蘆葦掩著。牠的武器與裝備鏽蝕嚴重、被鹽分侵蝕，皮件則被蟲蛀、結滿塵垢。
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE SKY DARKENS.
entries.text: 天色暗了下來。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE SLAVES CHEER YOUR VICTORY.  A LARGE GROUP OF BUCCANEERS STANDS IN DISBELIEF.  THE BUCCANEERS PART AS A LARGE MAN IN GLEAMING CHAIN MAIL STEPS FORTH.  THE SLAVES FALL SILENT.
entries.text: 奴隸為你們的勝利歡呼。一大群海盜難以置信地站著。人群分開，一名身穿亮甲的高大男子走了出來，奴隸頓時安靜下來。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: THE SLUMS IMMEDIATELY TO OUR WEST NEED TO BE CLEARED OF MONSTERS.'
entries.text: 我們西邊那片貧民區的怪物必須清掉。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE SMITH (A HUMAN) AND THREE FIRE GIANTS ARE WORKING ON A SUIT OF ARMOR. PILED UP OUT OF THE WAY ARE AN ASSORTMENT OF WEAPONS AND ARMOR.
entries.text: 鐵匠（一名人類）和三名火巨人正在打一套護甲。角落堆著各式武器與護甲。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE SMITH IGNORES YOU AS HE HAMMERS ON A GREAVE.
entries.text: 鐵匠只顧著捶打護脛，沒理會你們。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE SMITH LOOKS UP FROM HIS WORK. 'WHAT DO YOU NEED?'
entries.text: 鐵匠從活兒裡抬起頭：「要什麼？」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE SMITHY WIPES HIS BROW AND SAYS, 'NO, YOU NEVER GET TOTALLY USED TO THE HEAT, BUT IT'S NOT THAT BAD. NOW, IF YOU'LL EXCUSE ME I NEED TO GET BACK TO WORK.'
entries.text: 鐵匠抹了抹額頭：「不，這熱氣沒人能完全習慣，不過也還好。恕我失陪，我得回去做事了。」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE SOUND OF WAR CRIES DRAWS YOU OUT OF THE HUT.
entries.text: 喊殺聲把你們引出了帳篷。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: THE SPECTRE HAS NOTICED YOU.
entries.text: 那隻幽魂發現你們了。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE TELLING IS FINISHED. (WHAT DO YOU DO?)
entries.text: 話說完了。（你們要怎麼做？）
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE TEMPLE GUARDS INFORM YOU THAT THE BISHOP IS NOT RECEIVING VISITORS AT THIS TIME.  WHAT DO YOU DO?
entries.text: 神殿衛兵告訴你們，主教這時候不見客。你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 提爾神殿。

entries.source: THE TIME IS NIGH WHEN THE PATHS YOU HAVE TROD WILL EMPTY AND YOU MUST SEEK NEW WAYS.  THE RIDDLE'S ANSWER IS GREAT EVIL USING GREAT GOOD FOR GREAT EVIL.
entries.text: 你們走過的路即將走盡，該去尋新路了。這道謎的答案是：大惡假大善之名，行大惡之事。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。算命內容。

entries.source: THE TOWER DOOR SWINGS OPEN AND A SMALL ARMY OF ZOMBIES SHUFFLES OUT.  THE DOOR CLOSES WITH A CLAMOR OF LOCKS FALLING INTO PLACE.
entries.text: 塔門敞開，一小支殭屍軍拖著腳步走了出來。門隨即關上，鎖扣落下的聲響此起彼落。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE TOWER GUARDS ATTACK.
entries.text: 塔上的守衛動手了。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE TUNNEL BEGINS TO SLOPE UP.
entries.text: 隧道開始往上斜。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE TWO ENVOYS WAIT AT THE THRONE. THEY SMILE. 'A REMATCH THEN. PREPARE FOR DEATH.'
entries.text: 兩名使節在王座旁等著，臉上帶笑：「那就再打一場。準備受死吧。」
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THE UNDEAD ARE CROSSING THE RIVER IN HORDES AND KILLING OR CARRYING OFF OUR SETTLERS.  THE COUNCIL DEMANDS THESE ATTACKS BE STOPPED. A GENEROUS REWARD IS OFFERED.'
entries.text: 不死怪物成群渡河而來，殺害或擄走我們的移民。議會要求制止這些襲擊，並提供優厚報酬。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE UNDEAD LEAVE.
entries.text: 不死怪物離開了。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE VAMPIRE TURNS INTO A VAPOR CLOUD AND FLOATS AWAY.
entries.text: 吸血鬼化成一團霧氣飄走了。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE WALL IS CLIMBABLE HERE, WILL YOU SCALE OVER IT?
entries.text: 這一段牆爬得上去。要翻過去嗎？
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE WALLS ARE LINED WITH FLASKS AND BOTTLES CONTAINING POWDERS, OILS, OINTMENTS, AND DRAUGHTS. THESE ARE SURELY OF AN ALCHEMICAL NATURE.
entries.text: 牆邊排滿了瓶瓶罐罐，裝著粉末、油劑、藥膏與湯藥，顯然都是煉金之物。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: THE WATER LOOKS COLD AND DEEP. DO YOU WANT TO DIVE IN?
entries.text: 水看起來又冷又深。要潛下去嗎？
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THE WAY IS BLOCKED.
entries.text: 路被擋住了。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE WHINE SUBSIDES AS THE PRESSURE IS RELEASED.
entries.text: 壓力洩去，那陣尖鳴也跟著減弱。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: THE WOMAN SAYS 'TYRANTHRAXUS IS LEADING OUR MEN TO THEIR DEATHS. IF YOU INTEND TO KILL HIM WE WILL HELP. USE THESE CLOTHES AS A DISGUISE AND YOU WILL ESCAPE NOTICE.
entries.text: 那女子說：「泰蘭特拉克斯正把我們的男人送去送死。你們若打算殺牠，我們願意幫忙。拿這些衣服偽裝，就不會被注意到。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。接下一段。

entries.source: THE WOMAN'S HANDS MAKE MYSTIC PASSAGES WHILE SHE MUTTERS SOME WORDS.  HER VOICE UNDERGOES A STRANGE TRANSFORMATION ...
entries.text: 那女人雙手比劃著神祕的手勢，口中念念有詞。她的聲音起了奇異的變化……
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THE WOMEN SHRIEK AND FLEE BEFORE YOU AS YOU CHOP THEM DOWN. THE HALF-ORC WOMAN WITH HATE IN HER EYES SNARLS 'HEROES! HAH!' THEN HER EYES GLAZE AS SHE DIES.
entries.text: 婦人們尖叫著在你們刀下四散奔逃。那名半獸人女子眼裡滿是恨意，啐道：「英雄？哈！」隨即目光渙散，斷了氣。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THEIR LEADER SAYS 'FOUL SERVANTS OF YARASH!'
entries.text: 領頭的喝道：「亞拉斯的卑鄙走狗！」
entries.note: 野外。

entries.source: THEN FEEL MY WRATH!
entries.text: 那就嘗嘗我的怒火！
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THEN LEAVE AND BID YOU GOOD DAY.
entries.text: 然後離開，向你們道別。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THEN YOU MUST LEAVE.
entries.text: 那你們得離開。
entries.note: 敘述。

entries.source: THERE ARE FOUR GUARDS HERE.  THEIR LEADER SAYS, 'YOU ARE RESTRICTED TO YOUR QUARTERS.   RETURN TO THEM NOW.'  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 這裡有四名守衛，領頭的說：「你們被限制在住處，現在就回去。」你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THERE ARE LARGE SILVER HOLY SYMBOLS UP AND DOWN THE CRACK IN THE DOORWAY.
entries.text: 門縫上下嵌著幾枚碩大的銀製聖徽。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THERE ARE TWO HUMANS AND THREE ETTIN IN THE ROOM.
entries.text: 房裡有兩個人類和三隻雙頭巨魔。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。Ettin 為新增譯名。

entries.source: THERE ARE TWO THRI-KREEN HERE.  THEY BLOCK THE PASSAGE WITH THEIR BODIES.  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 這裡有兩隻昆蟲人，牠們用身體堵住通道。你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THERE IS A BOAT DOCKED HERE THAT WILL RETURN YOU TO THE CIVILIZED SECTION OF PHLAN.  WILL YOU TAKE IT?
entries.text: 這裡停著一艘船，可以載你們回菲蘭城的文明區。要搭嗎？
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: THERE IS A BOAT HERE THAT WILL TAKE YOU BACK TO THE CIVILISED SECTION OF PHLAN.  WILL YOU TAKE IT?
entries.text: 這裡有一艘船，可以載你們回菲蘭城的文明區。要搭嗎？
entries.note: 城郊出入口。

entries.source: THERE IS A FEELING OF SOMETHING IMMENSE AND EVIL STARING DOWN AT YOU...
entries.text: 你們感覺到某個龐大而邪惡的東西正俯視著自己……
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THERE IS A FREE MAN HERE. WHAT DO YOU DO?
entries.text: 這裡有個獲釋的人。你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THERE IS A GLOW IN THE NORTHWESTERN CORNER OF THE ROOM.
entries.text: 房間西北角有一團光。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THERE IS A HEDGE WITH POISONOUS THORNS IN THAT DIRECTION. DO YOU WANT TO TRY TO CUT THROUGH?
entries.text: 那個方向有一道長滿毒刺的樹籬。要試著砍出一條路嗎？
entries.note: 瓦傑渥城堡內部。

entries.source: THERE IS A HOLE IN THE WALL THAT LEADS TO THE OUTSIDE. DO YOU GO THROUGH IT?
entries.text: 牆上有個通往外面的洞。要鑽過去嗎？
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: THERE IS A SEEDY LITTLE MAN HERE WHO WHISPERS 'PSSST, BUDDY.  WANT TO BUY A PASS TO SEE THE CAPTAIN?'
entries.text: 這裡有個賊頭賊腦的小個子低聲說：「喂，朋友。要不要買張見隊長的通行證？」
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: THERE IS A STEEP RUBBLED SLOPE. WILL YOU GO UP?
entries.text: 有一道陡峭的瓦礫坡。要爬上去嗎？
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THERE IS A VAMPIRE HERE.
entries.text: 這裡有一隻吸血鬼。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THERE IS AN ENORMOUS EXPLOSION! BITS OF PIPE AND OTHER PLUMBING FIXTURES FLY IN ALL DIRECTIONS.
entries.text: 一聲巨響炸開！管線碎片與各種配件朝四面八方飛散。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: THERE IS GREAT CONFUSION AS THE GUARDS RUN TO THEIR POSTS.
entries.text: 守衛紛紛奔向崗位，場面一片混亂。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: THERE IS MASS CONFUSION AS THE ANIMALS RUN AROUND THE COMPOUND.  GUARDS ARE LEAVING THEIR POSTS IN ORDER TO CONTROL THE ANIMALS.
entries.text: 牲口在營區裡亂竄，場面一片混亂。守衛紛紛離開崗位去趕牲口。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: THERE IS MASS CONFUSION. SUDDENLY, THE OGRE SPRINTS FROM THE DARKNESS.
entries.text: 場面一片混亂。忽然，那隻食人鬼從黑暗中衝了出來。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THERE IS NO ROOM IN YOUR PARTY FOR HIM.
entries.text: 你們的隊伍沒有位置給他。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THESE ARE THE LIBRARY STACKS. OLD AND MOLDERING BOOKS ARE STORED ON SHELVES. A SIGN OVER THE ENTRANCE READS
entries.text: 這裡是書庫，架上堆著發霉的舊書。入口上方的牌子寫著
entries.note: 舊繩索公會的圖書室。片段，後接書名。

entries.source: THESE HISTORIES CONTAIN MUCH USEFUL INFORMATION.
entries.text: 這些史料裡有很多有用的東西。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THESE MAPS SHOULD HELP US TO LOCATE SEVERAL LEGENDARY BUILDINGS.
entries.text: 這些地圖應該能幫我們找出幾座傳說中的建築。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THEURGIST
entries.text: 術士
entries.note: AD&D 等級稱號（魔法師）。

entries.source: THEY ADVANCE, WEAPONS READY
entries.text: 牠們舉著武器逼近
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THEY ARE AS SURPRISED AS YOU.
entries.text: 牠們和你們一樣措手不及。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THEY ARE WARY, BUT NOT HOSTILE.
entries.text: 牠們戒備著，但沒有敵意。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: THEY ATTACK YOU.
entries.text: 牠們攻擊你們。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THEY ATTACK.
entries.text: 牠們發動攻擊。
entries.note: 遭遇敘述。

entries.source: THEY CHECK OUT YOUR PARTY,
entries.text: 牠們把你們的隊伍打量一番，
entries.note: 片段。

entries.source: THEY COME RUNNING TOWARD YOU.
entries.text: 牠們朝你們奔來。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THEY DESCRIBE THE SURROUNDING AREA TO YOU. YOU LISTEN CAREFULLY, QUESTION THEM AND FROM THIS, SKETCH A MAP INTO YOUR JOURNAL CALLING IT ENTRY 10.
entries.text: 牠們把附近的地形說給你們聽。你們仔細聽、細細問，據此在手冊裡畫了一張圖，編為線索報導 10。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THEY DIDN'T LIKE THAT WORD.
entries.text: 牠們不喜歡這個字。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THEY DON'T LISTEN.
entries.text: 牠們不理會。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THEY GLARE AT YOUR PARTY,
entries.text: 牠們瞪著你們的隊伍，
entries.note: 片段。

entries.source: THEY GRUMBLE AND MOVE ON.
entries.text: 牠們咕噥著走開了。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THEY HELP YOU PUT ON THE CLOTHES. 'HAVE NO FEAR.
entries.text: 他們幫你們把衣服穿上：「別怕。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。接下一段。

entries.source: THEY HOLD THEIR WEAPONS READY.
entries.text: 牠們握緊了武器。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THEY PAW THROUGH YOUR COINS AND LEAVE.
entries.text: 他們翻了翻你們的錢就走了。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THEY PLEAD FOR MERCY.
entries.text: 他們跪地求饒。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THEY RAISE THEIR CLUBS. 'YOU STOLE FROM LORD BANE'S TEMPLE!'
entries.text: 牠們舉起棍棒：「你們偷了邪惡神廟的東西！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THEY RECOIL IN FEAR
entries.text: 牠們嚇得退開
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: THEY RUSH TOWARD YOU
entries.text: 牠們朝你們衝過來
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THEY SEEM UNAWARE OF YOU.
entries.text: 牠們似乎沒有察覺你們。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THEY STAND ARMS RAISED IN SURRENDER.
entries.text: 他們舉起雙手投降。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THEY TURN TO DIVE BACK IN THE WATER.
entries.text: 牠們轉身要潛回水裡。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: THEY YELL 'SETTLERS! KILL THEM!'
entries.text: 牠們大喊：「移民！殺了他們！」
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: THIEVES
entries.text: 盜賊
entries.note: 怪物名。與職業 Thief（賊）分開用字，避免混淆。

entries.source: THINGS SEEM STRANGELY QUIET. THE DRUM HAS FADED TO SILENCE.
entries.text: 四下靜得出奇，鼓聲已經停了。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THIS BUILDING IS FILLED WITH BROKEN AND SPLINTERED WOOD, THE REMAINS OF THE BUNKS AND CHESTS OF THE ORIGINAL DEFENDERS.  IT SEEMS EVERYTHING HAS BEEN WELL LOOTED.
entries.text: 這棟建築裡滿是碎裂的木料，是當年守軍的床鋪與箱櫃殘骸。看來所有東西都被搜刮乾淨了。
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THIS CABINET IS EMPTY.
entries.text: 這個櫃子是空的。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: THIS CASKET IS EMPTY.
entries.text: 這個小箱是空的。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: THIS CAVERNOUS BUILDING SERVES AS A BARRACKS.
entries.text: 這棟空蕩的建築被當成營房。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THIS DIRECTION WILL TAKE YOU BACK INTO THE WILDERNESS. DO YOU STILL WANT TO GO THIS WAY?
entries.text: 這個方向會把你們帶回荒野。還要往這邊走嗎？
entries.note: 野外。

entries.source: THIS IS A HIDDEN TEMPLE OF ILMATER. YOU FEEL SAFE HERE.
entries.text: 這是一座隱密的伊爾梅特神殿，在這裡你們覺得安全。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。Ilmater 為新增譯名。

entries.source: THIS IS A SMALL CELL. CHAINED TO THE WALL IS A MAN BEATEN TO WITHIN AN INCH OF HIS LIFE. AS YOU OPEN THE DOOR HE LOOKS UP AND YOU FEEL A SHOCK... THE MAN IS PORPHYRYS CADORNA.
entries.text: 這是一間小牢房。牆上鎖著一個被打得只剩一口氣的人。你們一開門，他抬起頭來——你們心頭一震……那人正是普洛菲力·卡多納。
entries.note: 瓦傑渥城堡內部。

entries.source: THIS IS A SMALL SHRINE. SYMBOLS OF BANE HAVE REPLACED THOSE OF ILMATER.
entries.text: 這是一座小祠堂，伊爾梅特的聖徽已被邪惡神的取代。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: THIS IS THE DESK OF YARASH. ON IT IS A LITTER OF PAPERS.
entries.text: 這是亞拉斯的書桌，上面散著一堆文件。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: THIS IS THE LIVING AREAS. FEMALE AND CHILD KOBOLDS FLEE.
entries.text: 這是起居區，母小妖魔與幼崽四散奔逃。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THIS LARGE ROOM IS APPARENTLY EMPTY.
entries.text: 這間大房間看來是空的。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THIS LOSS OF THE KOBOLD FORCES WILL BE A MAJOR BLOW TO THE ENEMY.
entries.text: 小妖魔的兵力折損，對敵方是一大打擊。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THIS MATERIAL IS OF SMALL VALUE.
entries.text: 這份資料價值不高。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THIS ROOM HAS HAD BLOOD SMEARED ON THE FLOOR AND WALLS IN A RITUAL, UNHOLY MANNER.
entries.text: 這房間的地板與牆上塗滿血跡，是某種邪穢儀式的樣式。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THIS ROOM IS DIMLY LIT WITH GUTTERING TORCHES.
entries.text: 房裡點著幾支忽明忽滅的火把，光線昏暗。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THIS ROOM IS FILLED WITH HUMAN BONES.
entries.text: 這間屋子裡堆滿了人骨。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THIS ROOM WAS ONCE A STUDY. IT IS NOW A SHATTERED RUIN.
entries.text: 這裡本來是書房，如今只剩一片殘破。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THIS TOWER IS OCCUPIED BY FOUR GIANTS. AS YOU COME IN THEY ARE IN THE MIDST OF AN ARGUMENT. THE BIGGEST ONE TURNS TO YOU AND SAYS, 'THEM LOOK SMART. THEM TELL US.'
entries.text: 這座塔裡住著四名巨人。你們進去時牠們正在爭論。最大的那個轉向你們：「他們看起來聰明，讓他們說。」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版用不標準的口語。

entries.source: THIS WAS A PRISON CELL. BROKEN BINDINGS AND SIX DEAD KOBOLDS ARE STREWN ON THE FLOOR.
entries.text: 這裡曾是牢房，地上散著扯斷的束縛與六隻小妖魔的屍體。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THIS WAS ONCE THE CHAPEL OF THE KEEP.  INSIDE THE DOORWAY ARE THE DRIED HUSKS OF TWO ORCS, THEIR FACES TWISTED WITH TERROR.  A LARGE ALTAR DOMINATES THE SOUTHERN WALL.
entries.text: 這裡曾是城堡的禮拜堂。門內躺著兩具乾癟的半獸人屍殼，臉上滿是驚恐。南牆前立著一座大祭壇。
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: THREATEN IT
entries.text: 恐嚇牠
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THREE GIANTS STEP UP TO YOU.
entries.text: 三名巨人朝你們走來。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: THRI-KREENS
entries.text: 昆蟲人
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。怪物名，音近。

entries.source: THROUGH THE SMOKE AND DARKNESS, A DIMLY SEEN FIGURE FIRES AN ARROW INTO THE PARTY.  THE FIGURE FADES AWAY.
entries.text: 煙塵與黑暗之中，一個依稀可辨的身影朝隊伍射出一箭，隨即淡去。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: THROW A ROCK
entries.text: 丟石頭
entries.note: 遭遇選單。

entries.source: TIE THEM UP
entries.text: 把他們綁起來
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: TIGERS
entries.text: 老虎
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: TIMBERS LINE THE WALLS HERE. A BOULDER BLOCKS THE FAR END.
entries.text: 這裡的牆邊架著坑木，盡頭被一塊巨石堵住。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。
