entries.text: 你們在睡夢中遭到四名守衛襲擊
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE ATTACKED BY SOME GNOLLS.
entries.text: 幾隻豺狼人攻擊你們。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: YOU ARE ATTACKED BY WIGHTS.
entries.text: 你們遭到屍妖攻擊。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU ARE BEFORE THE ALTER.
entries.text: 你們站在祭壇前。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版把 ALTAR 拼成 ALTER。

entries.source: YOU ARE BEING APPROACHED BY SOME ANGRY
entries.text: 有一群怒氣沖沖的
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。片段，後接怪物名。

entries.source: YOU ARE BEING AVOIDED BY SOME
entries.text: 有幾隻在躲著你們
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。句子片段。

entries.source: YOU ARE BEING ESCORTED INTO ZHENTIL OUTPOST.
entries.text: 你們正被護送進漢提爾前哨。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE BLINDFOLDED AND TAKEN ON A LONG, TWISTING WALK, THEN UP A LADDER.'ONLY MEET US AT THE MAIN WELL.'
entries.text: 你們被蒙上眼，走了一段長而曲折的路，再爬上梯子。「以後只在大井那裡碰面。」
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU ARE BY THE GATEWAY TO THE UNSETTLED AREAS. THE CITY WATCH EYES YOU SUSPICIOUSLY.
entries.text: 你們就在通往未開發地區的門邊。城衛隊用懷疑的眼神打量你們。
entries.note: 地點敘述。

entries.source: YOU ARE CHASED OUT INTO THE STREETS.
entries.text: 你們被追到街上。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU ARE CONVERSING WITH
entries.text: 你們正在和
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。片段。

entries.source: YOU ARE ENTERING A WEEDY, GARBAGE STREWN COURTYARD. A DRUM BEGINS TO BEAT AND HOBGOBLINS ATTACK.
entries.text: 你們踏進一座雜草叢生、垃圾滿地的中庭。鼓聲響起，大哥布林攻了上來。
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU ARE FINDING A PATTERN TO TYRANTHRAXUS' ACTIVITIES. AT FIRST TYRANTHRAXUS' FOLLOWERS WERE AN UNSOPHISTICATED HORDE OF ILL ORGANIZED UNHUMANS.
entries.text: 你們漸漸看出泰蘭特拉克斯行事的規律。起初牠的追隨者不過是一群烏合之眾般的非人生物。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。接下一段。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A BUILDING FULL OF RECORDS.
entries.text: 你們在一棟堆滿檔案的建築裡。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A BUILDING THAT WAS ONCE A BARRACKS BUT HAS NOW BEEN CONVERTED TO A TEMPLE OF BANE. AT THE FAR END OF THE ROOM IS A CRUDE ALTER.
entries.text: 你們在一棟原本是營房、如今被改成邪惡神廟的建築裡。房間另一頭立著一座粗陋的祭壇。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版把 ALTAR 拼成 ALTER。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A CRUDE BARRACKS. ON ONE WALL IS A CRUDE MAP.
entries.text: 你們身在一間簡陋的營房，一面牆上釘著一張粗糙的地圖。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A DESERTED BUILDING. THERE ARE NOTHING BUT VERY LARGE COBWEBS HERE.
entries.text: 你們在一棟廢棄的建築裡，除了幾張巨大的蜘蛛網什麼也沒有。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版此處 THERE ARE 與單數不一致。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A DETERIORATED BUILDING.
entries.text: 你們在一棟破敗的建築裡。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A HALL WITH LONG TABLES, BENCHES AND A GREAT HEARTH AT ONE END. IN THE CORNERS ARE HEAPS OF GARBAGE BEING PICKED OVER BY SOME RATS WHICH FLEE AT YOUR ENTRANCE.
entries.text: 你們在一間大廳裡，擺著長桌與長凳，一端有座大火爐。角落堆著垃圾，幾隻老鼠正在翻找，見你們進來便四下逃開。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A LARGE ROOM WHICH SERVES AS A CRUDE TEMPLE, AND CAUSES A VAGUE FEELING OF DISQUIET.
entries.text: 你們在一間大屋裡，它被充作簡陋的神廟，讓人隱隱不安。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A ROOM FILLED WITH BROKEN STATUES. A HEAD BROKEN LOOSE FROM THE TORSO SHOWS A FACE FILLED WITH TERROR.
entries.text: 你們在一間滿是破碎雕像的房間裡。一顆從軀幹上斷落的頭顱，臉上滿是驚恐。
entries.note: 瓦傑渥城堡內部。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A ROOM FILLED WITH RUBBLE AND WASTE.
entries.text: 你們在一間堆滿瓦礫與廢物的屋子裡。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A ROOM FURNISHED WITH CHAIRS AND BENCHES.
entries.text: 你們在一間擺著椅子與長凳的房間裡。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A ROOM THAT HAS BEEN CONVERTED TO A JAIL CELL.  IT IS EMPTY.
entries.text: 你們在一間被改成牢房的房間裡，裡面空無一人。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A ROOM THAT IS FILLED WITH THE DEAD BODIES OF THE ORC'S PREVIOUS VICTIMS.
entries.text: 你們在一間堆滿屍體的屋子裡，都是半獸人先前的犧牲者。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A SMALL ROOM HAVING LITTLE MORE THAN A BENCH AND A SMALL DESK.
entries.text: 你們在一間小房間裡，除了一張長凳和一張小桌子，幾乎什麼都沒有。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A SMITHY.
entries.text: 你們在一間鐵匠鋪裡。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A STANDARD MEAT SMOKEHOUSE... WELL MAYBE NOT QUITE STANDARD. YOU FEEL A LITTLE SICK AS YOU LOOK AT THE MEAT. THE SMELL AND THE SMOKE DON'T HELP EITHER.
entries.text: 你們在一間普通的燻肉房裡……好吧，也許沒那麼普通。看著那些肉，你們有點反胃，那氣味和煙也幫不上忙。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A STOREROOM FULL OF COAL.
entries.text: 你們在一間堆滿煤的儲藏室裡。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A STOREROOM HOLDING A VAST COLLECTION OF MAGICAL JUNK.
entries.text: 你們身在一間貯藏室，裡面堆滿了各式各樣的魔法雜物。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A TAVERN.  THE AIR IS FILLED WITH SMOKE AND GOSSIP.  PEOPLE ARE GAMBLING AT THE TABLES.
entries.text: 你們在一間酒館裡，空氣中滿是煙味與閒話，桌邊有人在賭錢。
entries.note: 地點敘述。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A VERY SMALL, DARK ROOM.
entries.text: 你們在一間又小又暗的房間裡。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN AN EMPTY ROOM. THE ONLY FEATURE IS A TRAP DOOR IN THE CENTER. DO YOU OPEN IT?
entries.text: 你們在一間空屋裡，唯一的東西是正中央的一道活門。要打開嗎？
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN FRONT OF A DEEP POOL OF WATER. DO YOU WISH TO DIVE IN AND SEARCH IT?
entries.text: 你們面前是一池深水。要潛下去搜一搜嗎？
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN FRONT OF A MAGNIFICENT PYRAMID.  YOU HAVE FOUND A SECRET DOOR THAT LEADS INTO THE PYRAMID.  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們站在一座宏偉的金字塔前，找到了一道通往塔內的暗門。要怎麼做？
entries.note: 野外。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN THE AUDIENCE HALL OF TYRANTHRAXUS, CONQUEROR OF PHLAN. THE CEILING HAS BEEN TORN AWAY LEAVING THE ENTIRE SECTION OF THE TOWER OPEN TO THE SKY.
entries.text: 你們在菲蘭城征服者泰蘭特拉克斯的覲見廳裡。屋頂已被掀去，整段塔身就這麼敞向天空。
entries.note: 瓦傑渥城堡內部。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN THE DUSTY REMAINS OF A BLACK MARBLE CRYPT.
entries.text: 你們在一座黑色大理石墓室的塵封殘跡裡。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN THE ILLUMINATORS CARRELS. ALL THEIR EQUIPMENT HAS DECAYED AND LIES ROTTING ON THE FLOOR.
entries.text: 你們在繕寫師的小隔間裡，所有器具都腐朽了，散落一地。
entries.note: 舊繩索公會的圖書室。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN THE MERCHANTS' CAMP AREA.
entries.text: 你們在商人紮營的區域。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN THE REMAINS OF A ONCE GREAT DINING ROOM.  FURNITURE LIES BURNED AND BROKEN THROUGHOUT THE ROOM.
entries.text: 你們在一間曾經氣派的餐廳廢墟裡，家具被燒毀砸爛，散了一地。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN THE SLAVE PEN.  STANDING NEAR YOU IS THE YOUNG BOY.  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們在奴隸欄裡，那個男孩就站在旁邊。你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN YOUR QUARTERS.  WILL YOU WALK AROUND OR WILL YOU JUST RELAX UNTIL DINNER?
entries.text: 你們在住處裡。要四處走走，還是就這樣休息到晚餐？
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE INSIDE THE COMMANDANT'S OFFICE.  HE GREETS YOU AND YOU HAND HIM THE PAPERS.
entries.text: 你們在指揮官的辦公室裡。他招呼了你們，你們把文件交給他。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE INTERCEPTED BY THE COUNCIL GUARD. 'HALT.  YOUR PRESENCE IS NOT AUTHORIZED.  LEAVE.'  DO YOU LEAVE?
entries.text: 議會衛兵攔下你們：「站住。你們沒有獲准進入，離開。」你們要離開嗎？
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOU ARE JUST
entries.text: 你們就在
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。句子片段。

entries.source: YOU ARE JUST INSIDE THE MAIN GATE OF THE BUCCANEER'S BASE.  YOU ARE BEING TAKEN TO THE CENTER OF THE BASE WHERE THE MERCHANTS MAKE CAMP.
entries.text: 你們剛進海盜據點的大門，正被帶往據點中央商人紮營的地方。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU ARE JUST NORTH OF THE ENTRY TO THE OLD ROPE GUILD.
entries.text: 你們就在舊繩索公會入口的北邊。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU ARE JUST OUTSIDE A PEN FOR HOLDING SLAVES.  THE PEOPLE HERE ARE WORN AND BEATEN, DESTINED TO A LIFE OF SLAVERY.  AROUND THE PEN THERE ARE MANY GUARDS AND SLEAZY MERCHANTS LOOKING AT THE SLAVES.
entries.text: 你們就在關押奴隸的欄外。裡面的人個個憔悴、遍體鱗傷，注定要為奴一生。欄邊圍著不少守衛與下流的商人，正打量著這些奴隸。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU ARE JUST OUTSIDE AN UNGUARDED SLAVE PEN.
entries.text: 你們就在一座無人看守的奴隸欄外。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE JUST OUTSIDE SOME EMPTY ANIMAL PENS.
entries.text: 你們就在幾座空獸欄外。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE JUST OUTSIDE THE SLAVE PEN.
entries.text: 你們就在奴隸欄外面。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE JUST OUTSIDE THE SLAVE PEN.  AMOUNG THE SLAVES IS A YOUNG BOY WITH A HEART-SHAPED BIRTHMARK.
entries.text: 你們就在奴隸欄外。奴隸之中有個男孩，身上有一塊心形胎記。
entries.note: 海盜據點。原版把 AMONG 拼成 AMOUNG。

entries.source: YOU ARE LED TOWARD THE CENTRAL KEEP.
entries.text: 你們被領往中央的主堡。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE NEAR A DENSLY PACKED ANIMAL PEN.
entries.text: 你們就在一座擠滿牲口的獸欄旁。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。原版把 DENSELY 拼成 DENSLY。

entries.source: YOU ARE NEAR AN OPEN DOOR TO THE ANIMAL PENS.
entries.text: 你們就在獸欄一道敞開的門旁。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE NEAR THE FRONT GATE TO THE SLAVE PEN.  TWO GUARDS GUARD THE DOOR.  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們就在奴隸欄前門附近，兩名守衛看著門。你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE NEAR THE FRONT GATE.
entries.text: 你們就在前門附近。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE NEAR THE GATE TO THE SLAVE PEN.
entries.text: 你們就在奴隸欄的門附近。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE NEAR THE MAIN GATE TO THE COMPOUND.  SOME BUCCANEERS STAND GUARD NEAR THE ENTRANCE.
entries.text: 你們就在營區大門附近，幾名海盜在入口處守著。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE NO LONGER GOING DOWN. SUDDENLY YOU HEAR A NOISE. THERE ARE GIANT LIZARDS CHARGING! THERE IS NO TIME TO REACT. COMBAT IS UPON YOU!
entries.text: 路不再往下了。忽然一陣聲響——巨蜥衝了過來！根本來不及反應，戰鬥已經開始！
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU ARE NOTICED.
entries.text: 你們被發現了。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU ARE ON THE EASTERN EDGE OF THE CITY.  THERE ARE  NORTH AND SOUTH ENTRANCES INTO THE CITY AND A SMALL BOAT THAT YOU CAN TAKE TO THE CIVILISED AREA.  WHICH ROUTE WILL YOU TAKE?
entries.text: 你們位在城東邊緣。進城有北、南兩個入口，另外還有一艘小船可以載你們到文明區。要走哪一條？
entries.note: 城郊出入口。

entries.source: YOU ARE ON THE NORTH EDGE OF THE CITY.  WILL YOU ENTER THE NORTHERN CITY GATES OR ENTER THE GRAVEYARD?
entries.text: 你們位在城北邊緣。要走北城門，還是進墳場？
entries.note: 城郊出入口。

entries.source: YOU ARE ON THE WESTERN EDGE OF THE CITY.  THERE ARE TWO ENTERANCES INTO THE CITY, A NORTH ENTRANCE AND A SOUTH ENTRANCE.  WHICH ENTRANCE WILL YOU TAKE?
entries.text: 你們位在城西邊緣。進城有兩個入口，北入口與南入口。要走哪一個？
entries.note: 城郊出入口。原版把 ENTRANCES 拼成 ENTERANCES。

entries.source: YOU ARE OUTSIDE THE CITY HALL. THE CITY CLERK WAITS INSIDE TO AWARD COMMISSIONS.
entries.text: 你們站在市政廳外。書記官在裡面發放委託。
entries.note: 地點敘述。

entries.source: YOU ARE OUTSIDE THE CLERK'S OFFICE. GUARDS POSTED AROUND A DOOR IN THE SOUTH WALL WATCH YOU CLOSELY.
entries.text: 你們在書記官辦公室外。南牆那道門邊站著衛兵，緊盯著你們。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOU ARE ROUSTED BY THE CITY WATCH AND TOLD TO MOVE ALONG. WHAT DO YOU DO?
entries.text: 城衛隊把你們趕起來，要你們別逗留。你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 城衛隊事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE RUNNING OUT OF AIR...
entries.text: 你們快沒氣了……
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARE STRIPPED OF ALL VALUABLES AND BLINDFOLDED.  THE BANDITS RELEASE YOU SOMEWHERE ABOVE GROUND.
entries.text: 你們的財物被搜光、眼睛被蒙上。盜匪把你們放在地面上某處。
entries.note: 沼澤中的廢棄城堡，挪里斯的盜匪團。

entries.source: YOU ARE SUDDENLY CONFRONTED BY
entries.text: 你們突然遭遇了
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。片段。

entries.source: YOU ARE SUDDENLY FACE TO FACE WITH A GROUP OF
entries.text: 你們冷不防和一群
entries.note: 片段，後接怪物名。

entries.source: YOU ARE SUDDENLY FACE TO FACE WITH ARMED
entries.text: 你們冷不防與武裝的
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。句子片段。

entries.source: YOU ARE SUMMONED BY THE BISHOP OF BRACCIO OF TYR. REPORT TO HIM AT TYR'S TEMPLE.'
entries.text: 提爾神殿的巴西歐主教召見你們，到提爾神殿去見他。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOU ARE SUMMONED TO A SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING.  YOU ARE TO BE AWARDED A VALUABLE COMMISSION. THE CITY GUARDS WILL SHOW YOU THE WAY.'
entries.text: 議會召開特別會議，要授予你們一件重要的委託。城衛隊會帶路。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOU ARE SURPRISED BY
entries.text: 你們被偷襲了，來的是
entries.note: 同上。

entries.source: YOU ARE SURPRISED BY A GROUP OF
entries.text: 你們被一群
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。片段，後接怪物名。

entries.source: YOU ARE SURROUNDED BY THE BANDIT BAND OF THE INFAMOUS NORRIS THE  GRAY.  'YOU DARE TO INVADE MY HALLS?', HE SNARLS. 'SURRENDER OR DIE!'
entries.text: 你們被惡名昭彰的灰袍挪里斯的盜匪團團團圍住。「你們竟敢闖我的地盤？」他咆哮道，「投降不然就死！」
entries.note: 沼澤中的廢棄城堡，挪里斯的盜匪團。Norris the Gray 依說明書 p.42 作挪里斯。

entries.source: YOU ARE THROWN INTO A CELL BEREFT OF EQUIPMENT.
entries.text: 你們被扔進牢房，裝備全被搜走。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU ARE TREATED AS HONORED GUESTS FOR THE REST OF THE DAY. THERE ARE CONTESTS OF STRENGTH AND SKILL IN YOUR HONOR.
entries.text: 這一天剩下的時間，你們被奉為上賓。營地為你們辦了力與技的比試。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: YOU ARE USHERED INTO THE BISHOP'S STUDY. BISHOP BRACCIO SPEAKS, 'ALLOW ME TO INTRODUCE DIRTEN, PRIEST OF ILMAR.
entries.text: 你們被帶進主教的書房。巴西歐主教說：「讓我介紹伊爾梅特的僧侶迪爾騰。
entries.note: 提爾神殿；句子在原版就沒有收尾，接下一段。 原版把 ILMATER 拼成 ILMAR，譯名照定案作伊爾梅特。

entries.source: YOU ARE USHERED INTO THE STUDY WHERE DIRTEN WAITS.  'I AM ABOUT TO JOURNEY TO THE TEMPLE, WILL YOU COME WITH ME?'
entries.text: 你們被帶進書房，迪爾騰在裡面等著。「我正要動身去那座神殿，你們願意同行嗎？」
entries.note: 提爾神殿。

entries.source: YOU ARE WELCOMED BY PRIESTESS JOY OF SUNE.
entries.text: 蘇妮神殿的喬伊女祭司歡迎你們。
entries.note: 地點敘述。

entries.source: YOU ARRIVE AT THE OFFICERS MESS AND ARE SEATED WITH THE COMMANDANT AND HIS ADVISORS.  A FINE MEAL OF ROAST BOAR IS SERVED WITH A HEARTY RED WINE.
entries.text: 你們來到軍官食堂，與指揮官和他的顧問同席。上的是一頓豐盛的烤野豬，配著濃郁的紅酒。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ARRIVE BACK AT YOUR QUARTERS.
entries.text: 你們回到了住處。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ATTACK THE BUCCANEERS.
entries.text: 你們攻擊那群海盜。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ATTACK THE GUARDS.
entries.text: 你們攻擊守衛。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ATTACK THE GUARDS.  THE GUARDS SOUND AN ALARM AND ATTACK.
entries.text: 你們攻擊守衛。守衛拉響警報，反擊回來。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ATTACK THE TOWER GUARDS.
entries.text: 你們攻擊塔上的守衛。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ATTACKED THE CITY WATCH, YOU WON'T BEAT US SO EASILY!
entries.text: 你們攻擊了城衛隊，沒那麼容易打贏我們！
entries.note: 城衛隊事件。

entries.source: YOU AVOID THE TRAP BY NOT OPENING THE CABINET!
entries.text: 你們沒有打開櫃子，因此避開了陷阱！
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU AVOID THE TRAP BY NOT OPENING THE CASKET.
entries.text: 你們沒有打開小箱，因此避開了陷阱。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU AVOID THE TRAP BY NOT OPENNING THE CABINET.
entries.text: 你們沒有打開櫃子，因此避開了陷阱。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。原版此處把 OPENING 拼成 OPENNING。

entries.source: YOU BEGIN A LONG FALL.
entries.text: 你們開始長長地墜落。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU BOARD A BOAT.
entries.text: 你們上了船。
entries.note: 敘述。

entries.source: YOU BREAK THE SURFACE GASPING FOR AIR.
entries.text: 你們衝出水面大口喘氣。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU BREAK THE SURFACE JUST AS YOU BREATHE IN SOME WATER.
entries.text: 你們衝出水面，同時嗆進了一口水。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU BUMP INTO SOME
entries.text: 你們撞見了一些
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。片段，後接怪物名。

entries.source: YOU BURST INTO AN ELEGANTLY PANELLED ROOM. A SMALL MAN SITS HUNCHED OVER A TABLE BY THE EAST WALL. HE SETS DOWN HIS PEN AND GAZES STERNLY AT YOU.  'WELL?', HE DEMANDS.  (WHAT DO YOU DO?)
entries.text: 你們闖進一間鑲著雅緻壁板的屋子。東牆邊的桌前伏著一個瘦小的男人。他放下筆，嚴厲地盯著你們：「有事？」（你們要怎麼做？）
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU BUY THE PASS.  THE SEEDY LITTLE MAN DISAPPEARS AROUND A CORNER.
entries.text: 你們買下通行證。那個賊頭賊腦的小個子消失在轉角。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU BYPASS THE TRAP BY NOT FOOLING WITH ANY OF THE WEAPONS.
entries.text: 你們沒有去碰那些武器，因此躲過了陷阱。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU CAN BARELY SEE A DARK OBJECT TO THE WEST.
entries.text: 你們勉強看見西邊有個暗色的東西。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU CAN SEE CHILDREN PEERING OUT OF THE TENT OPENINGS, ONLY TO BE PUSHED BACK INSIDE BY THEIR MOTHERS.
entries.text: 你們看見孩子從帳篷口探頭張望，隨即被母親推了回去。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: YOU CHARGE INTO A GROUP OF SCRUFFY LOOKING NOMADS.
entries.text: 你們衝進一群衣衫襤褸的遊牧民之中。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: YOU CLAMBER NOISILY DOWN A SLOPE OF RUBBLE.
entries.text: 你們踩著瓦礫坡往下爬，弄出好大聲響。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU CLIMB OVER THE WALL AND LEAVE THE OUTPOST.
entries.text: 你們翻牆而過，離開了前哨。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU CLIMB TO THE SECOND LEVEL OF THE DRAGON'S DEN.  THERE IS THE DRAGON WAITING FOR YOU.  HE LOOKS EXTREMELY MAD!  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們爬到龍穴的第二層，那條龍正等著你們，看起來火冒三丈！你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。

entries.source: YOU COLDLY KILL THE DEFENCELESS GOBLINS.
entries.text: 你們冷酷地殺光了毫無反抗之力的哥布林。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: YOU COLDLY KILL THE DEFENSELESS KOBOLDS.
entries.text: 你們冷血地殺光了毫無防備的小妖魔。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU CONFRONT AN ARMED MAN WHO IMMEDIATELY ATTACKS YOU.
entries.text: 你們迎上一個持械的人，他立刻動手。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU CONTINUE TO TALK ABOUT OLD PHLAN AND THE COMMANDANT SAYS 'IS NEW PHLAN HAVING ANY TROUBLE WITH TYRANTHRAXUS?'
entries.text: 你們繼續談舊菲蘭城，指揮官問：「新菲蘭城被泰蘭特拉克斯困擾嗎？」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU CONTINUE YOUR CONVERSATION WITH THE COMMANDANT.  WHAT WILL BE YOUR NEXT TOPIC OF DISSCUSION?
entries.text: 你們和指揮官繼續談下去。下一個話題要談什麼？
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。原版把 DISCUSSION 拼成 DISSCUSION。

entries.source: YOU CONVINCE THE
entries.text: 你們說服了
entries.note: 敘述片段。

entries.source: YOU COPY THE PAPERS INTO YOUR JOURNAL UNDER JOURNAL ENTRY 48.
entries.text: 你們把這些文件抄進手冊，成為線索報導 48。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU CROSS OVER A PIT.
entries.text: 你們越過一個坑。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU CUT DOWN THE KOBOLD.
entries.text: 你們砍倒了那隻小妖魔。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU DEACTIVATE THE TRAP
entries.text: 你們解除了陷阱
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU DESTROY EVERYTHING OF VALUE.
entries.text: 你們把所有值錢的東西都毀了。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU DESTROY THE EVIL ALTAR AND THE UNEASY FEELING LEAVES YOU.
entries.text: 你們搗毀了邪惡祭壇，那股不安的感覺也隨之消散。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: YOU DISARM A DEADFALL TRAP.
entries.text: 你們拆掉了一個落石陷阱。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU DISARM A NET TRAP.
entries.text: 你們拆掉了一個網陷阱。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU DISARM A SPIKE TRAP.
entries.text: 你們拆掉了一個尖刺陷阱。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU DISLODGE A NUMBER OF ROCKS.
entries.text: 你們弄落了一些石塊。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU DIVE INTO THE POOL AND BEGIN TO SEARCH BY TOUCH. SUDDENLY BEFORE YOUR CLOUDED VISION YOU SEE SOME LIZARD MEN...
entries.text: 你們潛進水裡摸索著搜尋。忽然，在一片模糊的視野中出現了幾名蜥蜴人……
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: YOU DO NOT HAVE A PASS TO SHOW THE GUARDS!
entries.text: 你們沒有通行證可以給守衛看！
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU DON'T HAVE ENOUGH MONEY!
entries.text: 你們的錢不夠！
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU DON'T HAVE ENOUGH PLATINUM.
entries.text: 你們的白金幣不夠。
entries.note: 敘述。

entries.source: YOU DRAW YOUR WEAPONS AND ATTACK.  THE CAPTAIN DRAWS HIS SWORD AND YELLS FOR HIS GUARDS TO ATTACK!
entries.text: 你們拔出武器動手。隊長也抽出劍，喝令守衛攻擊！
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU EASILY MURDER THE OLD WOMAN.  EXCEPT FOR A FEW COPPER PIECES YOU FIND NOTHING OF VALUE.  THE GODS HAVE NOTED YOUR ACTIONS.
entries.text: 你們輕易殺了那個老婦人。除了幾枚銅幣之外一無所獲。眾神記下了你們的作為。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU ENCOUNTER HOBGOBLINS!
entries.text: 你們遭遇了大哥布林！
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A BARRACKS FILED WITH TWENTY BUCCANEERS.  ONE OF THE BUCCANEERS SAYS 'THIS AREA IS OFF LIMITS.  LEAVE NOW.' WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們走進一間住著二十名海盜的營房。其中一個說：「這裡禁止進入，馬上離開。」你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 海盜據點。原版把 FILLED 拼成 FILED。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A BRIGHTLY LIT BUILDING WHICH REEKS OF TALLOW AND LEATHER. YOU SEE SIX SCRIBES BUSILY WRITING DOWN THE REPORTS OF A COUPLE OF OFFICERS.
entries.text: 你們走進一棟燈火通明的建築，屋裡瀰漫著油脂與皮革味。六名文書正忙著記下兩名軍官的報告。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A BUILDING WHERE WOMEN ARE WASHING CLOTHES. AS YOU COME IN, THEY RETREAT TO THE CORNER LOOKING FEARFULLY AT YOU.
entries.text: 你們走進一棟有婦人在洗衣的建築。你們一進去，她們就退到角落，驚懼地望著你們。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A BUILDING WHICH IS FILLED WITH TABLES AND WRITING SUPPLIES. THOUGH EMPTY, THERE ARE SIGNS THAT WORK HAS BEEN DONE HERE RECENTLY.
entries.text: 你們走進一棟滿是桌子與文具的建築。雖然空無一人，卻看得出不久前還有人在這裡辦公。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A BUILDING WHOSE WALLS ARE MORE OR LESS INTACT, THOUGH THE ROOF HAS FALLEN IN. RUBBLE MAKES PASSAGE DIFFICULT.
entries.text: 你們走進一棟牆還算完整的建築，屋頂卻已塌落，瓦礫讓人難以通行。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A CAVE ROOM WITH FOUR THRI-KREEN WARRIORS IN IT.  ON THE FLOOR IS A CHEST WITH TREASURE IN IT.  AS YOU ENTER THEY ATTACK.
entries.text: 你們走進一間洞室，裡面有四名昆蟲人戰士，地上有個裝著財寶的箱子。你們一進去牠們就攻了上來。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A CHAMBER WHICH IS LAVISHLY APPOINTED WITH HANGINGS, CARPETS AND FURNITURE. SITTING ON A THRONE IS A POWERFUL LOOKING MAN CLAD IN BARBARIC SPLENDOR.
entries.text: 你們走進一間布置奢華的廳室，掛毯、地毯與家具一應俱全。王座上坐著一個外表強悍、穿戴著蠻族華服的男人。
entries.note: 瓦傑渥城堡內部。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A CHAMBER WITH FOUR GIANT LIZARDS AND TWO MINOTAURS.  THE MINOTAURS ORDER THE LIZARDS TO ATTACK.
entries.text: 你們走進一間石室，裡面有四隻巨蜥和兩頭牛頭人。牛頭人喝令巨蜥攻擊。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A GUARD ROOM. THERE ARE TABLES, CHAIRS, AND BEDS HERE. ALL BUT TWO OF THE BEDS ARE 14 FEET LONG!
entries.text: 你們走進一間守衛室，裡面有桌椅和床。除了兩張之外，每張床都有十四呎長！
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A HALL WHICH IS FILLED WITH ROWS OF WRITING TABLES AND HIGH STOOLS. ROTTED MOUNDS OF PARCHMENT LITTER THE FLOOR.
entries.text: 你們走進一間大廳，裡面一排排都是書桌與高凳，地上散著腐爛的羊皮紙堆。
entries.note: 舊繩索公會的圖書室。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A HUT THAT IS COVERED IN FILTH.  STANDING IN A POOL OF BLACK MUCK ARE TWO HORRIBLY MUTATED LIZARD MEN.  THEY LUNGE OUT AND ATTACK THE PARTY.
entries.text: 你們走進一間污穢不堪的棚屋。兩名嚴重變異的蜥蜴人立在一灘黑泥裡，猛地撲向隊伍。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A LATRINE. THE LACK OF BAD SMELL GIVES YOU A GENERAL IDEA OF THE LEVEL OF SANITATION PRACTICED BY THE INHABITANTS OF THE AREA.
entries.text: 你們走進一間茅廁。沒什麼臭味，這大致說明了這一帶住民的衛生水準。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A ROOM FURNISHED AS THE APARTMENT OF A WEALTHY IF ECCENTRIC MERCHANT.
entries.text: 你們走進一間布置得像富有卻古怪的商人住處的屋子。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A ROOM THAT HAS BEEN CONVERTED TO A JAIL.  THERE ARE TEN YOUNG THUGS BEATING AN OLDER THIEF TO DEATH.  ONCE YOU ENTER THEY STOP AND ATTACK YOU.
entries.text: 你們走進一間被改成牢房的屋子，十個年輕流氓正把一名年長的盜賊往死裡打。看到你們，他們停手轉而攻擊。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A ROOM THAT HAS BEEN COVERTED INTO A CELL.
entries.text: 你們走進一間被改成牢房的屋子。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。原版把 CONVERTED 拼成 COVERTED。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A ROOM THAT HAS SOME CRUDE HAY BEDS. WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們走進一間擺著幾張粗陋草床的屋子。要怎麼做？
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A ROOM THAT MORE RESEMBLES A PIGSTY THAN THE BARRACKS IT IS.
entries.text: 你們走進一間屋子，說是營房，倒更像豬圈。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A ROOM THAT REEKS OF SMOKE AND BURNED FOOD. YOU SEE THREE HUMAN SLAVES COOKING MEAT, PEELING POTATOES, AND BEING BEATEN BY VISCIOUS LOOKING GNOLL.
entries.text: 你們走進一間滿是煙味與焦味的屋子，看到三名人類奴隸在烤肉、削馬鈴薯，還被一隻凶惡的豺狼人毆打。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版把 VICIOUS 拼成 VISCIOUS。

entries.source: YOU ENTER A ROOM WITH FOUR GUARDS IN GLEAMING CHAIN MAIL.  AS YOU ENTER, ONE OF THEM GOES THROUGH THE SOUTH DOOR AND RETURNS WITH THE BUCCANEER CAPTAIN.
entries.text: 你們走進一間屋子，裡面有四名身穿亮甲的守衛。你們一進去，其中一個便走出南門，帶著海盜隊長回來。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU ENTER AN EMPTY BARRACKS.  IT SEEMS MOST OF THE MEN ARE OUTSIDE CHASING THE ANIMALS.
entries.text: 你們走進一間空營房。看來大部分的人都在外面追牲口。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ENTER INTO A FILTHY ROOM.  EIGHT ORC GUARDS ATTACK YOU IMMEDIATELY.
entries.text: 你們走進一間骯髒的屋子，八名半獸人守衛立刻撲了上來。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: YOU ENTER THE CAVE.
entries.text: 你們走進洞裡。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU ENTER THE CITY HALL.  AS YOU FACE DOWN THE HALLWAY, YOU SEE A GUARDED DOOR.
entries.text: 你們走進市政廳。順著走廊看去，有一道門守著衛兵。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOU ENTER THE ENORMOUS CAVE, SEARCH IT AND FIND NOTHING OF INTREST.  YOU THEN LEAVE.
entries.text: 你們走進那個巨大的洞穴，搜了一遍卻沒發現什麼值得一提的，於是離開了。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。原版把 INTEREST 拼成 INTREST。

entries.source: YOU ENTER THE KEEP'S OLD ARMORY.  ALL OF THE WEAPONS AND ARMOR HAVE DECAYED INTO USELESSNESS.
entries.text: 你們走進城堡的舊軍械庫，所有武器與護甲都已腐朽得不能用了。
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU ENTER THE REMAINS OF THE CENTRAL KEEP. THE CEILING AND WALLS HAVE COLLAPSED TO THE POINT WHERE THE INTERIOR IS CHOKED WITH RUBBLE.
entries.text: 你們走進主堡的殘骸。天花板與牆面塌得太厲害，裡頭全被瓦礫堵滿。
entries.note: 沼澤中的廢棄城堡，挪里斯的盜匪團。

entries.source: YOU ESCAPE FROM THE OUTPOST.
entries.text: 你們逃出了前哨。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU FEEL A LIGHT TOUCH ON YOUR PURSE.  DO YOU IGNORE IT OR GRAB THE OFFENDING HAND?
entries.text: 你們感覺錢袋被輕輕碰了一下。要不理會，還是抓住那隻手？
entries.note: 扒手事件。

entries.source: YOU FEEL A SUDDEN DISORIENTATION.
entries.text: 你們突然一陣暈眩失向。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU FIND A BOOK ENTITLED
entries.text: 你們找到一本書，書名是
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。片段，後接書名。

entries.source: YOU FIND A FIGHTER WITH BATTERED ARMOR AND WILD EYES COWERING IN THE CORNER. 'YAI! MERCY! MERCY!' HE CRIES. AND THEN AS SUDDENLY, 'DIE! DIE YOU SLIME FROM THE PIT!'
entries.text: 你們發現一名戰士縮在角落，護甲殘破、雙眼發直。「哇！饒命！饒命啊！」他喊著，忽然又變調：「去死！你們這些地獄來的爛泥去死！」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU FIND A GIANT SKELETON
entries.text: 你們發現一具巨大的骷髏
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。片段。

entries.source: YOU FIND A HIDDEN TUNNEL LEADING DOWN. DO YOU TAKE IT?
entries.text: 你們找到一條往下的隱密隧道。要走嗎？
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU FIND A LARGE NUMBER OF VALUABLES.
entries.text: 你們找到大量值錢的東西。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU FIND A LONG LEATHER BAG.  WILL YOU OPEN IT?
entries.text: 你們找到一個長形皮袋。要打開嗎？
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU FIND A LOOSE FLOORBOARD.  PRYING IT UP, YOU FIND A CHEST HIDDEN BENEATH THE FLOOR.  DO YOU TAKE IT?
entries.text: 你們發現一塊鬆動的地板。撬開一看，底下藏著一個箱子。要拿走嗎？
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU FIND A MARBLE CHEST.  OPEN IT?
entries.text: 你們找到一個大理石箱。要打開嗎？
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU FIND A NOTEBOOK. A TYPICAL ENTRY READS, 'SUBJECT 213: PROGRESSING WELL, SCARS HEALING, UNABLE TO TALK YET. SUBJECT 214: DIED WHEN TREATED, FAILED AGAIN...'
entries.text: 你們找到一本筆記，其中一則寫著：「樣本 213：進展良好，傷疤癒合中，尚不能言語。樣本 214：施術時死亡，又失敗了……」
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU FIND A PAGE FROM A DIARY AND PLACE IT IN YOUR JOURNAL UNDER ENTRY 11.
entries.text: 你們找到一頁日記，把它放進手冊，成為線索報導 11。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU FIND A PASSAGEWAY GOING OUT.  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們找到一條往外的通道。要怎麼做？
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU FIND A PIECE OF PAPER ON THE FLOOR IN THE ROOM.  YOU PLACE IT IN YOUR JOURNAL UNDER ENTRY 53
entries.text: 你們在房間地上撿到一張紙，把它放進手冊，成為線索報導 53
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。片段。

entries.source: YOU FIND A PILE OF MINE TAILINGS.
entries.text: 你們發現一堆礦渣。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU FIND A POUCH OF SMALL GEMS.
entries.text: 你們找到一小袋寶石。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU FIND A RECENTLY ABBANDONED CAMP.
entries.text: 你們找到一處剛被棄置的營地。
entries.note: 野外。原版把 ABANDONED 拼成 ABBANDONED。

entries.source: YOU FIND A REPORT INDICATING THAT THE NORTHERN BARBARIANS ARE READY FOR THE TAKE OVER OF A STRONG LEADER AND THAT THE CHIEF OF THE RAVEN CLAN IS ALLIED TO TYRANTHRAXUS.
entries.text: 你們找到一份報告，指出北方蠻族已準備好接受一位強勢領袖的統御，而渡鴉氏族的首領已與泰蘭特拉克斯結盟。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。Raven Clan 為新增譯名。

entries.source: YOU FIND A RUINED CASTLE SURROUNDED BY QUICKSAND.   AN OLD WORN DRAWBRIDGE IS THE ONLY SAFE WAY ACROSS THE QUAGMIRE.  WILL YOU ENTER THE RUINED CASTLE?
entries.text: 你們找到一座被流沙環繞的廢棄城堡。一道年久失修的吊橋是安全穿越泥沼的唯一途徑。要進去嗎？
entries.note: 沼澤中的廢棄城堡，挪里斯的盜匪團。

entries.source: YOU FIND A SECRET DOOR IN THE
entries.text: 你們找到一道暗門，位在
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。句子片段。

entries.source: YOU FIND A SECRET DOOR IN THE NORTH WALL.
entries.text: 你們在北牆找到一道暗門。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU FIND A SET OF STAIRS LEADING UP.
entries.text: 你們找到一段往上的階梯。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU FIND A TRAP DOOR.  WILL YOU OPEN IT?
entries.text: 你們發現一道活門。要打開嗎？
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: YOU FIND A TRAP, BUT THE TUNNEL IS TOO NARROW TO AVOID IT.
entries.text: 你們發現一個陷阱，但隧道太窄，避不開。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU FIND A WIDE VARIETY OF SCROLLS IN SCROLL CASES.
entries.text: 你們在卷軸盒裡找到各式各樣的卷軸。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU FIND AN IRON BOX, ACROSS THE LOCK IS THE SEAL OF THE FAMILY OF CADORNA. OPENING THE BOX WILL DAMAGE THE SEAL BEYOND REPAIR. WHAT DO YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們找到一個鐵盒，鎖上蓋著卡多納家族的封印。打開盒子會把封印毀得無法修復。你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU FIND AN OLD AND PARTIALLY BLOCKED SET OF STAIRS LEADING DOWN INTO THE DARK. DO YOU TAKE THEM?
entries.text: 你們找到一段老舊、半被堵住的階梯，通往下方的黑暗。要走嗎？
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU FIND ASSORTED REPORTS.
entries.text: 你們找到各式各樣的報告。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU FIND ESSAYS ON GEOMETRY, METAMAGICAL MATH, UNIVERSAL GEOMETRY, ETC., BUT NOTHING USEFUL.
entries.text: 你們找到幾何學、超魔數學、萬有幾何之類的論文，沒有用得上的。
entries.note: 舊繩索公會的圖書室。

entries.source: YOU FIND EVIDENCE THAT THE RED WIZARDS OF THAY ARE ALLIED TO TYRANTHRAXUS.
entries.text: 你們找到證據，塞伊的紅袍法師與泰蘭特拉克斯結了盟。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。Red Wizards of Thay 為新增譯名。

entries.source: YOU FIND FYERDETHA'S DISCOURSES ON POWER. AMONG ALL THE DRY TEXT YOU FIND AN INTERESTING PASSAGE WHICH YOU COPY INTO YOUR JOURNAL AS ENTRY 7.
entries.text: 你們找到斐爾德沙的《論權力》。在一堆枯燥的文字裡有一段挺有意思，抄進手冊，成為線索報導 7。
entries.note: 舊繩索公會的圖書室。Fyerdetha 為新增譯名。

entries.source: YOU FIND HARD EVIDENCE THAT CADORNA HAS BEEN USING YOU FOR HIS OWN ENDS AND HAS BEEN SEEKING THE POOL OF RADIANCE FOR HIMSELF.
entries.text: 你們找到確鑿的證據：卡多納一直在利用你們達成自己的目的，並且早就在為自己尋找光芒之池。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。Pool of Radiance 依說明書作光芒之池。

entries.source: YOU FIND LEX GEOGRAPHICA, AN ATLAS DRAWN BY TOMARUS. IT HAS A MAP OF PHLAN WHICH, THOUGH OLD, STILL COULD BE USEFUL. IT BECOMES ENTRY 37 IN YOUR JOURNAL.
entries.text: 你們找到托馬魯斯繪製的地圖集《地理法典》。裡面有一張菲蘭城的地圖，雖然舊了，還是派得上用場，成為手冊的線索報導 37。
entries.note: 舊繩索公會的圖書室。Tomarus 為新增譯名。

entries.source: YOU FIND NOTHING OF ANY VALUE.
entries.text: 你們沒找到任何值錢的東西。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU FIND NOTHING.
entries.text: 你們什麼也沒找到。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU FIND SOME TREASURE!
entries.text: 你們找到一些財寶！
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU FIND SOME TREASURE.
entries.text: 你們找到一些財寶。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU FIND SOME UNDEAD.
entries.text: 你們遇上了一些不死怪物。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU FIND SPEECHES FROM FAMOUS MURDER TRIALS, PUBLIC DEBATES, ETC., BUT NOTHING OF INTEREST.
entries.text: 你們找到著名兇殺案審判、公開辯論之類的講稿，沒什麼值得一看的。
entries.note: 舊繩索公會的圖書室。

entries.source: YOU FIND THE CORPSE OF A MAN. THE BODY HAS BEEN STRIPPED OF WEAPONS AND ARMOR, AS WELL AS ANY USEFUL GEAR.
entries.text: 你們找到一具男屍，武器、護甲以及任何堪用的裝備都已被搜走。
entries.note: 野外。

entries.source: YOU FIND THE GRAND HISTORIAN'S RECORDS OF THE ARTS OF WAR. IN IT YOU FIND A USEFUL PASSAGE WHICH YOU COPY INTO YOUR JOURNAL AS ENTRY 21.
entries.text: 你們找到大史官的《兵法錄》，其中一段很有用，抄進手冊，成為線索報導 21。
entries.note: 舊繩索公會的圖書室。

entries.source: YOU FIND THE HISTORY OF THE NORTH. IT IS MOSTLY WRITTEN TO PLEASE A ROYAL LINE. HOWEVER, THERE IS AN INTERESTING PASSAGE WHICH YOU COPY INTO YOUR JOURNAL AS ENTRY 8.
entries.text: 你們找到《北方史》。內容多半是寫來討好某個王室的，不過其中一段挺有意思，抄進手冊，成為線索報導 8。
entries.note: 舊繩索公會的圖書室。

entries.source: YOU FIND THE VAMPIRE'S TREASURE TROVE.  DO YOU TAKE IT?
entries.text: 你們找到了吸血鬼的寶藏。要拿走嗎？
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU FIND TWO CAVES;  A SMALL, WELL-HIDDEN CAVE AND A LARGER, MORE OBVIOUS CAVE.  WHAT CAVE WILL YOU ENTER?
entries.text: 你們找到兩個洞穴：一個窄小隱蔽，一個較大也較顯眼。要進哪一個？
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: YOU FIND URGUND'S DESCRIPTION OF DARKNESS. THIS IS AN ACCOUNT OF HIS IMPRISONMENT IN THE LOWER REALMS. THERE IS A PASSAGE OF INTEREST WHICH YOU COPY AS ENTRY 19 IN YOUR JOURNAL.
entries.text: 你們找到烏爾岡的《黑暗記述》，寫的是他被囚於下界的經歷。其中一段值得一記，抄進手冊，成為線索報導 19。
entries.note: 舊繩索公會的圖書室。Urgund 為新增譯名。

entries.source: YOU FIND VARIOUS BOOKS WHICH ARE SO FILLED WITH MYTH THAT YOU DON'T FIND ANYTHING USEFUL.
entries.text: 你們翻到幾本書，滿紙都是神話傳說，沒有半點有用的東西。
entries.note: 舊繩索公會的圖書室。

entries.source: YOU FIND WORKS ON NATURAL PHILOSOPHY, THEORIES OF ART, AND THE SUPERNATURAL SCIENCES. IT IS VERY BORING.
entries.text: 你們找到自然哲學、藝術理論與超自然科學的著作，無聊得很。
entries.note: 舊繩索公會的圖書室。

entries.source: YOU FINISH SEARCHING THE BEDS BUT YOU FIND NOTHING BUT LICE AND HAIR.
entries.text: 床鋪搜完了，除了蝨子和毛髮什麼也沒有。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: YOU FLEE THE ROOM.
entries.text: 你們逃出了房間。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU FLOAT DOWN THE WELL.
entries.text: 你們順著井飄了下去。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU GO BACK OUT THE DOOR.
entries.text: 你們退出門外。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU GO BACK TO YOUR QUARTERS.
entries.text: 你們回到住處。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU GO FORWARD AND KNEEL. 'IN THE NAME OF LORD BANE, GOD OF GODS, I BLESS YOU.'
entries.text: 你們上前跪下。「以眾神之神邪惡神之名，我為你們祝福。」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU GO UPSTAIRS.
entries.text: 你們上了樓。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU GRAB THE LOOT.
entries.text: 你們抄起了戰利品。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU HACK THE BODY TO BITS.
entries.text: 你們把屍體砍成碎塊。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU HAD A GREAT TIME UNTIL YOU ALL PASSED OUT. YOUR PURSE IS MISSING.
entries.text: 你們玩得很盡興，直到全部醉倒。錢袋不見了。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: YOU HAVE
entries.text: 你們有
entries.note: 敘述片段，後面接數量。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ALERTED THE GUARDS.
entries.text: 你們驚動了守衛。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ALREADY TRIED TO PICK THIS LOCK AND HAVE FOUND THAT IT IS TOO COMPLEX FOR YOU TO HANDLE.
entries.text: 這個鎖你們試過了，太複雜，撬不開。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ALSO TAKEN POSSESSION OF A HIDEOUT IN WHICH YOU MAY REST UNDISTURBED FROM THE RIGORS OF YOUR QUESTING.
entries.text: 你們也接收了一處藏身地，可以在此不受打擾地歇息，喘口氣。
entries.note: 沼澤中的廢棄城堡，挪里斯的盜匪團。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ANGERED THE
entries.text: 你們惹惱了
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。片段。

entries.source: YOU HAVE CAUGHT ONE OF THE THIEVES.  THE THIEF BEGS FOR MERCY AND SAYS, 'I AM THE GUILD MASTER.  IF YOU RELEASE ME, MY THIEVES WILL NO LONGER ATTACK YOU!'  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們抓到其中一名盜賊。他求饒說：「我是公會會長。放了我，我的人就不再找你們麻煩！」你們要怎麼處置？
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU HAVE CLEARED THE AREA NEXT TO THE EVIL TEMPLE.
entries.text: 你們清空了邪惡神廟旁的區域。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOU HAVE DEFEATED THE DREADED BANDIT GANG AND RID PHLAN OF A GREAT EVIL.  THE HONEST SETTLERS WILL CHEER YOUR DEEDS!
entries.text: 你們擊潰了那個令人聞風喪膽的盜匪團，替菲蘭城除去一大禍害。老實的墾民會為你們喝采！
entries.note: 沼澤中的廢棄城堡，挪里斯的盜匪團。

entries.source: YOU HAVE DESTROYED THE LAST PIECE OF EQUIPMENT.
entries.text: 你們搗毀了最後一件設備。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ENTERED A CROWDED TAVERN.
entries.text: 你們走進一間擠滿人的酒館。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ENTERED A PUMPING ROOM. WORKING AS SLAVES IN THIS ROOM ARE THREE LIZARD MEN WITH WHIP CUTS ACROSS THEIR BACK WHO ARE SHACKLED TO THE WALL BY LONG CHAINS.
entries.text: 你們走進一間泵房。三名背上滿是鞭痕的蜥蜴人被長鏈鎖在牆上，像奴隸一樣在這裡幹活。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ENTERED A ROOM FILLED WITH A HORRIBLE ASSORTMENT OF TORTURE INSTUMENTS. IN THE CENTER IS A LARGE TABLE WITH METAL RESTRAINTS.
entries.text: 你們走進一間屋子，裡面擺滿了各式駭人的刑具。正中央是一張帶金屬束具的大檯子。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。原版把 INSTRUMENTS 拼成 INSTUMENTS。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ENTERED A ROOM FILLED WITH LARGE VATS WITH THE SAME OILY BLACK STUFF THAT FLOWS FROM THE FOUNTAIN. THE CHAMBER STINKS. ON THE WALLS ARE SHELVES OF BOTTLES AND FLASKS.
entries.text: 你們走進一間擺滿大缸的屋子，缸裡是噴泉流出的那種油黑之物。屋內臭氣沖天，牆上架著一排排瓶罐。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ENTERED A SMALL STORAGE ROOM.
entries.text: 你們走進一間小儲藏室。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ENTERED A STOREROOM FULL OF SUPPLIES TOO OLD TO BE USEFUL.
entries.text: 你們走進一間儲藏室，裡面的物資早就舊得不能用了。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ENTERED A VERY UNCLEAN STABLE.  THERE IS EVIDENCE THAT A LARGE AND UNTIDY ANIMAL HAD LIVED HERE.
entries.text: 你們走進一間骯髒的馬廄，看得出這裡住過一隻又大又邋遢的動物。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ENTERED AN ARMORY. INSIDE IS A LARGE ASSORTMENT OF ARMOR AND WEAPONS.
entries.text: 你們走進一間軍械庫，裡面有大批各式護甲與武器。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ENTERED AN L-SHAPED BUILDING. IT IS REASONALBLY INTACT... THERE ARE EVEN PORTIONS OF ROOF OVERHEAD!
entries.text: 你們走進一棟 L 形建築。它保存得還算完整……頭頂甚至還留著一部分屋頂！
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。原版把 REASONABLY 拼成 REASONALBLY。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ENTERED ONE OF THE GUARD TOWERS.  INSIDE ARE FOUR BUCCANEERS.  ONE OF THEM SAYS 'THIS IS A RESTRICTED AREA, LEAVE NOW!'  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們走進其中一座守衛塔，裡面有四名海盜。其中一個說：「這裡是管制區，馬上離開！」你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ENTERED THE FOUNTAIN CHAMBER. IN THE CENTER OF THE ROOM A COLUMN OF BLACK FOUL WATER JETS UP THROUGH A CLEAR PIPE AND OUT THE ROOF.
entries.text: 你們走進噴泉室。房間正中，一道黑濁的水柱沿著透明管線噴上去，直穿屋頂。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ENTERED THE MONSTER-CRAWLING SLUMS OF PHLAN.  SMALL, UGLY THINGS SCURRY FROM BENEATH YOUR FEET.  IN THE DISTANCE, AN ALARM SOUNDS.
entries.text: 你們踏進了怪物橫行的菲蘭城貧民區。醜陋的小東西從腳邊竄開。遠處傳來警報聲。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ENTERED THE MYSTERIOUS BUILDING THAT WAS ONCE THE ROPE GUILD.  MOST WHO VENTURE INTO ITS TWISTY HALLS NEVER RETURN.
entries.text: 你們走進了那棟神祕的建築，它從前是繩索公會。敢深入這些彎曲廊道的人，多半再也沒有回來。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ENTERED THE REMAINS OF A TOWER.
entries.text: 你們走進一座塔的殘骸。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU HAVE ENTERED WHAT LOOKS LIKE AN ORDINARY ALCHEMISTS LAB... RECENTLY USED.
entries.text: 你們走進一間看似尋常的煉金術實驗室……最近才有人用過。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。原版把 ALCHEMIST'S 寫成 ALCHEMISTS。

entries.source: YOU HAVE FOUND A PASSAGE WHICH LEADS OUTSIDE.  WILL YOU TAKE IT?
entries.text: 你們找到一條通往外面的通道。要走嗎？
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU HAVE FOUND A ROWBOAT HIDDEN AMOUNGST THE REEDS.  WILL YOU TAKE IT TO THE PYRAMID?
entries.text: 你們發現一艘藏在蘆葦叢裡的小船。要划它去金字塔嗎？
entries.note: 野外。原版把 AMONGST 拼成 AMOUNGST。

entries.source: YOU HAVE FOUND A SMALL DARK CAVE.  WILL YOU ENTER?
entries.text: 你們發現一個又小又暗的洞穴。要進去嗎？
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU HAVE FOUND A SMALL WOODED GROVE.  WILL YOU ENTER?
entries.text: 你們找到一小片樹叢。要進去嗎？
entries.note: 野外。

entries.source: YOU HAVE FOUND A SMALL, DARK CAVE.  WILL YOU ENTER?
entries.text: 你們找到一個窄小昏暗的洞穴。要進去嗎？
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: YOU HAVE FOUND SOME RUINED HUTS.  WILL YOU INVESTIGATE?
entries.text: 你們發現幾間毀壞的棚屋。要查看嗎？
entries.note: 野外。

entries.source: YOU HAVE FOUND SOME TREASURE.
entries.text: 你們找到了一些財寶。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU HAVE FOUND THE BANDIT'S TREASURE.  DO YOU TAKE IT?
entries.text: 你們找到了盜匪的寶藏。要拿走嗎？
entries.note: 沼澤中的廢棄城堡，挪里斯的盜匪團。

entries.source: YOU HAVE FOUND THE WYVERN'S TREASURE!
entries.text: 你們找到了雙足飛龍的寶藏！
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: YOU HAVE INSULTED THE
entries.text: 你們羞辱了
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。片段。

entries.source: YOU HAVE MANAGED TO SNEAK UP ON SOME
entries.text: 你們成功摸到了幾隻
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。片段。

entries.source: YOU HAVE NO KEY TO UNLOCK THE PADLOCKS.
entries.text: 你們沒有鑰匙能打開那些掛鎖。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU HAVE OFFENDED THE
entries.text: 你們冒犯了
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。句子片段。

entries.source: YOU HAVE REACHED THE BUCCANEER BASE.  A BAND OF BUCCANEERS RIDE OUT TO ESCORT YOU IN.  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們抵達了海盜據點。一隊海盜騎馬出來要護送你們進去。你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU HAVE RUN OUTSIDE THE CAPTAINS QUARTERS.  AN ALARM GOES OFF IN THE DISTANCE.  YOU SEE A LARGE GROUP OF ANGRY BUCCANEERS CHARGING TOWARD YOU!
entries.text: 你們跑到隊長住處外面。遠處警報響起，一大群憤怒的海盜正朝你們衝來！
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU HAVE SLAIN THE GARRISON. NOW IF YOU CAN BUT SLAY THE OUTSIDE GUARDS QUICKLY BEFORE THE ENEMY ARRIVES THE GATE WILL BE YOURS!
entries.text: 你們殲滅了守軍。只要能在敵人趕到前迅速解決外頭的守衛，這道門就是你們的了！
entries.note: 史塔傑諾門一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU HAVE STUMBLED ACROSS A FEROCIOUS WYVERN.  IT CHARGES AND ATTACKS!
entries.text: 你們撞上一頭凶猛的雙足飛龍，牠衝上來攻擊！
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: YOU HAVE STUMBLED INTO A TREASURE ROOM.
entries.text: 你們誤打誤撞走進了一間寶庫。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU HAVE STUMBLED UPON A LARGE NOMAD CAMP.  WILL YOU ENTER IT?
entries.text: 你們無意間撞見一座大型遊牧民營地。要進去嗎？
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: YOU HAVE SURPRISED A PARTY OF
entries.text: 你們突襲了一隊
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。片段。

entries.source: YOU HAVE SURPRISED THEM.
entries.text: 你們突襲了牠們。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: YOU HAVE TAKEN THE GATE! YOU OPEN THE GREAT PORTALS AS 20  HUMAN AND DEMI-HUMAN GUARDS IMMEDIATELY TAKE POSSESSION OF THE GUARD TOWERS.
entries.text: 你們拿下了這道門！大門一開，二十名人類與半人類守衛立刻接管了兩座守衛塔。
entries.note: 史塔傑諾門一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU HEAR A DEEP VOICE, 'HEY, THAT'S THEM GUYS WHO TRIED TO BUST IN!'
entries.text: 你們聽見一個低沉的聲音：「喂，就是那票想硬闖進來的傢伙！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版用口語。

entries.source: YOU HEAR A DEEP VOICE, 'THIEF! YOU STOLE FROM LORD BANE!'
entries.text: 你們聽見一個低沉的聲音：「小偷！你們偷了邪惡神的東西！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU HEAR A DEEP VOICE,'THIEF! YOU STOLE FROM LORDBANE!'
entries.text: 你們聽見一個低沉的聲音：「小偷！你們偷了邪惡神的東西！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版把 LORD BANE 連寫成 LORDBANE。

entries.source: YOU HEAR A GREAT FLAPPING SOUND.  A STRONG WHOOSH OF AIR COMES DOWN UPON THE ADVENTURERS.  A LARGE SILVER DRAGON STANDS BEFORE YOU.  IN A BOOMING VOICE IT SAYS...
entries.text: 你們聽見巨大的振翅聲，一股強風壓了下來。一條巨大的銀龍立在你們面前，以洪亮的嗓音說道……
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。

entries.source: YOU HEAR A HISS. AS YOU LOOK DOWN YOU SUDDENLY SEE A DULL BROWN REPTILIAN MONSTER.
entries.text: 你們聽到嘶嘶聲，低頭一看，竟是一隻暗褐色的爬蟲怪物。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU HEAR A ROAR THEN A GREAT FLAPPING SOUND.  A STRONG RUSH OF AIR BATTERS THE PARTY AS A LARGE SILVER DRAGON LANDS BEFORE THE ADVENTURERS.  IN A BOOMING VOICE IT SAYS...
entries.text: 你們先聽見一聲咆哮，接著是巨大的振翅聲。一股強風撲向隊伍，一條巨大的銀龍落在冒險者面前，以洪亮的嗓音說道……
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。

entries.source: YOU HEAR A WHINING FROM THE PIPES THE BLACK LIQUID IS BUBBLING. HOWEVER, NOT ALL THE EQUIPMENT IS YET DESTROYED.
entries.text: 管線傳出尖鳴，黑色液體翻騰冒泡。不過設備還沒全毀。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU HEAR MUFFLED SOUNDS AND TURN TO INVESTIGATE.
entries.text: 你們聽見一陣悶響，轉身查看。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU HEAR ONE OF THEM WHISPER, 'THEY DON'T BELONG HERE; THEY MUST HAVE COME TO KILL TYRANTHRAXUS'. A HALF-ORC WOMAN STEPS FORWARD 'WHAT DO YOU WANT OF US?'
entries.text: 你們聽見其中一人低聲說：「他們不該在這裡，一定是來殺泰蘭特拉克斯的。」一名半獸人女子上前一步：「你們要我們做什麼？」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU HEAR THE VOICES OF HUMANS AND KOBOLDS.
entries.text: 你們聽見人類與小妖魔的說話聲。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU HEAR WAR CRIES AND THE CLANG OF METAL
entries.text: 你們聽見喊殺聲與兵器相擊的聲響
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: YOU HIDE.
entries.text: 你們躲了起來。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU HIT AN UNYIELDING STONE FLOOR.
entries.text: 你們重重摔在堅硬的石地板上。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU IGNORE THE SLEAZY MERCHANT AND CONCENTRATE ON RESCUING THE BOY.
entries.text: 你們不理會那名下流的商人，專心救那個男孩。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU INTERRUPT SOME FEEDING KOBOLDS.
entries.text: 你們打擾了一群正在進食的小妖魔。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU INTIMIDATE THE MONSTERS SO MUCH THEY RUN AWAY!
entries.text: 你們把怪物嚇得拔腿就跑！
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: YOU INTRUDE ON A GATHERING OF MONSTER LEADERS.
entries.text: 你們闖進了一場怪物首領的集會。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU KILL THE CAPTAIN.
entries.text: 你們殺了那名隊長。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU KILL THE GUARDS BUT ARE CAUGHT DOING IT.  A LARGE GROUP OF GUARDS RUN TOWARD YOU AND ATTACK.
entries.text: 你們殺了守衛，卻當場被逮個正著。一大群守衛朝你們衝來動手。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU LASH OUT WITH YOUR WEAPON DEALING ONE SWIFT, DEADLY BLOW. THE OLD LIZARD MAN TOTTERS FOR A MOMENT WITH A SURPRISED LOOK ON HIS FACE, AND THEN COLLAPSES.
entries.text: 你們揮出武器，一擊致命。那名年老的蜥蜴人踉蹌了一下，臉上寫滿錯愕，隨即倒地。
entries.note: 沼澤的蜥蜴人部族。

entries.source: YOU LEAVE THE SHOP.
entries.text: 你們離開了店裡。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU LEAVE THE WEAPONS ALONE.
entries.text: 你們沒有去動那堆武器。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU LEAVE. BEHIND YOU ARE HIS SCREAMS, 'INTRUDERS! INTRUDERS!'
entries.text: 你們離開了，身後傳來他的尖叫：「有人闖進來了！有人闖進來了！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU LET THE GOBLINS GO.  AS THEY LEAVE ONE OF THEM SAYS 'TO ENTER THE TEMPLE YOU NEED A HOLY SYMBOL OF BANE.'
entries.text: 你們放走了哥布林。臨走前有一隻說：「要進神廟，得有邪惡神的聖徽。」
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: YOU LOOK AT THE WRITING...
entries.text: 你們看著上面的字……
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU MAKE THE LONG, ARDUOUS CLIMB UP THE WELL.
entries.text: 你們沿著井壁費力地爬了很久才上來。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU MAKE UP STORIES ABOUT WONDERFUL MAGICAL ITEMS AND PLACES.  YOU CAPTIVATE EVERYONE SITTING AROUND YOU.
entries.text: 你們胡謅了一堆神奇魔法物品與地方的故事，把在座的人都聽住了。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU MANAGE TO GET OUT OF THE POOL BEFORE THEY FINISH YOU OFF.
entries.text: 你們趕在牠們解決你們之前爬出了水池。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: YOU MANAGE TO RUN AWAY AND HIDE.  YOU HEAR AN ALARM IN THE DISTANCE AS GUARDS ARE ISSUING OUT OF BARRACKS.
entries.text: 你們設法逃開躲了起來。遠處警報大作，守衛正從營房裡湧出。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU MAY EASILY FOLLOW THE DRAGON BY CLIMBING UP A WALL AND THEN THROUGH THE HOLE IN THE CEILING.  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們可以輕易爬上牆、穿過天花板的洞跟上那條龍。要怎麼做？
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。

entries.source: YOU MENTION THE YOUNG BOY IN THE SLAVE PEN AND THE CAPTAIN SEEMS INTERESTED.  HE SAYS 'I CAN LET YOU BUY THE YOUNG BOY BUT IT WILL COST YOU ALOT!'  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們提起奴隸欄裡那個男孩，隊長似乎有興趣：「那男孩可以賣你們，不過價錢不便宜！」你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 海盜據點。原版把 A LOT 連寫成 ALOT。

entries.source: YOU MOVE THROUGH THE CROWD NONCHALANTLY UNTIL YOU ARE NEAR THE FRONT GATE OF THE SLAVE PEN.
entries.text: 你們若無其事地穿過人群，來到奴隸欄前門附近。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU NOW CAREFULLY AVOID THE GREEN SLIME.
entries.text: 你們小心地繞開那團綠泥怪。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU NOW SEE THE WAND ISN'T A MAJOR ARTIFACT, IT'S ONLY A WAND OF FEAR!
entries.text: 你們這才看清那根魔杖不是什麼重要神器，只是一根恐懼魔杖！
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: YOU OFFER THE GUARDS SOME MONEY BUT THEY REFUSE.  ONE OF THE GUARDS SAYS 'GET OTTA' HERE YA SCUM'
entries.text: 你們塞錢給守衛，他們卻不收。其中一個說：「滾出去，渣滓。」
entries.note: 海盜據點。原版用口語，把 OUT OF 寫成 OTTA'。

entries.source: YOU OPENED THE DOOR INTO A DRUNK BUCCANEER.
entries.text: 你們一開門就撞上一名喝醉的海盜。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: YOU OVERHEAR TAVERN TALE
entries.text: 你們聽到酒館裡的傳言
entries.note: 敘述片段，後面接編號。

entries.source: YOU OVERHEAR THE FIGHTER TELL THE MAGE, 'YOU BETTER WATCH YOUR TALK. THE LAST GUY WHO GAVE THE BOSS LIP WAS THROWN THROUGH THE TRAPDOOR TO THE MEDUSA!'
entries.text: 你們聽見那名戰士對法師說：「你講話最好小心點。上一個頂撞老大的，被從活門丟下去餵梅杜莎了！」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU OVERHEAR THE MAGE TELL HIS COMPANION, 'HOW MUCH LONGER MUST WE WAIT BEFORE ASSAULTING PHLAN. I AM EAGER TO BECOME A BARON.'
entries.text: 你們聽見那名法師對同伴說：「還要等多久才進攻菲蘭城？我可等不及要當男爵了。」
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU PASS INTO HIDDEN CATACOMBS. THIS LARGE ROOM IS DIMLY LIT BY SPUTTERING TORCHES. THROUGH THE SMOKE YOU SEE CURTAINS HUNG TO COVER DOORWAYS.
entries.text: 你們走進隱密的地下墓道。這間大廳只有幾支劈啪作響的火把照明，煙霧中看得見門口掛著布簾。
entries.note: 沼澤中的廢棄城堡，挪里斯的盜匪團。

entries.source: YOU PICK THE LOCK!
entries.text: 你們把鎖撬開了！
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU PUNCH THE MERCHANT IN THE NOSE AND HE FALLS TO THE GROUND, BADLY BLEEDING.  THE MERCHANT YELLS FOR HIS GUARDS AND THEY COME RUNNING.
entries.text: 你們一拳打在那名商人鼻子上，他倒在地上血流不止，一邊叫來他的護衛，那些人跑了過來。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU QUICKLY KILL THE TRADER AND GRAB HIS WAGON.
entries.text: 你們迅速殺了那名商人，搶走他的貨車。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU QUICKLY TRANSLATE THEM AND SAY...?
entries.text: 你們很快譯出符文，念道……？
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU REACH THE BOTTOM AND FEEL AROUND...
entries.text: 你們摸到了底，四處探了探……
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU REACH THE KING'S QUARTERS AND CONFRONT HIS GUARDS.
entries.text: 你們來到王的居所，與他的護衛正面相對。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU REALIZE YOU HAVE BEEN VICTIMIZED BY A PICKPOCKET.
entries.text: 你們發現自己被扒了。
entries.note: 街頭事件。

entries.source: YOU RECORD IT IN YOUR JOURNAL UNDER ENTRY
entries.text: 你們把它記進手冊，編為線索報導
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。句子片段，後面接編號。

entries.source: YOU RELEASE THE KOBOLDS AND THEY THANK YOU.  ONE OF THEM SAYS, 'WATCH OUT FOR THE MUTANT LIZARD MEN, THEY'RE KILLERS!'  THEY THEN RUN OUT THE DOOR.
entries.text: 你們放走小妖魔，牠們連聲道謝。其中一隻說：「小心那些變異的蜥蜴人，牠們會殺人！」說完便奪門而出。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU RUN AWAY FROM THE BATTLE BACK TO THE MERCHANT'S AREA.  FROM BEHIND YOU HEAR PEOPLE CALLING YOU NAMES LIKE 'PANSY' AND 'WIMP.'
entries.text: 你們逃離戰鬥，跑回商人區。身後傳來一片「膽小鬼」「孬種」的叫罵。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU RUN FOR THE EXIT. AS YOU SLAM THE DOOR BEHIND YOU, YOU HEAR AN ENORMOUS EXPLOSION. THE EQUIPMENT IS NOW CERTAINLY DESTROYED.
entries.text: 你們衝向出口，門在身後砰地關上時，裡面轟然巨響。那些設備這下肯定全毀了。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU RUN FOR YOUR LIVES AS THE GARRISON CHASES BEHIND YOU.  YOU RUN FOR THE FRONT GATE BUT ARE STOPPED BY SOME GUARDS.
entries.text: 駐軍在後面追，你們拚命逃。跑向前門時卻被幾名守衛攔了下來。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU RUN FROM THE BATTLE AND OUT THE OUTPOST GATE.  THE YOUNG BOY COULD NOT KEEP UP AND WAS LEFT BEHIND.
entries.text: 你們逃離戰場，衝出前哨大門。那個男孩跟不上，被留在了後面。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU RUN INTO SOME MORE GUARDS.
entries.text: 你們又撞上幾名守衛。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU RUSH TO HELP THE OLD THIEF BUT IT'S TOO LATE.  BEFORE HE DIES HE SAYS, 'THE BOSS HAS ALLIES EVERYWHERE.  TAKE THESE PAPERS.  THEY MAY HELP.'  HE THEN DIES.
entries.text: 你們趕上前想救那名年長的盜賊，卻已經來不及。他臨死前說：「老大到處都有同夥。拿去這些文件，或許幫得上忙。」說完就斷了氣。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU SAY THAT BISHOP BRACCIO IS NOT THE REAL POWER IN PHLAN AND THE COMMANDANT RESPONDS BY SAYING 'THE CITIZENS OF PHLAN ARE WISE TO NOT FOLLOW AN IDIOT FROM THE TEMPLE OF TYR!'
entries.text: 你們說巴西歐主教並非菲蘭城真正掌權的人，指揮官回道：「菲蘭城的市民有智慧，不去跟隨提爾神殿的蠢貨！」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU SAY THAT BISHOP BRACCIO IS THE REAL POWER IN PHLAN AND THE COMMANDANT RESPONDS BY SAYING 'PHLAN MUST BE A CITY OF FOOLS IF A BISHOP OF TYR HAS POWER!'
entries.text: 你們說巴西歐主教才是菲蘭城真正掌權的人，指揮官回道：「要是一個提爾的主教握有權力，那菲蘭城肯定滿城都是傻子！」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU SAY THAT ULRICH EBERHARD IS A LOYAL HONEST MAN.  THE COMMANDANT SMIRKS AND SAYS 'YES, OF COURSE HE IS.'
entries.text: 你們說亞爾瑞屈·艾伯哈德是個忠誠正直的人。指揮官冷笑一下：「是啊，當然。」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU SAY THAT ULRICH EBERHARD IS CORRUPT AND HE RESPONDS BY SAYING 'I WOULD ADVISE YOU TO BE CAREFUL WHEN DEALING WITH THE TOWN COUNCIL.'
entries.text: 你們說亞爾瑞屈·艾伯哈德貪腐，他回道：「我勸各位跟市議會打交道時小心點。」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU SAY THAT YOU DON'T KNOW ANYTHING ABOUT THAT MATTER AND THE COMMANDANT RESPONDS BY SAYING 'YES, OF COURSE YOU DON'T.'
entries.text: 你們說對那件事一無所知，指揮官回道：「是啊，當然不知道。」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU SCATTER THE DUST AND PLACE WHAT HOLY ITEMS YOU CAN SPARE INSIDE.
entries.text: 你們把塵土撥開，將能挪出的聖物放了進去。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU SEARCH THE BEDS BUT FIND NOTHING.
entries.text: 你們搜遍床鋪，什麼也沒找到。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: YOU SEARCH UNTIL YOU FEEL THE PULSE POUNDING IN YOUR EARS. NOTHING IS FOUND. WITH THAT YOU RESURFACE.
entries.text: 你們一直找到耳中脈搏轟響，什麼也沒找到，只好浮出水面。
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: YOU SEE A
entries.text: 你們看到
entries.note: 遭遇敘述的開頭片段，後面接怪物名。

entries.source: YOU SEE A BOY THAT HAS A HEART-SHAPED BIRTHMARK ON HIS LEFT SHOULDER.  AS YOU STARE AT THE BOY, A SLEAZY FAT MERCHANT APPROACHES YOU AND SAYS ...
entries.text: 你們看到一個男孩，左肩上有塊心形胎記。你們盯著他看時，一名肥胖下流的商人走過來說……
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU SEE A BRASS BOTTLE JAMMED INTO A CRACK HERE.
entries.text: 你們看到一只黃銅瓶卡在這裡的裂縫中。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU SEE A CHAMBER FILLED WITH ROTTED FURNITURE AND BENCHES.
entries.text: 你們看到一間堆滿腐朽家具與長凳的屋子。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU SEE A DEAD HOBGOBLIN WITH ITS HEAD CRUSHED. WRITTEN IN BLOOD IS A MESSAGE: 'SKULLCRUSHER WAS HERE.'
entries.text: 你們看到一具腦袋被砸爛的大哥布林屍體，旁邊用血寫著：「碎顱者到此一遊。」
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU SEE A DIAL THAT CAN BE SET TO FOUR DIFFERENT COLORS: BLUE, COPPER, SILVER, AND GOLD. IT IS CURRENTLY SET TO
entries.text: 你們看到一個可以轉到四種顏色的轉盤：藍、銅、銀、金。目前轉在
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU SEE A DULL BROWN REPTILIAN MONSTER. IT DOESN'T SEEM AWARE OF YOU.
entries.text: 你們看到一隻暗褐色的爬蟲怪物，牠似乎沒有察覺你們。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU SEE A GROUP OF FIVE LIZARD MEN. THEY HISS AT YOU.
entries.text: 你們看到五名蜥蜴人，牠們朝你們嘶叫。
entries.note: 野外。

entries.source: YOU SEE A GROUP OF FOUR ORCS WHOSE SHIELDS BEAR A BLACK HAND ON A RED FIELD.  THEY CAUTIOSLY LOOK YOU OVER.
entries.text: 你們看到四隻半獸人，盾上是紅底黑手的紋樣。牠們謹慎地打量你們。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。原版把 CAUTIOUSLY 拼成 CAUTIOSLY。

entries.source: YOU SEE A HARMLESS, MIDDLE AGED MAN.
entries.text: 你們看到一個看來人畜無害的中年男子。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU SEE A JAR UNDER THE FLOORBOARDS.
entries.text: 你們看到地板底下有個罐子。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU SEE A PACK OF TROLLS.
entries.text: 你們看到一群巨魔。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU SEE A PACK OF TROLLS. THEY SEEM UNAWARE OF YOU.
entries.text: 你們看到一群巨魔，牠們似乎沒有察覺你們。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU SEE A RUINED ROOM WITH ROTTED FURNITURE. HUMAN BONES LIE SCATTERED ABOUT A DESK.
entries.text: 你們看到一間殘破的屋子，家具都爛了，桌子四周散著人骨。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU SEE A SIGN OVER THE DOOR IN FRONT OF YOU. IT SAYS, 'DON'T FORGET THE PASSWORD'. THIS IS FOLLOWED BY SIX DWARVISH RUNES...
entries.text: 眼前的門上有一塊牌子，寫著「別忘了通關密語」，後面跟著六個矮人符文……
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU SEE A SMALL GROUP OF KOBOLDS ENTERING A SMALL,   CONCEALED CAVE.  A LARGER, MORE NOTICEABLE CAVE LIES JUST EAST OF THE SMALL HIDDEN, CAVE.  WHAT CAVE WILL YOU ENTER?
entries.text: 你們看到一小群小妖魔鑽進一個隱蔽的小洞。小洞東邊還有一個較大、較顯眼的洞穴。要進哪一個？
entries.note: 荒野。

entries.source: YOU SEE A STRANGE GREEN PLANT GROWTH WHICH YOU RECOGNIZE AS GREEN SLIME. YOU CAREFULLY MOVE AROUND IT.
entries.text: 你們看到一團奇怪的綠色黏狀物，認出那是綠泥怪，於是小心地繞了過去。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU SEE A WIDE COLLECTION OF RUGS AND TAPESTRIES.  TWO OF THEM LOOK EXTRAORDINARY WHILE THE OTHERS LOOK AVERAGE.
entries.text: 你們看到一大批地毯與掛毯，其中兩件看來非凡，其餘平平。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU SEE AN EMPTY ROOM. THE ONLY FEATURE IS A SERIES OF FRESCOES ON THE WALLS OF LEARNED MEN AND THE HEAVENLY PATRONS OF ART AND LEARNING. YOU GET A FEELING OF PEACE.
entries.text: 你們看到一間空屋，唯一的陳設是牆上一系列壁畫，畫的是學者與掌管藝術與學問的天上守護者。你們心裡生出一股寧靜。
entries.note: 舊繩索公會的圖書室。

entries.source: YOU SEE FOUR GIANTS. 'HEY, THEM THE GUYS WHAT STEAL FROM LORD BANE. GET 'EM!'
entries.text: 你們看到四名巨人：「喂，就是那票偷邪惡神東西的傢伙。上！」
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版用不標準的口語。

entries.source: YOU SEE FOUR GIANTS. 'THEM THE NOT BELONG HERE! GET THEM!
entries.text: 你們看到四名巨人：「他們不該在這！上啊！
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。原版用不標準的口語。接下一段。

entries.source: YOU SEE GIANT SNAKES.
entries.text: 你們看到幾條巨蛇。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU SEE ROCKS SCATTERED ABOUT THE SMOOTH FLAGSTONES.
entries.text: 平整的石板上散落著一些石塊。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU SEE SOME BLOODTHIRSTY
entries.text: 你們看到幾隻嗜血的
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。句子片段。

entries.source: YOU SEE SOME GIANTS PUTTING ON THEIR ARMOR.
entries.text: 你們看到幾名巨人正在穿護甲。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU SEE SOME GIANTS STRUGGLING OUT OF BED.
entries.text: 你們看到幾名巨人正掙扎著爬下床。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU SEE SOME LIZARD MEN SWIMMING IN THE POOL.  UPON SEEING YOU THEY ATTACK!
entries.text: 你們看到幾名蜥蜴人在池裡游動。牠們一看到你們就攻了上來！
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU SEE THE CHIEF OF THE HOBGOBLINS, A HUGE OGRE. AS YOU ENTER, HE RISES TO HIS FULL, TEN FEET OF HEIGHT; HIS HEAD WREATHED IN THE FLICKERING SHADOWS.
entries.text: 你們看到大哥布林的首領，是一隻巨大的食人鬼。你們一進來，牠便挺直了十呎高的身軀，腦袋沒入搖曳的陰影裡。
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU SEE THE MAN IS QUITE MAD. DO YOU TAKE PITY AND INVITE HIM TO GO WITH YOU?
entries.text: 你們看得出這人瘋得不輕。要不要可憐他，邀他同行？
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU SEE THE PITIFUL REMAINS OF A DEAD ELF.  EVERYTHING OF VALUE HAS BEEN TAKEN OR DESTROYED.
entries.text: 你們看到一名精靈的可憐遺骸，值錢的東西不是被拿走就是被毀了。
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU SEE WHAT ONCE WAS A GARDEN, NOW-WEED FILLED. THE PLEASANT POND HAS BECOME A SWAMP.
entries.text: 這裡曾經是花園，如今雜草叢生，原本宜人的池塘變成了沼澤。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU SENSE AN ANTI-MAGIC SHELL AROUND YOU.
entries.text: 你們感覺到身邊罩著一層反魔法殼。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU SLIP BY WITH EASE.
entries.text: 你們輕鬆溜了過去。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU SLOWLY CLIMB DOWN THE SLIPPERY RUNGS.
entries.text: 你們沿著濕滑的踏階慢慢往下爬。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU SPIN TO FACE THE SOUND.
entries.text: 你們循聲轉過身去。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU SPOT A GROUP OF
entries.text: 你們發現一群
entries.note: 同上。

entries.source: YOU SPOT A SMALL BAND OF SICKLY KOBOLDS CAREFULLY PICKING ITS WAY THROUGH THE RUBBLE.  WHEN THEY SPOT YOU, THEY STOP AND STARE IN SURPRISE.
entries.text: 你們看見一小群病懨懨的小妖魔小心翼翼地在瓦礫間穿行。牠們發現你們後停下腳步，吃驚地盯著看。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU SPY A GROUP OF SEEDY-LOOKING
entries.text: 你們瞥見一群衣衫襤褸的
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。片段。

entries.source: YOU STAND BEFORE A HUGE TOWER. THE SINGLE ENTRANCE IS LOCKED AND STRONGLY BUILT.
entries.text: 你們站在一座巨塔前，唯一的入口鎖著，而且造得極為堅固。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU STAND BELOW THE ROTTING REMAINS OF THE ONCE-MIGHTY GATES OF SOKAL KEEP.
entries.text: 你們站在索卡爾城堡那道昔日雄偉、如今朽壞的大門底下。
entries.note: 索卡爾城堡的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU STAND IN FRONT OF THE ENTRANCE TO A LARGE SHADOWY TEMPLE.  AN OLD BLIND DECREPIT ORC STANDS OUTSIDE WITH EIGHT ORC GUARDS.
entries.text: 你們站在一座陰森大神廟的入口前。門外站著一隻年邁失明、形容枯槁的半獸人，還有八名半獸人守衛。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: YOU STAND OUTSIDE A LARGE MANSION.  ON THE WALLS OF THE MANSION ARE CRUDE BLACK HAND PRINTS.
entries.text: 你們站在一棟大宅外面，牆上印著粗糙的黑手印。
entries.note: 邪惡神廟（Temple of Bane）一帶。

entries.source: YOU START TO RUN FOR THE EXIT... YOU DON'T MAKE IT.
entries.text: 你們拔腿衝向出口……沒能跑到。
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU STEP INTO A STRANGE GREEN PLANT GROWTH... IT'S GREEN SLIME! QUICKLY, YOU SCRAPE IT OFF, TAKING A GOOD DEAL OF DAMAGE.
entries.text: 你們踩進一團奇怪的綠色黏狀物……是綠泥怪！你們趕緊刮掉，還是受了不小的傷。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU STOP, AND THEY MOVE ON.
entries.text: 你們停下腳步，牠們就走開了。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: YOU STUMBLE ON SOME WAITING KOBOLDS!
entries.text: 你們一頭撞上埋伏在那裡的小妖魔！
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU SURPRISE A FIGURE AS IT SUMMONS A WIGHT.
entries.text: 你們撞見一個身影正在召喚屍妖。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU SURPRISE A GROUP OF
entries.text: 你們突襲了一群
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。片段。

entries.source: YOU SURPRISE A SHADOWY FORM CREATING NEW SKELETONS.
entries.text: 你們撞見一個陰影般的身影正在造新的骷髏。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOU SURPRISE THREE GIANTS!
entries.text: 你們突襲了三名巨人！
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU SURRENDER.  THEY STRIP YOU OF ALL POSSESSIONS AND TOSS YOU OUT INTO THE WILDERNESS.'
entries.text: 你們投降了。他們搜光你們的財物，把你們扔進荒野。」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU SWIM DOWN UNTIL YOU FEEL YOUR PULSE BEATING IN YOUR EARS. YOU DON'T REACH THE BOTTOM.
entries.text: 你們一直往下潛，直到耳中傳來自己的脈搏聲，卻仍到不了底。
entries.note: 紡織行與巨人占據一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU TAKE THE YOUNG BOY AND LEAVE.  THE OTHER SLAVES ALSO RUN OUT THE SLAVE PEN.
entries.text: 你們帶著那個男孩離開，其他奴隸也跟著跑出了奴隸欄。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU TALK A LITTLE WHILE LONGER THEN THE COMMANDANT STATES THAT HE HAS OTHER DUTIES TO ATTEND TO.  HE BIDS YOU GOOD NIGHT.
entries.text: 又談了一會兒，指揮官表示還有別的公事要辦，向你們道了晚安。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU TELL THE COMMANDANT THAT NEW PHLAN'S FORCES ARE CAPABLE.  HE LOOKS AT YOU AND SAYS, 'I HOPE, FOR YOUR SAKE, THAT YOUR CITY'S FORCES CAN DEFEND THEMSELVES FROM TYRANTHRAXUS'S HORDE.'
entries.text: 你們告訴指揮官新菲蘭城的兵力還算得力。他看著你們說：「為了各位好，但願貴城的兵力擋得住泰蘭特拉克斯的大軍。」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU TELL THE COMMANDANT THAT NEW PHLAN'S FORCES ARE STRONG.  HE SEEMS IMPRESSED, AND SAYS 'IT SOUNDS LIKE YOUR CITY CAN HANDLE THAT FIRE DEMON TYRANTHRAXUS'
entries.text: 你們告訴指揮官新菲蘭城兵力強盛。他似乎頗為佩服：「聽起來貴城應付得了泰蘭特拉克斯那頭火魔。」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU TELL THE COMMANDANT THAT NEW PHLAN'S FORCES ARE WEAK.  HE SMILES AND SAYS, 'I HOPE THAT PHLAN CAN DEFEND ITSELF.'
entries.text: 你們告訴指揮官新菲蘭城兵力薄弱。他笑了笑：「但願菲蘭城守得住自己。」
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU THROW A ROCK. SUDDENLY IT DISAPPEARS WITH A FLASH!
entries.text: 你們扔出一塊石頭，它閃了一下便憑空消失！
entries.note: 亞拉斯的金字塔。

entries.source: YOU THROW CAUTION TO THE WIND AND ATTACK.  THE CAPTAIN SMILES AND THEN RUSHES TO BATTLE.
entries.text: 你們豁出去動手了。隊長笑了笑，隨即投入戰鬥。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU TRIP ON A WIRE TO THE ACCOMPANIMENT OF BELLS TINKLING. AFTER A MOMENT THERE IS A COMMOTION AHEAD OF YOU.
entries.text: 你們絆到一根細線，鈴聲隨之響起。片刻後，前方一陣騷動。
entries.note: 遊牧民營地。

entries.source: YOU TRY TO ATTACK THE DRAGON BUT SEEM TO BE FROZEN IN TIME.  THE DRAGON THROWS A FIREBALL IN THE MIDDLE OF THE PARTY AND THEN DISAPPEARS.  YOU HAVE A STRANGE FEELING THAT YOU JUST MADE A BIG MISTAKE.
entries.text: 你們想攻擊那條龍，卻像被定在時間裡動彈不得。牠朝隊伍中央丟出一顆火球後便消失了。你們隱隱覺得自己剛剛鑄下大錯。
entries.note: 銀龍狄奧根尼斯的巢穴。

entries.source: YOU TRY TO FLEE BUT ARE STOPPED BY SOME GUARDS.
entries.text: 你們想逃，卻被幾名守衛攔了下來。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU TRY TO PICK THE LOCK BUT IT IS TOO COMPLEX FOR YOU TO PICK.  YOU FAIL MISERABLY.
entries.text: 你們試著撬鎖，但這鎖太複雜了，撬得一塌糊塗。
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOU TRY TO RUN BUT ARE CAUGHT.  YOU ARE CAPTURED, STRIPPED AND TOSSED OUT INTO THE WILDERNESS.
entries.text: 你們想逃卻被抓住，財物被搜光，人被扔進荒野。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU TRY TO RUN FROM THE GUARDS BUT ARE CUT OFF BY NEW ARRIVALS.  THE YOUNG BOY IS SLOWING YOU DOWN.  IF YOU RUN AGAIN YOU WILL LEAVE HIM BEHIND.
entries.text: 你們想甩開守衛，卻被新趕來的人截住。那個男孩拖慢了你們的腳步，再逃一次就得把他丟下。
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU TRY TO SNEAK UP PAST THE GUARDS BUT THEY ARE TOO ALERT.  YOU CANNOT GET BY THE GUARDS INTO THE SLAVE PEN.  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們想溜過守衛，他們卻警覺得很，怎麼也進不了奴隸欄。你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 海盜據點。

entries.source: YOU TUMBLE DOWN A STEEP, LOOSE SLOPE, MAKING A LOUD CLATTER.
entries.text: 你們滾下一道陡峭鬆動的斜坡，弄出好大聲響。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU UP THE BID. MONSTERS NEARBY TURN, STARE,
entries.text: 你們加了價。附近的怪物轉過頭來盯著，
entries.note: 片段。

entries.source: YOU WAIT IN YOUR ROOM FOR ABOUT TWO HOURS WHEN SUDDENLY FOUR ARMED GUARDS BURST IN AND ATTACK YOU.
entries.text: 你們在房裡等了約莫兩個小時，四名武裝守衛突然闖進來攻擊。
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOU WALK NEAR THE
entries.text: 你們走近
entries.note: 敘述片段，後面接地名。

entries.source: YOU WANDER IN THE OLD HEMP MARKET.  MONSTERS SCURRY AT YOUR APPROACH.  YOU OCCASSIONALLY CATCH SNATCHES OF CONVERSATIONS.
entries.text: 你們在舊麻市裡走著，怪物一見你們就四下逃竄，偶爾能聽見隻字片語。
entries.note: 貧民區（Slums）的事件與敘述。原版此處把 OCCASIONALLY 拼成 OCCASSIONALLY。

entries.source: YOU WANDER IN THE PLAZA NEAR KUTO'S WELL.
entries.text: 你們在古托井旁的廣場上走著。
entries.note: 古托井與井下的小妖魔洞穴。

entries.source: YOU'VE ANGERED THE GUARDS.  THEY DEMAND THAT YOU RETURN TO YOUR QUARTERS.  WHAT WILL YOU DO?
entries.text: 你們惹惱了守衛，他們要你們回住處去。你們要怎麼做？
entries.note: 野外與漢提爾前哨一帶的事件。

entries.source: YOUR ACTIONS ANGER THE PATRONS AND THEY ATTACK.
entries.text: 你們的舉動惹惱了客人，他們動手了。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: YOUR ACTIONS TRIGGER A FREE FOR ALL.
entries.text: 你們的舉動引爆了一場大亂鬥。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: YOUR CLEARING OF THE SLUM AREAS PERMITS US TO EXPAND.
entries.text: 你們清空了貧民區，我們才得以往外拓展。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOUR COVER IS BLOWN.
entries.text: 你們的偽裝被識破了。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: YOUR ELIMINATION OF THE LIZARDMEN MENACE HAS GREATLY IMPROVED OUR STRATEGIC POSITION.
entries.text: 你們解除了蜥蜴人的威脅，我方的戰略處境大為改善。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOUR FRIEND FLOATS OUT OF THE WELL.
entries.text: 你們的同伴從井裡飄了上來。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOUR MAGIC DETECTS A TRAP!
entries.text: 你們的法術偵測到陷阱！
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOUR PARTY DETECTS A TRAP!
entries.text: 隊伍發現了陷阱！
entries.note: 柯威大樓的盜賊據點。

entries.source: YOUR PARTY IS TOO LARGE FOR ME TO JOIN.
entries.text: 你們人太多了，我加入不了。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: YOUR PARTY SLIPS PAST THEM.
entries.text: 你們的隊伍從牠們身邊溜了過去。
entries.note: 波多廣場的拍賣會與街頭遭遇。

entries.source: YOUR SUCCESS AT PODAL PLAZA IS NOTED.
entries.text: 你們在波多廣場的表現已記錄在案。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOUR TAKING THE GATE WILL ENABLE OUR FORCES TO ASSAULT THE ENEMY STRONGHOLD. RETURN THERE TO LEAD THE ATTACK.
entries.text: 你們拿下那道門，我軍才能進攻敵方要塞。回去領頭發動攻擊。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: ZOMBIES SHUFFLE DOWN THE STAIRS!
entries.text: 殭屍拖著腳步從樓梯下來了！
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。

entries.source: ZOMBIES.
entries.text: 殭屍。
entries.note: 瓦海登墳場的事件與敘述。
